summaries: Study of genes, their protein products and regulatory networks; bioactive ingredients' effects can be detected via molecular assays using known markers.
Measurement of which genes are turned on/off (microarrays, qPCR) used in cosmetics to screen raw materials, show efficacy and mechanism, and assess safety.

nodes.label: Glutathione
summaries: Endogenous antioxidant balancing cellular oxidative stress; reacts with prostaglandin J2 cyclopentenone.

nodes.label: Glycosaminoglycan
summaries: Acidic polysaccharides of the dermal ground substance (hyaluronic acid, chondroitin sulfate, dermatan sulfate) holding copious water.
ECM components whose synthesis is stimulated by signal peptides.

nodes.label: Hot Iron Styling
summaries: Flat or curling irons at 160-230°C that dehydrate hair, partially melt crystalline keratin and soften the amorphous matrix above Tm/Tg, locking shapes by vitrification on cooling; causes damage.

nodes.label: Keloid
summaries: Large raised abnormal scar; tendency noted in Asian III, Pacific Islander and Black skin classes.
Scar tissue overgrowth from abnormal wound healing with fibroblast proliferation and collagen overproduction; differential microRNAs including up-regulated miR-21.

nodes.label: Kojic Acid
summaries: Non-FDA-approved natural alternative to hydroquinone for hyperpigmentation; used in combination peels for melasma.
Benchmark skin lightener; tyrosinase IC50 3.0, melanogenesis IC50 100 µg/ml in comparisons.
Copper-chelating tyrosinase inhibitor, QD in 1988 at 1%; clinically tested on freckles and age spots; discouraged by MHLW in 2003 over carcinogenicity concerns.

nodes.label: Langerhans Cell
summaries: Immune cell present in the epidermis contributing to skin immune homeostasis.
Epidermal resident dendritic antigen-presenting cell (3-5% of suprabasal cells) with Birbeck granules; captures antigens via langerin; impaired by UVB and decreases with age.
Skin immune cells bearing toll-like receptors.

nodes.label: Nonionic Surfactants
summaries: Surfactants with no charge, first developed in the 1930s by Atlas Powder Company (sorbitan esters); best solubilizers; used for steric stabilization.

nodes.label: Sebaceous Gland
summaries: Holocrine gland, usually attached to hair follicles, densest on scalp, face, chest (400-900/cm2); androgen-stimulated; cell division to rupture takes about 14 days.
Gland releasing sebum in concert with the follicle (pilosebaceous unit) to maintain the hair shaft; sebum output decreases with age.

nodes.label: SIRT1
summaries: Sirtuin deacetylase regulating cell growth and apoptosis via p53; target of miR-34a.
Nuclear sirtuin deacetylating histones for gene silencing, deacetylating BMAL-1, activating p53, attenuating FOXO; promotes keratinocyte differentiation.

nodes.label: Skin of Color
summaries: Skin with enough pigment to impart a color other than white (African, Asian, Latin, Native American, Pacific Islander, mixed origin); global skin color landscape shifting toward darker tones.

nodes.label: Anagen
summaries: Growth phase of the follicle (2-6 years on scalp, 1-4 months for eyelashes) with intense matrix cell proliferation.
Active growth phase of hair follicles, induced by Eclipta alba.

nodes.label: Androgenetic Alopecia
summaries: Most common patterned hair loss: androgen-driven miniaturization of genetically predisposed follicles with shortened anagen and more telogen/kenogen.
Male pattern baldness with up-regulated miR-221, miR-125b, miR-106b and miR-410.

nodes.label: Atopic Dermatitis
summaries: Itchy chronic skin inflammation with barrier dysfunction; associated with filaggrin mutations and unique gene expression profiles.
Dry, flaky, itchy skin in which all standard amino acids in skin are significantly reduced.

nodes.label: Carbomer
summaries: Cross-linked polyacrylic acid polymer that builds pseudoplastic viscosity, forms clear gels and stabilizes emulsions; salt sensitivity allows lotions to break down quickly on skin.

nodes.label: Fundamentals of Skin Anti-Aging Overview
summaries: Section overview introducing anti-aging research from genomics to apoptosis. Highlights sirtuins, stem cells, DNA repair, glycation/AGEs, telomere theory, beauty from within, sleep, senescence and epigenetics.

nodes.label: Eyelash
summaries: Short (4-14 mm) curved hairs on the eyelids, 300-400 on the upper and 100-150 on the lower lid, with a short anagen phase.

nodes.label: Melanosome
summaries: Melanocyte organelle in which tyrosinase forms melanin; number and size, not melanocyte count, determine skin color.
Cytoplasmic organelle where hair melanins form; transferred via dendrites to cortex and medulla keratinocytes.
Organelle in which melanin is made and transported to dendrites; regulated by OA1, MART1, MLPH genes.
Melanocyte organelle where melanin is synthesized and transferred to keratinocytes.

nodes.label: Padina Pavonica Extract
summaries: Hydrophilic fraction of Padina (HFP) from brown alga farmed in Malta; mobilizes keratinocyte calcium, raising cytokeratin synthesis ~85% at 50 µg/ml and desmosome expression dose-dependently; protects against sulfuric acid and nicotine.

nodes.label: Cosmetic Safety Assessment
summaries: Evaluation by a qualified expert of ingredient toxicology, exposure and finished-product tests to conclude a product is safe under normal and foreseeable use; voluntary in US (else warning), compulsory in EU PIF.

nodes.label: SFDA Guidance for Products Classification
summaries: 2012 guideline classifying drugs, herbal, health and cosmetic products; adds bans (tretinoin, hydroquinone, triclosan) and limits (retinol 1%, sulfur 2%, urea 10%, AHAs 10%).

nodes.label: Skin Elasticity
summaries: Viscoelastic property; extensibility (Uf) and elastic recovery (Ur/Uf) decrease with age, Ur/Uf most strongly (R2=0.656).
Decreases with declining HA production during aging.
Measured as elongation to break on Fudo rheometer; increased by sodium PCA and polyaspartate.

nodes.label: Vascular Endothelial Growth Factor
summaries: Angiogenic factor up-regulated by UVB in keratinocytes, endothelial cells and fibroblasts.
VEGF, potent angiogenic factor produced by ORS keratinocytes, upregulated with perifollicular vascularization during anagen.
Vascular endothelial growth factor promoting new blood vessel formation; in ADSC conditioned media.
Vascular growth factor whose secretion is increased by 1.5-3% lactic acid, possibly explaining AHA microvascular effects.

nodes.label: Arginine
summaries: Amino acid positively charged at neutral pH, a major contributor to protein charge.
Amino acid nitric oxide precursor (Ajinomoto) reported to stimulate hair regrowth and strengthen hair by nourishing roots.
Used with calcium carbonate in dentifrices to block open dentinal tubules.
Alkaline amino acid that raises pH of AHA/BHA products without reducing efficacy, smooths hair and neutralizes gel polymers.

nodes.label: CLOCK/BMAL-1 Complex
summaries: Circadian heterodimer; CLOCK acetyltransferase acetylates BMAL-1; limited by SIRT1 deacetylation.

nodes.label: Cytokines
summaries: Signaling molecules regulating growth, differentiation, migration, immunity and inflammation; malfunction leads to arthritis, cardiac disease and cancer.
Small signaling proteins/glycoproteins from keratinocytes, LCs, macrophages, fibroblasts, lymphocytes (interleukins, interferons, TNF, CSFs, growth factors); production rises upon challenge.
Immune-regulating secreted factors also involved in skin repair; combined with growth factors in topical products.

nodes.label: Dry Skin
summaries: Xerosis common in the elderly, prone to itching, with distinctive line patterns on legs; multifactorial (lower PCA, slower SC renewal, less lactate and glycerol).
Dehydration addressed by marine polysaccharides and Salicornia.
Excessive skin dryness linked to hyperosmolarity and senescence; target of osmoprotective agents.

nodes.label: Ellagic Acid
summaries: Natural alternative to hydroquinone for hyperpigmentation.
Polyphenol from oak galls, berries, pomegranates and walnuts; copper chelator; QD for Lion in 1996 at 0.5%.

nodes.label: Hair Color
summaries: Product containing ammonia at levels whose odor fragrance can only slightly mitigate.
Hair colorants requiring CU State Registration; special-use in China; exempted from some US adulteration rules.
Permanent and demi-permanent dyes used to cover gray; permanent color oxidizes proteins and lipids via ammonia and H2O2.

nodes.label: INCI Nomenclature
summaries: International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients names listed by the PCPC, used for ingredient labels; INCI fragrance blends list each material instead of 'fragrance'.
Conventional worldwide naming system for cosmetic ingredient labeling; presence of an INCI name does not authorize an ingredient, nor does absence prohibit it.

nodes.label: MMP-1
summaries: Interstitial collagenase secreted by fibroblasts under estrogen/progesterone and IL-1alpha control; dissolves type I collagen trabeculae in cellulite.

nodes.label: N-Acetylglucosamine
summaries: Neutral amino sugar (NAG), component of GAGs, chitin and hyaluronic acid; 8% cream raised skin thickness 16.2% and pinch recoil 12.2%, inhibits tyrosinase glycosylation and synergizes with retinoic acid on HA (2.5-fold).

nodes.label: Niacinamide
summaries: Vitamin B3 amide; listed as alternative to hydroquinone for hyperpigmentation.
Used as hydroxycitrate (2.2%) and salicylate (4.0%) in the anti-aging cream.

nodes.label: Obstructive Sleep Apnea
summaries: Airway collapse during sleep causing oxygen desaturation, HPA activation, fragmented sleep; graded by AHI; increases oxidative stress, reduces growth hormone; more prevalent with age.

nodes.label: p53
summaries: Tumor suppressor protein encoded by TP53, 'guardian of the genome', regulating the cell cycle; interacts with Nrf2 and AMPK.
Apoptosis-inducing protein rapidly degraded by increased proteasome activity; link to cancer caveat.

nodes.label: PEG/PPG Dimethicone
summaries: Dimethicone copolyols: silicones with pendant PEG/PPG chains giving amphiphilic surfactant behavior (wetting at ~500 Da, emulsification ~2,500, conditioning ~10,000, waterproofing ~50,000); the term 'silicone copolyol' is obsolete.

nodes.label: Regulatory Harmonization
summaries: Alignment of cosmetic regulations across countries; harmonized guidelines streamline assessment, reduce development time and duplication, and minimize in vivo testing without compromising safety.

nodes.label: Skin Hydration
summaries: Moisture state of skin, a target of gene expression and epigenetic studies.
Upper lip hydration greater than lower; submucosa less hydrated than rest of vermilion.
In a 60-day study with 0.005% HA, 4.6 and 17 kDa fragments raised hydration first month; 1.66 MDa HA best after three months.
Key to youthful appearance; correlates linearly with SC amino acid content.

nodes.label: Sodium Lauryl Sulfate
summaries: Surfactant irritant; older skin shows lower reactivity to SLS.
Harsh surfactant to avoid in daily cleansing because it strips natural oils.
Toothpaste surfactant suggested as a predisposing factor for canker sores.
Typical sulfate anionic surfactant used in shampoos and body washes.
Anionic fatty surfactant reducing water surface tension from 72 to ~30 dynes/cm; co-surfactant in RF50 studies.
Irritant (SLS) used to challenge skin barrier.

nodes.label: Stem Cells
summaries: Immature precursor cells capable of self-renewal and multi-lineage differentiation; adult stem cells have fewer ethical and control issues than embryonic.
Cells that self-renew and differentiate; their extracts contain growth factors and cytokines used in serums and creams.
Stem-cell-ness correlates with telomere length; telomere loss may contribute to stem cell dysfunction.

nodes.label: Superoxide Dismutase
summaries: Antioxidant enzyme in ADSC conditioned media protecting skin from oxidative damage.
Most important endogenous enzyme for mitigating reactive oxygen.
Endogenous antioxidant enzyme; large protein that cannot penetrate cell membranes.
Major metal-containing antioxidant enzyme; activity reduced by free radical damage.

nodes.label: Viscosity
summaries: A measure of the resistance of a fluid to deformation or flow; higher viscosity contributes to emulsion stability and is associated with luxuriousness.

nodes.label: Alkyl Dimethicone
summaries: Alkyl-modified silicones soluble in oils and petrolatum, insoluble in dimethicone; hardness/melt point rise with alkyl length (C32+ melt ≥60°C).
Amphiphilic silicones with silicone- and oil-soluble groups that lower oil surface tension (soybean oil 32 to 22 dynes/cm), improve spread and gel oils; C16 or less liquid, C18+ solid.

nodes.label: Antioxidant Network
summaries: Skin's interlinked defense of enzymes and non-enzymatic antioxidants maintaining pro-oxidant/antioxidant balance; can be overwhelmed by exogenous ROS.

nodes.label: Chelating Agents
summaries: Adding a chelating agent and keeping the product slightly acidic can help prevent fragrance-induced color change.
Bind metal ions neutralizing their ability to initiate oxidation; important in high water activity O/W emulsions, soaps, shampoos.

nodes.label: China
summaries: Major market where imported cosmetics require CFDA registration and animal testing; announced removal of mandatory animal tests for domestic non-special-use cosmetics from June 2014.
Skin care market over 35 billion yuan (US$5.5 billion), of which whitening products are 71%.

nodes.label: Citric Acid
summaries: May exceed 10% in KSA bath preparations meant to be diluted.
Acid in neutralizing shampoos that stops OH ion reactions after relaxing.
Natural fermentation-derived chelator weaker than EDTA.
Polycarboxyl acid that is both AHA and BHA; found in citrus and the Krebs cycle; antioxidant; 20% increased epidermal thickness and dermal GAGs.

nodes.label: Cosmetic/Drug Combination Product
summaries: US category for products with both cosmetic and drug function (e.g., anti-dandruff shampoo, antiperspirant-deodorant, fluoride toothpaste, SPF moisturizers); must meet both requirements; not allowed in the EU.

nodes.label: Cytokeratins
summaries: Intermediate filament proteins forming keratinocyte cytoskeleton, responsible for mechanical strength and signal transduction; maturation calcium-dependent; decline with aging and pollutants.

nodes.label: FDA Prohibited Cosmetic Ingredients
summaries: Short FDA list (about 8 substances) banned in cosmetics: bithionol, CFC propellants, chloroform, halogenated salicylanilides, methylene chloride, vinyl chloride, zirconium complexes in aerosols, prohibited cattle materials.

nodes.label: Gingivitis
summaries: Reversible inflammation of the gums with bleeding, associated with plaque accumulation and Gram-negative anaerobes like Fusobacterium nucleatum and Prevotella intermedia.

nodes.label: Gluconolactone
summaries: Most common PHA, from corn sugar; equivalent to glycolic acid on aging attributes with less irritation; chelates metals inhibiting MMPs, reduces UV elastin promoter activation by 50%, and strengthens barrier against SLS.

nodes.label: Glycerol
summaries: Derived from sebum hydrolysis; contributes to skin hydration (asebic mice studies).
Carrier (not an effective maceration solvent) from local rapeseed; avoids preservatives by preventing germ growth.
Common humectant whose moisturizing depends on humidity; at low humidity draws water from inner skin.
Humectant that left hair rougher than sodium PCA.

nodes.label: GSO 1943/2009 Cosmetic Products Safety Requirements
summaries: SFDA-sanctioned Gulf standard (equivalent SASO 1953/2009) based on Directive 76/768 with tables of prohibited, restricted substances, colorants, preservatives and UV filters.

nodes.label: Hair Damage
summaries: Denaturation and bond breakage of hair proteins from heat, perms, bleaching, alkaline straightening, UV and mechanical fatigue, compromising moisture control and mechanical and optical properties.

nodes.label: Osmoprotection
summaries: Adaptation via compatible solutes protecting cells from osmotic stress; offered as therapy for collagen synthesis, inflammation, wrinkles, brightening, age spots and acne.

nodes.label: Phenylpropanoids
summaries: Phenylalanine-derived polyphenols that absorb UV, repel herbivores, and act as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, photoprotecting and antimicrobial cosmetic agents.

nodes.label: Pheomelanin
summaries: Yellow to red melanin formed from DOPA-quinone and cysteine via cysteinyldopa; predominates in blond hair.
Yellow to red melanin found mainly in red hair; its synthesis also involves cysteine; less photostable than eumelanin.

nodes.label: Polysorbates
summaries: Affordable surfactants used as diluent/compatibilizer in water-soluble fragrances.
Sorbitan esters reacted with ethylene oxide; high HLB emulsifiers and solubilizers; reduce eye sting in baby shampoos.

nodes.label: Rosemary Extract
summaries: Plant antioxidant performing well in oily phases of formulations.
Nonpolar Rosmarinus officinalis leaf extract (solvent or supercritical CO2) whose activity comes from phenolic diterpenes carnosic acid and carnosol; low-odor/color grades available.

nodes.label: Hair Shape Memory
summaries: Hair behaves as a thermoset, viscoelastic shape-memory biopolymer: it has a permanent shape that can be temporarily changed and later recovered.

nodes.label: Skin Whitening
summaries: Breakthroughs in skin whitening are highlighted among key ingredient developments.
Achieved via tyrosinase inhibition by algal compounds, peptides and lactic acid.
Very large Asian skin care category (Bihaku in Japan) aiming to lighten skin and dark spots; regarded as equivalent to anti-wrinkle for Caucasians.
ASCs lighten skin dose-dependently, of interest in Eastern markets.

nodes.label: Soap
summaries: Soaps and special toilet soaps were developed for the military and home front in WWII, partly to reduce dermatitis.

In the US, a product whose nonvolatile matter is mainly alkali salts of fatty acids and sold solely as soap; regulated by CPSC, not FDA, unless it has cosmetic claims or ingredients. Classified as cosmetic in the EU.
The original naturally derived anionic surfactant, used since the Akkadians c. 2800 BCE; made by boiling fats with ashes; soap-stabilized emulsions need pH above 7.
Removes about 70% of SC amino acids and 62% PCA.

nodes.label: Styling Polymers
summaries: Film formers (PVP, VP/VA, acrylates, polyquaterniums, chitosan) that form seam and spot welds between fibers to restrict movement and hold temporary shapes without altering hair memory.

nodes.label: Toll-Like Receptor
summaries: Membrane proteins binding pathogen components (bacterial DNA, LPS, flagellin, beta-glucan) that regulate cytokine production.
Pattern recognition receptors (~11 characterized) on epithelia, keratinocytes and Langerhans cells; activation causes defensin production.

nodes.label: Waxes
summaries: Key lipstick component providing crystalline structure; hard waxes melt over ~3-5°C range, soft waxes over ~10-12°C.

nodes.label: Arbutin
summaries: Natural alternative to hydroquinone for hyperpigmentation.
Skin lightener; tyrosinase IC50 33; less effective than ellagic acid and tetrahydrocurcuminoids.
Beta-D-glucopyranoside of hydroquinone from cowberry leaves; reversible competitive tyrosinase inhibitor; QD for Shiseido 1989 at 3%.
Used at 0.5% in the anti-aging cream.

nodes.label: Asian Ethnic Skin
summaries: Skin of EP classes V-VII with yellow undertones from higher pheomelanin; prone to pigmentation disorders and acne in normal to oily skin; aging shows as hyperpigmentation rather than wrinkles.

nodes.label: Bakuchiol
summaries: Phenolic meroterpene; psoralen-depleted Sytenol A (~95%) is non-sensitizing; inhibits lipid peroxidation, NF-kB, HIF-1 and iNOS; radical scavenging above vitamin E; retinol-like gene expression; 1% eliminated UV erythema; improves acne and aging signs; stabilizes retinol.

nodes.label: Catagen
summaries: Regression phase lasting ~2-4 weeks in which follicle cells undergo apoptosis and a club fiber forms.

nodes.label: Cell
summaries: Membrane-bound unit containing DNA and cytoplasm; eukaryotic cells contain organelles and vesicles.

nodes.label: Certification-Exempt Color Additives
summaries: Colorants from mineral, plant or animal sources exempt from FDA batch certification, e.g. iron oxides, titanium dioxide, mica, carmine, zinc oxide.

nodes.label: Cholesterol
summaries: Stratum corneum barrier lipid secreted via lamellar bodies; rate-limiting enzyme of its synthesis is HMG-CoA reductase.
Major stratum corneum lipid determining permeability barrier; 1% of sebum.
Skin lipid whose synthesis is influenced by Ulkenia extracts.

nodes.label: Cortisol
summaries: Glucocorticoid stress hormone; excess breaks down skin collagen (loss 10x greater than other tissues), reduces skin regeneration, disrupts REM; linked to adult acne.

nodes.label: Cuticle Cell Buckling
summaries: Lifting and buckling of cuticle cells with breakage of CMC cement caused by elongation, blow-drying or hot irons; common at hair tips, partly viscoelastically reversible.

nodes.label: Cyclomethicone
summaries: INCI family of cyclic dimethyl siloxanes (D4, D5, D6) that are volatile (heat of vaporization 31 cal/g) and give a dry, silky feel; under environmental/regulatory scrutiny.

nodes.label: Dark Under-Eye Circles
summaries: Reduced by Boswellin CG under-eye cream.
Reduced by PSP, possibly via increased collagen thickening skin over vessels.
Skin problem linked to poor blood circulation; assessed in Albizia self-assessment.

nodes.label: Defensins
summaries: Antimicrobial host defense peptides discovered mid-1980s, produced by epithelial cells (trachea, bowel, epidermis); also proliferative and anti-inflammatory; overproduced in psoriasis.

nodes.label: UV DNA Damage
summaries: UV-induced dimerization of adjacent pyrimidine bases in DNA that can lead to cell death.
Chemical changes in DNA structure producing dysfunction; central to most aging theories.

nodes.label: Ethanol
summaries: Alcohol in perfumery; must be denatured in KSA; alcohol-containing mouthwash banned in KSA since 2011.
Biodegradable extraction solvent produced from renewable sugar cane, beet, wheat or corn; recycled by distillation.
Most common organic solvent in hydroalcoholic personal care gels; reduces viscosity of Aristoflex HMB progressively above 20%.

nodes.label: Eumelanin
summaries: Brown to black melanin formed via indole-5,6-quinone; a poikilopolymer; seen in dark hair.
Brown to black melanin; brown eumelanin in low amounts gives blond hair, dark eumelanin gives dark hair; more photostable than pheomelanin.

nodes.label: Frizz
summaries: Hair fibers out of synchrony with the bundle, from damaged shape memory, cuticle damage raising inter-fiber friction, or static fly-away; common after bleaching and hot ironing.

nodes.label: Gel Structure of the Amorphous Phase
summaries: Hydrophilic, hydrogen-bonded part of the amorphous matrix (Feughelman's term) that absorbs water, is plasticized by moisture and stores temporary shapes such as water sets.

nodes.label: Genistein
summaries: Soy isoflavone phytoestrogen binding estrogen receptors (preferring ERβ) with 100-1000 times less activity than estradiol; 0.5-1% topically suggested to inhibit estradiol.
Phytoestrogenic isoflavone demethylating agent inhibiting DNMTs and HDACs and activating HATs; stronger than biochanin A and daidzein.

nodes.label: Humectants
summaries: Moisturizers such as glycerin, propylene glycol, sorbitol, PEG; HA retains water at low and high humidity unlike others.
Hygroscopic materials supplying moisture to SC; e.g., sodium PCA, sodium lactate, proline, glycerin.

nodes.label: Kallikrein
summaries: Serine proteases co-localized to lamellar bodies that progressively dissolve corneodesmosomes for orderly desquamation.
Serine protease desquamation enzymes (stratum corneum tryptic and chymotryptic enzymes) whose expression is increased by some marine exopolysaccharides.
Family of 15 serine proteases (KLK1-15) in SC; KLK-7 is a candidate desquamation protease.

nodes.label: Lactobacillus
summaries: Probiotic genus (acidophilus, casei, lactis, plantarum, reuteri, rhamnosus, helveticus); L. acidophilus cell wall has lipoteichoic acid and peptidoglycans.

nodes.label: Lipid Oxidation
summaries: Auto-oxidation of unsaturated oils in three steps (initiation, propagation, termination) causing discoloration, off-odor and instability; principal cause of reduced cosmetic shelf life.

nodes.label: Melanoma
summaries: Cutaneous malignant melanoma, about 5% of skin cancers; metastasizes with high mortality once invasive.
Malignant pigmented band in the nail; new or rapidly changing pigmented bands should be evaluated by a dermatologist for biopsy.
Dangerous melanocyte cancer with distinct microRNA signature; miR-203 down-regulation promotes melanogenesis and reduces melanosome transport.

nodes.label: Nail Unit
summaries: Consists of nail plate, nailbed, medial/lateral/distal nail grooves, epionychium, cuticle and nail root (matrix, lunula). Protects distal digits and enhances tactile sensation and gripping.

nodes.label: Natural Fragrance
summaries: Fragrance of essential oils, absolutes, concretes, isolates and fermentation products; 3-10 times more expensive than traditional fragrances with limited odor characters.

nodes.label: Open Innovation
summaries: Ideation process drawing ideas from outside the organization, e.g. hair care developers using carpet-industry fiber knowledge.
Confidentiality and ownership issues in contract R&D, manufacturing, outsourcing and open innovation; file patents before joint projects.
Methodology leveraging internal and external technology assets to accelerate innovation, relying on transparency and collaboration.

nodes.label: Oral Malodor
summaries: Bad breath; intrinsic mainly from anaerobic bacterial volatile sulfur compounds on tongue and plaque, extrinsic from ingested garlic, cheese, tobacco.

nodes.label: Palmitoyl Pentapeptide (Matrixyl)
summaries: Pal-KTTKS (lysine-threonine-threonine-lysine-serine) by Sederma; 50 ppm significantly reduced periorbital lines vs vehicle; stimulates collagen I, III, IV, fibronectin, elastin and GAG production.

nodes.label: Pseudofolliculitis Barbae
summaries: Razor bumps from ingrown curled hairs; listed for Black/African American skin class.

nodes.label: RNA Interference
summaries: Inhibition of gene expression by small double-stranded RNAs, described by Fire and Mello in C. elegans in 1998 (Nobel Prize 2006).
Suppression of certain genes by sirtuins; loss of this function with age is linked to cancer, Alzheimer's and diabetes.

nodes.label: Scientific Committee on Consumer Safety
summaries: EU Commission scientific committee issuing ingredient safety opinions and 'Notes of Guidance' (incl. MoS calculation and nanomaterial guidance).
EU scientific committee whose 2010 opinion (SCCS/1241/10) addressed D4 and D5 cyclomethicones.

nodes.label: Sensory Perception
summaries: Touch, vibration and thermal perception most significantly affected by advancing age; vulvar touch thresholds 4.6-fold lower in normoestrogenic vs hypoestrogenic women.

nodes.label: Tetrahydropiperine
summaries: Cosmoperine: hydrogenated black pepper piperine (95%); enhances topical bioavailability (green tea +30%, forskolin +40%, BMDP diffusion in 5 min); non-irritating at 0.01-0.1%.

nodes.label: Titanium Dioxide
summaries: Certification-exempt color additive (21 CFR 73.2575); nano TiO2 widely used in sunscreens and studied for size-dependent lung inflammation.
Colorant with relatively low oil absorbance.
Micronized inorganic UV blocker pigment wetted by glutamate derivatives.

nodes.label: Toothpaste
summaries: Toothpastes were among products developed for the military in WWII.
Dentifrice delivering fluoride, anticalculus, antimicrobial, desensitizing and abrasive agents; fluoride toothpastes introduced in the US in the 1950s.
Poloxamers used as solubilizers and gelling agents in oral care.
Silica builds structure and viscosity and gives short texture.

nodes.label: UVA Radiation
summaries: Ultraviolet A irradiation from which Nrf2 protects keratinocytes.
UV band penetrating to the dermis, damaging DNA indirectly via chromophore-generated ROS, activating metalloproteinases and decreasing immune recognition.

nodes.label: AP-1
summaries: Transcription factor promoting MMP/collagenase transcription and reducing fibroblast sensitivity to TGF-beta.
Transcription factor formed upon UV radiation that induces collagenase production.

nodes.label: Albizia Julibrissin Extract
summaries: 'Night sleeper' extract with preventive and curative anti-glycation: inhibits BSA glycation ~50%, reduces CML 43%, explant AGEs -23.4%, maintains glyoxalase-1 and proteasome activity; reduces skin fatigue.

nodes.label: Alternatives to Animal Testing
summaries: Human-relevant non-animal methods (predictive models, in vitro tests, pathway-based toxicity information) increasingly used for cosmetic safety assessment.

nodes.label: Amadori Product
summaries: Early glycation product formed when reducing sugars react non-enzymatically with protein amino groups.

nodes.label: Anti-Aging Cream
summaries: Example formulation with niacinamide salicylate, ethyl lactate, paeonol, carnosine, arbutin and peptide compound (III).

nodes.label: Antiperspirant
summaries: Roll-ons are difficult emulsions (low viscosity, low pH, high electrolyte); use blends of low/high HLB ethoxylated fatty alcohols.
Product category relying on suspending agents; uses PEGs as co-gelling aids for sticks and cyclomethicones for dry feel.

nodes.label: Cancer
summaries: Disease linked to epigenetic changes, DNA methylation, transcription factor mutations and cytokine malfunction; actives may prevent or, after onset, sometimes worsen malignancy.
HA oligosaccharides sensitize cancer cells to treatment and inhibit pro-tumorigenic signaling of high-MW HA.

nodes.label: Sustainability Book Authors
summaries: Lists the chapters and authors of the Sustainability & Eco-responsibility focus book, including an editor's overview by Alban Muller and chapters on defining sustainability, botanical sustainability, the Herboretum network, local cultures for carbon footprint reduction, plant cell cultures, eco-responsible extraction and green industrial production.

nodes.label: The Hair: Editor's Overview
summaries: Editor's overview of Part 3.3 on hair. Notes that hair aesthetics are linked to viscoelastic properties of cuticle and cortex, that follicle biology (stem cells, hormones, graying) has advanced, and that hair care is moving to a holistic approach targeting live follicle cells with bioactives.

nodes.label: Chemical Peel
summaries: Exfoliating treatment of varying depth; deep peels require caution in darker skin classes due to hyperpigmentation and keloid risk.

nodes.label: Cortical Cell
summaries: Elongated spindle-shaped cells ~20 µm in diameter and ~100 µm long forming ~90% of hair; they synthesize keratin into intermediate filaments embedded in an amorphous matrix and determine mechanical properties.

nodes.label: Legal Definition of Cosmetic
summaries: US: articles applied to the body for cleansing, beautifying, promoting attractiveness or altering appearance (excluding soap). EU: substances placed on external body parts, teeth or oral mucosa exclusively or mainly to clean, perfume, change appearance, protect, keep in good condition or correct odours.

nodes.label: EU Cosmetics Directive 76/768/EEC
summaries: 1976 EU directive based on self-responsibility, replaced by Regulation 1223/2009 in July 2013; model for GSO, Chinese and CU rules.

nodes.label: Cosmetic Products Notification Portal
summaries: EU online portal where the Responsible Person must notify products (category, RP, nanomaterials, CMR, frame formulation, label) before market placement; not an authorization.

nodes.label: Polymer Cross-Linking
summaries: Linking of polymer chains into a network; higher cross-link density generally raises yield stress and viscosity of rheology modifiers and determines elastomer vs resin behavior in silicones.

nodes.label: CU State Registration
summaries: Conformity document for 13 higher-risk cosmetic categories (e.g. tanning, whitening, children's, hair dyes, nanomaterial products, peelings, fluoride oral care); issued to manufacturer, unlimited validity, valid across the CU.

nodes.label: COX-2
summaries: Cyclooxygenase-2 inflammatory enzyme inhibited by verbascoside.
Inducible pro-inflammatory enzyme catalyzing prostaglandin biosynthesis from arachidonic acid; triggered by ubiquitinated protein aggregates.

nodes.label: Dental Calculus
summaries: Mineralized dental plaque (tartar), ~80% inorganic (brushite, octacalcium phosphate, whitlockite, apatite) with ~400 ppm fluorine; considered cosmetic but associated with periodontal disease.

nodes.label: Dental Plaque
summaries: Complex heterogeneous microbial biofilm on teeth that develops by ecological succession from Gram-positive cocci to anaerobic and acid-tolerant species; pathogenicity relates to mass and specific microbes.

nodes.label: Dentin Hypersensitivity
summaries: Pain from exposed dentin triggered by heat, cold, pressure or sugar; affects about one in seven people.

nodes.label: Dietary Supplementation
summaries: Comprehensive regimen of cell/connective tissue nutrients (glucosamine, amino acids, lecithin, EFAs, vitamins, sirtuin activators); 12 weeks raised ICW in 57.5% of patients.

nodes.label: Dihydrotestosterone
summaries: DHT, formed from testosterone by type II 5-alpha reductase; induces dermal papilla cells to secrete TGF-b1 and DKK-1 inhibiting keratinocyte growth; levels rise with age.

nodes.label: DNA Methyltransferases
summaries: DNMT1 (maintenance, most abundant), DNMT3A and DNMT3B add methyl groups to cytosines.

nodes.label: DNA Repair
summaries: Repair of UV-induced DNA dimers, e.g., by photolyase via photoreactivation.
Base excision and double-strand break repair aided by SIRT6; immediately affected by sirtuin expression changes.

nodes.label: Epigallocatechin Gallate
summaries: Green tea catechin associated with Nrf2 activation and reported to activate AMPK.
EGCG: major tea polyphenol; demethylating agent inhibiting DNMT1 and HATs, modulates miRNA, induces cancer apoptosis.

nodes.label: EU Animal Testing Ban for Cosmetics
summaries: EU prohibition (Art. 18 of Regulation 1223/2009) on animal testing of cosmetic products and ingredients and on marketing animal-tested products, fully applicable from March 2013.

nodes.label: Fitzpatrick Skin Type Classification
summaries: Skin phototype scale (I-VI) based on tanning ability and sunburn propensity; NMSC highest in types I and II.

nodes.label: Flavonoids
summaries: Active ingredients of German chamomile flower; synthesized in chloroplasts.
Over 5000 plant compounds with flavane nucleus; free radical scavengers, UVA absorbing, cytoprotective, anti-inflammatory, inhibit DNA damage; e.g. quercetin, catechin, kaempferol, EGCG.

nodes.label: Forskolin
summaries: Exclusive to Coleus forskohlii; direct adenylate cyclase activator raising cAMP and lipolysis without adrenergic activation; ForsLean 95% at 2-5% reduced thigh circumference 9.37% in 54 women.
Coleus forskohlii compound acting as fat mobilizer.

nodes.label: Gene Expression
summaries: Conversion of gene information into mRNA and then protein; how cells make the right proteins at the right time and quantity.

nodes.label: Green Tea Polyphenols
summaries: Most studied plant antioxidants; promising in mice but human trials failed to show visible anti-aging benefit, though elastic tissue improved histologically.
Water-soluble antioxidants whose permeation is enhanced by tetrahydropiperine.
Camellia sinensis catechins (EGCG, EGC, EC) quenching multiple ROS; reduce UV erythema, sunburn cells, Langerhans cell depletion and pyrimidine dimers.

nodes.label: Hair Cortex
summaries: Bulk of the hair shaft made of cortical cells; provides strength, color and texture and is responsible for most mechanical properties.

nodes.label: Hair Curl Shape
summaries: Permanent straight, wavy or curly hair shape, associated with the ratio and arrangement of ortho- to para-cortical cells and imprinted in the follicle.

nodes.label: Hair Follicle Aging
summaries: Age-related loss of pigmentation, reduced follicle density, more telogen hairs, thinner shafts and slower growth.

nodes.label: Hair Follicle Stem Cell
summaries: Epithelial stem cells residing in the bulge that regenerate the follicle each cycle and supply matrix keratinocytes.

nodes.label: Hair Shine
summaries: Specular reflection of light from smooth intact cuticle produces shine; lifted cuticles scatter light and make hair dull. Cuticle refractive index is ~1.53.

nodes.label: Heavy Metals
summaries: Inevitable impurities on EU forbidden lists, allowed only in technically unavoidable, nonhazardous traces.
Toxic contaminants some plants fix selectively from soil; soils must be analyzed.

nodes.label: High-Throughput Screening
summaries: Cell-based screening in 384- or 1536-well plates allowing hundreds of millions of extracts to be tested per 24 hours for new fragrance ingredients.

nodes.label: Histone Modification
summaries: Acetylation, phosphorylation, methylation and ubiquitination of histones that alter chromatin structure and regulate transcription; acetylation relaxes chromatin, raising transcription.
Acetylation, methylation, phosphorylation, ubiquitination and sumoylation of histone tails altering gene expression; methylation can be inherited.

nodes.label: Hypothalamic-Pituitary-Adrenal Axis
summaries: Fight-or-flight cascade: CRF and vasopressin to pituitary ACTH to adrenal cortisol, epinephrine, norepinephrine; negative feedback by cortisol.

nodes.label: International Cooperation on Cosmetics Regulation
summaries: International group of cosmetic regulators from Canada, the EU, Japan and the US promoting regulatory convergence; its topics include animal testing alternatives, in silico models, nanomaterials, trace impurities, endocrine disruptors and allergens.

nodes.label: Intellectual Property
summaries: Property right for intangibles allowing owners to profit or exclude others; mainly a license to sue, a barrier to entry in cosmetics.

nodes.label: Japan
summaries: ICCR member; Japan Patent Office excludes medical processes, allows post-grant opposition and utility models; deregulated cosmetics in 2001.
Dominates global skin lighteners market; cosmetics industry reported growing at 17% a year.
Major whitening market where quasi-drug approvals and products such as Kanebo, Shiseido, Kose and Pola lines evolved since the 1960s.

nodes.label: Lash Conditioner
summaries: Topical eyelash growth products: oil/vitamin formulas (2000s), prostaglandin analogues (2007), then bioactive peptide and adipose stem-cell peptide generations; increase anagen lashes from 20 to 90%.

nodes.label: Lipolysis
summaries: Enzymatic fat breakdown in adipocytes induced via cAMP.
Lipase hydrolysis of triglycerides to free fatty acids and glycerol, initiated by cAMP-activated lipase.

nodes.label: 18-Methyl Eicosanoic Acid
summaries: Branched fatty acid covalently attached to an ultra-high sulfur protein on the epicuticle forming the F layer; provides hair lubricity and hydrophobicity.

nodes.label: Microbiological Contamination
summaries: Contamination of cosmetics; common limits 1000 cfu/g total aerobic count, 500 cfu/g for eye-area products.

nodes.label: MITF
summaries: Microphthalmia-associated transcription factor in the cAMP melanogenesis pathway.
Transcription factor for tyrosinase and TYRP1 binding E-box CACGTG; down-regulation prevents tyrosinase activation.
Microphthalmia-associated transcription factor regulating melanogenesis enzyme genes; targeted by miR-25, miR-145 and miR-675.

nodes.label: Mitochondria
summaries: Organelles with their own DNA that carry out the cell's oxidative metabolism.
Organelles using oxygen to produce energy; weakest link in aging as they lack most cellular free radical defenses.

nodes.label: Nail Discoloration
summaries: Nail color change from dyes, smoking, nail varnish tints, artificial nails, psoriasis, Pseudomonas infection, or drugs such as tetracycline and chloroquine.

nodes.label: Natural Fragrance Ingredient
summaries: All-natural aromatic ingredients increasingly demanded but hard to source reliably, often from equatorial regions threatened by global warming.

nodes.label: New Product-Development Process
summaries: Seven-step process: idea generation, concept testing, business analysis/marketing planning, product development, market testing, commercialization and evaluation of market results.

nodes.label: Odorant Receptor
summaries: Biological entities mediating scent detection; humans have a family of ~350 OR genes, G-protein coupled integral membrane proteins expressed in nasal epithelium cells.

nodes.label: Onycholysis
summaries: Separation of nail from nailbed due to trauma, infection, dermatitis, psoriasis, drugs and cosmetics such as acrylic nails, formaldehyde hardeners; often colonized by Candida or Pseudomonas.

nodes.label: Parabens
summaries: Preservatives in some OTC vaginal products considered potentially irritating.
Became preservative of choice for antifungal activity; methylparaben most used (13434 US, 54668 Canada listings), plus propyl, butyl, ethyl, isobutyl parabens.

nodes.label: Emblica Antioxidant
summaries: Standardized Phyllanthus emblica fruit extract rich in emblicanins A/B; stable, chelates iron/copper without pro-oxidant activity, inhibits MMPs, increases collagen, lightens skin and reduces fine lines.

nodes.label: Polycyclic Aromatic Hydrocarbons
summaries: Inevitable impurities listed among EU forbidden substances.
Ubiquitous combustion pollutants (e.g., benzo[a]pyrene from exhaust and cigarette smoke) synergistic with UVA in oxidative damage.
Highly toxic contaminants produced by burning fossil fuels; drying equipment must not generate them.

nodes.label: Primary Antioxidants
summaries: Phenolic free-radical quenchers that delay initiation or slow propagation by donating hydrogen radicals.

nodes.label: Probiotics
summaries: WHO: live microorganisms conferring health benefit in adequate amounts; author proposes 'live or dead'; includes Lactobacillus, Bifidobacterium, Saccharomyces boulardii, Streptococcus thermophilus strains.

nodes.label: Product Information File
summaries: Compulsory EU dossier (Art. 11) with product description, CPSR, manufacturing/GMP statement, proof of claimed effects and animal testing data; available to authorities.

nodes.label: Microbial Product Spoilage
summaries: Degradation of cosmetics by bacteria and fungi (often combined) and chemical instability; can cause infections and lost sales.

nodes.label: Proline
summaries: Amino acid found with glycine at protein-surface loop locations.
Amino acid uniquely retaining moisture at low humidity, forming with leucine/isoleucine a lipid bilayer that inhibits moisture loss; boosts collagen in cocktail.
Amino acid osmoprotectant; increased tenfold-fivefold under salt stress.

nodes.label: Saudi Food and Drug Authority
summaries: Created 2003, Cosmetic Department since 2008; issues regulations, controls safety, develops standards and runs cosmetovigilance in KSA.

nodes.label: Singlet Oxygen
summaries: High-energy oxygen species formed in Type II photo-oxidation; quenched by carotenoids.
First ROS formed from triplet excited endogenous photosensitizers under UVA; initiates lipid peroxidation; also generated by organic sunscreens acting as triplet sensitizers.

nodes.label: Skin Whitening Products
summaries: Skin lightening cosmetics; hydroquinone-free versions are cosmetics in KSA; require CU State Registration; whitening claims make a US drug.
Whitening/brightening creams; about 60% of Indian women use daily; 71% of China's skin care market; Asia-Pacific market projected over $2 billion by 2012.

nodes.label: Sodium PCA
summaries: Highly hygroscopic humectant from cyclized glutamic acid; plumps fine lines, dramatically increases skin elongation and smooths hair better than glycerin or butylene glycol.

nodes.label: Solar Elastosis
summaries: Hallmark of photo-aging: accumulation of dystrophic elastic fibers with lysozyme and amyloid P that provide little elasticity.
Dermal matrix damage from chronic photoaging exacerbated by UV-induced elastin promoter activation.

nodes.label: Sun Exposure
summaries: Exposure to sunlight; most damage accumulated during the first 18 years of life; key driver of photodamage and pigmentation.

nodes.label: Telomeres
summaries: Non-coding DNA at chromosome ends that maintain genetic integrity; shorten with each division leading to senescence.

nodes.label: Trademark
summaries: Brand distinguishing a company's goods; protected by use and registration, renewable every ten years indefinitely; key test is likelihood of confusion.

nodes.label: Vulvar Atrophy
summaries: Silent epidemic affecting up to 50% of postmenopausal women: thinning, loss of elasticity, decreased vascularity and nerve endings, dryness and inflammation, mainly from hypoestrogenism.

nodes.label: Algae
summaries: Over 25,000 kinds of photosynthetic organisms without roots, stems or leaves; microalgae (Spirulina, Phormidium, Anacystis) and macroalgae (Laminaria, Fucus, Chondrus, up to 40 m).

nodes.label: Allergens
summaries: Sensitizing substances, notably fragrance components; an ICCR regulatory topic and subject of EU labeling thresholds.

nodes.label: Contact Allergy
summaries: Dermal allergy to fragrance substances; up to 26 fragrance materials are identified as dermal allergens.
Condition the EU's 26-allergen labeling aims to protect consumers against.
Potential risk of growth factors in hypersensitive patients.

nodes.label: Alpha-MSH
summaries: Melanocyte-stimulating hormone binding melanocyte receptor, stimulating melanogenesis via cAMP-MITF.
Keratinocyte messenger binding melanocyte receptors to trigger melanin synthesis.

nodes.label: Amorphous Protein Matrix
summaries: Disulfide cross-linked, non-crystalline protein phase (M phase) surrounding keratin microfibrils, with high- and low-sulfur regions and a water-plasticizable hydrophilic 'gel structure' plus a hydrophobic non-gel structure.

nodes.label: Beta-1,3-D-Glucan
summaries: Yeast cell-wall polysaccharide used ~70 years as nutraceutical and skincare additive; identified by DiLuzio as active of zymosan; stimulates immunity via Dectin-1; primary PDB.

nodes.label: Beta Hydroxy Acids
summaries: So-called BHA products based on salicylic acid.
Synthetic antioxidant, mixture of two isomers, used against rancidity.
Keratolytic clarifying acids whose stinging is reduced by pH adjustment.

nodes.label: Caffeic Acid
summaries: Polyphenolic component associated with Nrf2 activation.
Phenylpropanoid that is an excellent oxidative radical scavenger.

nodes.label: Caloric Restriction
summaries: Restricting calories (40-60%) extends life span in yeast, worms, flies, mice and primates; not shown to slow aging in humans; practitioners look older facially.

nodes.label: Cationic Surfactants
summaries: Surfactants with net positive charge; attach to negatively charged hair and skin to condition; high irritation potential.

nodes.label: Cell Membrane Complex
summaries: Extracellular 'cement' gluing cuticle and cortical cells, made of upper and lower beta (lipid) layers and a delta protein layer; the beta-delta junction is the weakest link and a diffusion path into the cortex.
Glues cortex cells of hair together; contains amino acids.

nodes.label: Chlorhexidine
summaries: Antimicrobial clinically shown to reduce gingivitis; also inhibits cariogenic bacteria, controls malodor and speeds canker sore healing.

nodes.label: Chromatin
summaries: DNA-protein material of eukaryotic chromosomes organized into nucleosomes; its winding plays a role in gene regulation.
Chromosomal complex of DNA, nucleosomes (eight histones) and RNA.

nodes.label: Coconut Water
summaries: Liquid endosperm of Cocos nucifera rich in proteins, amino acids, vitamins, growth hormones; Cococin freeze-dried solids support fibroblast proliferation and improved skin elasticity at 1%; use 1-5%.

nodes.label: Consumer Testing
summaries: Hybrid qualitative (field tests, shop-alongs, in-home visits, diaries, focus groups, interviews, in-store intercepts) and quantitative (surveys) testing guiding development.

nodes.label: Rock Samphire Extract
summaries: Crithmum maritimum oil extract with retinoid-like activity without irritation; up-regulates CRABP2, down-regulates desmosome genes, increases exfoliation and reduces sebum and wrinkles.

nodes.label: Cyclic AMP
summaries: Regulation of intracellular c-AMP suggested but unproven as lash conditioner mechanism.
Second messenger activating lipase to break down fat and part of melanogenesis signaling.
Second messenger activating lipase; destroyed by phosphodiesterase.

nodes.label: Cyclopentasiloxane
summaries: D5 cyclic silicone, the most common D4 replacement and most widely used elastomer solvent; authors expect it may disappear long-term due to consumer sensitivity.

nodes.label: Cysteine
summaries: Amino acid whose reactive sulfhydryl oxidizes to form disulfide bonds that maintain folded extracellular proteins.
Sulfur-rich amino acid involved in pheomelanin synthesis; hair is rich in half-cystine.
Powerful antioxidant amino acid that penetrates skin.

nodes.label: Dechloro Ethylcloprostenolamide
summaries: Synthetic topical prostaglandin analogue (MD Lash Factor, 2007); increased lash length 1.44-1.94 mm vs 0.63 mm placebo in 4 weeks; non-irritating, nonmutagenic, no IOP change.

nodes.label: Epigenetic Orthodontics
summaries: 'Nonsurgical plastic surgery' using functional appliances to upregulate methylated 'sleepy' genes via mechanotransduction, remodeling craniofacial bone for symmetry and smoother skin.

nodes.label: Epigenetic Therapy
summaries: Anticipated skin-care approach to improve aging skin appearance by targeting epigenetic changes in hydration, barrier repair, ECM renewal, pigmentation and antioxidant capacity.

nodes.label: EU Positive Lists (Annexes IV-VI)
summaries: Colorants (Annex IV), preservatives (Annex V) and UV filters (Annex VI) usable only if listed.

nodes.label: FDA Draft Guidance on Safety of Nanomaterials in Cosmetic Products
summaries: 2012 FDA draft guidance noting nanomaterials may affect safety and effectiveness; FDA has no formal definition but refers to materials of roughly 1-100 nm, and recommends tailored testing.

nodes.label: Film Formers
summaries: Polymers that extend wear but are often stiff and uncomfortable on lips.
Ingredients capable of forming a continuous film on a surface; rheological film formers stabilize foam and help distribute sunscreen actives.

nodes.label: Fragrance Brief
summaries: Brief to the fragrance house with brand overview, psychographic target, olfactive story and mood board, olfactive category, oil cost target, benchmarks, regulatory needs and timeline.

nodes.label: Fragrance House
summaries: Company specializing solely in fragrance creation, with sales, evaluation, perfumery, applications, analytical, regulatory, marketing and QC departments and a library of tens of thousands of formulas.

nodes.label: Fragrance Packaging Design
summaries: Integrated design of bottle, carton, color and name aligned with scent and story so sensory cues communicate the olfactive character and emotional concept.

nodes.label: Free Iron and Copper
summaries: Catalytic transition metals released from ferritin by UVB superoxide and from sweat; drive iron-catalyzed oxidative stress and NF-kB activation.

nodes.label: Hair Conditioner
summaries: Built with long-alkyl-chain cationic surfactant, fatty alcohol for viscosity, and ethoxylated fatty alcohol; usually <10% solids.
Hair care product; amino acid derivatives improve tensile strength (to 93%).

nodes.label: 4-Hexylresorcinol
summaries: Alkylresorcinol used 80+ years (throat lozenges, GRAS anti-browning); tyrosinase/peroxidase inhibitor superior to hydroquinone and kojic acid; increases glutathione enzymes; anti-glycation (Synovea HR).

nodes.label: Histone Deacetylase
summaries: HDAC: deacetylates histones tightening chromatin and silencing genes; at least 18 in humans including seven sirtuins.

nodes.label: Human Adipocyte Conditioned Media Extract
summaries: INCI name for ADSC-derived peptide extract approved by CTFA in September 2006; topical AAPE gave good-to-excellent wrinkle improvement in 47% of subjects.

nodes.label: Hydroxyl Radical
summaries: Highly toxic radical generated from hydrogen peroxide with Fe2+ (Fenton reaction).
Highly reactive species derived from superoxide; initiator of aging.

nodes.label: Inflammatory Cytokines
summaries: Destructive cell-signalling chemicals (TNF-alpha, IL-6) that increase systemically with age and contribute to degenerative disease.

nodes.label: Insomnia
summaries: Inability to sleep despite opportunity; primary or secondary, onset (>30 min latency) or maintenance; chronic insomnia is a 24-hour hyperarousal disorder with high cortisol and ACTH.

nodes.label: Interleukin-1 Alpha
summaries: Apoptosis-promoting cytokine whose increased expression is associated with catagen.
Cytokine controlling MMP secretion after initiation by sex hormones.
Cytokine released by GA-treated keratinocytes that up-regulates fibroblast MMP-1/3 and induces IL-6.

nodes.label: Intermediate Filament
summaries: Crystalline keratin micro-fibrils (C phase) assembled in cortical cells and bound via disulfide bonds to the amorphous matrix to form macrofibrils; do not swell in water.

nodes.label: Intracellular Water
summaries: Water within the cytosol (cell water volume); must be kept steady for metabolism and youthful appearance; reduced in elderly, especially diseased persons.

nodes.label: Keratinization
summaries: Hardening zone of the follicle where hair cells undergo apoptosis and their proteins are cross-linked by disulfide bonds, imprinting the permanent hair shape.
Process by which matrix epidermis forms nail plate, analogous to formation of stratum corneum in epidermis; matrix cells show adult keratinization by week 20 in utero.

nodes.label: Lactobionic Acid
summaries: Bionic acid of gluconic acid linked to galactose (milk sugar); 8% pH 3.8 matched glycolic acid in anti-aging benefits, reduced MMP9 and alpha-MSH-induced melanin.

nodes.label: Laminaria Digitata Extract
summaries: Brown alga extract that inhibits lipolysis-limiting factors, rejuvenates senescent fibroblasts restoring collagen synthesis, and reduces wrinkles in vivo after 28 days.

nodes.label: Lips
summaries: Specialized transitional region between skin and oral mucosa, covered by thin keratinized epithelium on flexible, highly vascular connective tissue.
Substrate for lipstick; thin layer of moisture present; hygroscopic ingredients can dry them.

nodes.label: Lipofuscin
summaries: Yellow-brown 'cellular garbage' age pigment from free radical attack on membranes; excess manifests as aging spots; common in nerve and heart muscle cells.

nodes.label: Margin of Safety
summaries: MoS = NOAEL / SED; per SCCS should exceed 100.

nodes.label: Methylglyoxal
summaries: Reactive dicarbonyl glycotoxin (MGO) forming AGEs such as CML/CEL; overproduces H2O2 accelerating fibroblast senescence.

nodes.label: Mouthwash
summaries: Alcohol-containing mouthwashes banned by SFDA in 2011 because alcohol-free alternatives exist.
Mouthrinse delivering fluoride, antimicrobials or flavors for caries, gingivitis and malodor control.

nodes.label: N-Acetyltyrosinamide
summaries: Increases HA, collagen-1 and elastin in fibroblasts; raised skin thickness 13% in 8 weeks; regimen improved nasolabial folds 10.3% and crow's feet 17.8%.

nodes.label: Nail Matrix
summaries: Germinal tissue (nail root) extending 5-10 mm proximal to the cuticle that produces onychocytes forming the nail plate; plate thickness relates to matrix length.

nodes.label: Nail Plate
summaries: Keratinized cells originating in the nail matrix, without keratohyalin granules; cuticle formed by proximal nail fold.
Hard part of the nail (corpus unguis) made of hard keratin from dead flattened onychocytes; contains 7-12% moisture, 0.15-0.76% fat and about 9-12% cystine by weight.

nodes.label: Oral Care Products
summaries: Toothpastes and mouthwashes; regulated by separate national standards in China; fluoride products have CU labeling rules.
Neem bark used for antimicrobial oral and dental care.

nodes.label: Overharvesting
summaries: Harvesting beyond regeneration capacity, threatening species such as Brazil nut and rosewood with extinction.

nodes.label: Patent Infringement
summaries: Unauthorized making, using, selling or importing a patented invention during its term; remedies include injunction and damages.

nodes.label: Permanent Waving
summaries: Breaking disulfide bonds with 7-9% ammonium or sodium thioglycolate at pH ~9.5, winding on rollers, and reoxidizing with 3% hydrogen peroxide to curl hair; quasi-permanent with gradual reversion.
Perming with ammonium thioglycolate neutralized by sodium bromide reduces tensile strength.

nodes.label: Personal Care Products Council
summaries: U.S. trade association (formerly CTFA) that assigns INCI names and governs botanical and ingredient label naming.
US industry association (formerly CTFA) that manages, publishes and assigns INCI names.
Formerly CTFA; approved INCI name Human Adipocyte Conditioned Media Extract in 2006.
Cosmetics, Toiletries and Fragrance Association (CTFA), cited as major industry regulator.

nodes.label: Pesticides
summaries: Contaminants of plant raw materials that must stay below authorized limits; absent in plant cell culture.

nodes.label: Photo-Aging of Hair
summaries: UV-induced damage causing lipid oxidation, disulfide cleavage, tryptophan degradation and cysteic acid formation; hair becomes dry, porous, weak, rough and lighter.

nodes.label: Polyquaternium
summaries: High-molecular-weight cationic polymers used for conditioning and thickening; polyquaternium-4, -11 and -37 also used in styling.
Cationic (sometimes nonionic) polymers based on cellulosic or synthetic backbones that condition hair, form protective films, improve slip and stabilize foam.

nodes.label: Propylene Glycol
summaries: Ingredient in OTC lubricants that can cause sensitivity in inflamed mucous membranes.
Common moisturizer influenced by relative humidity.

nodes.label: Prostaglandin Analogues
summaries: Glaucoma drugs (latanoprost, bimatoprost) with hypertrichotic side effects increasing eyelash length, number and thickness; rare iris pigmentation and periocular darkening.

nodes.label: Pyrrolidone Carboxylic Acid
summaries: Very hydrophilic NMF component formed from glutamine; lower in elderly skin, especially deeper in the SC.
PCA; 12% of NMF, formed by cyclizing glutamic acid.

nodes.label: Quaternary Ammonium Compounds
summaries: Cationic conditioners providing ease of combing.
Primary conditioning agents in rinse-off conditioners; made by reacting tertiary amine with alkylating agent.

nodes.label: REACH Regulation
summaries: EU chemicals regulation (Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals); substances over 1 t/year must be registered with ECHA, polymers and natural substances exempt.
EU chemicals regulation measuring substance environmental impact; cosmetic ingredients comply while food-grade products don't.
EU chemicals regulation under which ethyl methicone is a registered polymer.

nodes.label: Responsible Person
summaries: Natural or legal EU-established person designated for each cosmetic (Art. 4), responsible for compliance with safety, GMP, PIF, notification, labeling, claims and surveillance (Art. 5).

nodes.label: Salicornia Extract
summaries: Halophyte oil extract stimulating aquaporin-8 and aquaporin-3 and increasing urea, filaggrin, NMF and lipids, improving hydration.

nodes.label: Human Sensory Testing
summaries: Sensory studies by perfumers and naive panels; the gold standard of fragrance creation, required to confirm HTS hits and detect off-notes.
Consumer-perceived attributes such as speed of breakdown, spreadability, cushion, pick-up and skin afterfeel that correlate with rheological measurements.

nodes.label: Shape Reversion
summaries: Gradual return to original shape after perms or relaxers because residual memory in primary/secondary protein structure and crystalline regions is not erased.

nodes.label: SIRT3
summaries: Mitochondrial sirtuin activating acetyl-CoA synthetase and SOD2 by deacetylation; decreased by ozone and disrupted by UVB in keratinocytes.

nodes.label: Skin
summaries: Organ forming the border between organism and environment; prevents dehydration, blocks noxious materials and microbes, cushions shock, regulates temperature. Divided into epidermis, dermis and subcutaneous tissue.
Largest reservoir of HA, holding 50% of total body HA.

nodes.label: Skin Immunity
summaries: Coordinated immune response by keratinocytes and skin-resident immune cells to barrier disruption (UV, trauma, irritants, infection) to maintain homeostasis.

nodes.label: Sodium Laureth Sulfate
summaries: Ethoxylated anionic surfactant (SLES-2) whose polyoxyalkylene hydrogen bonding hinders large silicone copolyols reaching the surface.
Anionic surfactant (SLES) that removes about 62% of SC amino acids at 10%; damages hair tensile strength when shampooing.

nodes.label: Special-Use Cosmetics (China)
summaries: Chinese category of higher-risk cosmetics: hair growth, hair dye, perm, hair removal, breast shaping, fitness, deodorizing, spot removal and sun block; require registration.

nodes.label: Surface Tension
summaries: Energy required to break through a liquid surface; water is 72.6 dynes/cm while silicones are much lower, giving spreading and dry feel.

nodes.label: Sustainable Farming
summaries: Conventional farming controlling inputs of fertilizers and pesticides; most cosmetic plants come from it; requires checks for pesticides, heavy metals, mycotoxins, PAHs.

nodes.label: T-Cell
summaries: Lymphocyte present in skin; interferons increase antigen presentation to T-lymphocytes.
Immune cells activated by antigen-presenting Langerhans/dendritic cells; Th1/Th2 clonal expansion yields allergen-specific sensitivity.
Immune cell; low ROS required for survival, high ROS cause apoptosis/necrosis; decline drives immunosenescence.

nodes.label: Telogen
summaries: Resting phase of the follicle (~3 months on scalp, 4-8 months for eyelashes) after which the old hair is shed.

nodes.label: Tumor Necrosis Factor Alpha
summaries: Apoptosis-promoting cytokine whose increased expression is associated with catagen.
Pro-inflammatory cytokine elevated in older skin.
Tumor necrosis factor-alpha, a cytokine contributing to inflammation.

nodes.label: Vegetable Oils
summaries: Replacing mineral oils in cosmetics; improved to lower peroxide index, color and odor; cold-pressed oils oxidize less.

nodes.label: Hair Viscoelasticity
summaries: Hair displays both elastic and viscous behavior: elastic under rapid deformation, viscous plus delayed recovery under prolonged deformation, owing to crystalline filaments in a plasticizable matrix.
Balance of viscous and elastic components of a material, described by tan δ = G''/G'; tan δ < 1 means elastic dominance; affects at-rest appearance, pick-up and cushion.

nodes.label: Volatility
summaries: Ease of vaporizing a fragrance component, indicated by boiling point and vapor pressure; green, citrus and light fruity notes are most volatile, musks and woods least.

nodes.label: Water-Setting
summaries: Temporary shape change by wetting to break hydrogen bonds in the gel structure, imposing a shape on rollers and rapidly drying to re-form them; reversed by re-wetting and slowly lost by stress relaxation.

nodes.label: Yield Stress
summaries: The stress required to initiate flow of a fluid; increasing yield value improves distribution and suspension stability of actives and particles.

nodes.label: Alginate Oligosaccharide
summaries: Oligoalginate of mannuronic and guluronic acid from Laminaria membrane acting as EGF cofactor to stimulate keratinocyte growth and speed wound healing; zinc-chelated form controls acne.

nodes.label: Alkanolamides
summaries: Nonionic amides from triglycerides and MEA/DEA; manage salt thickening, solubilize fragrance, stabilize foam; DEA disfavored for toxicology.

nodes.label: Ammonia
summaries: Highly volatile gas with odor and trigeminal response; at hair-color concentrations fragrance can barely mask it.
Alkalizer in permanent hair color that with H2O2 causes oxidative damage; absent in demi-permanent color.

nodes.label: Amphoteric Surfactants
summaries: Zwitterionic surfactants that change charge with pH (cationic at low pH, anionic at alkaline); used to increase mildness in shampoos.

nodes.label: Androgen
summaries: Male sex hormones (e.g., testosterone) of gonadal and adrenal origin that stimulate sebaceous gland activity.
Male hormones that convert vellus to terminal hair in beard/pubic regions but miniaturize frontal scalp follicles in predisposed individuals.

nodes.label: Aphthous Ulcer
summaries: Canker sores: painful 2-10 mm crater-like lesions on tongue and buccal mucosa lasting 5-10 days; autoimmune origin most supported.

nodes.label: Arachidonic Acid
summaries: Produced from cell membranes by phospholipase A2; oxidized into pro-inflammatory chemicals.

nodes.label: Ayurveda
summaries: Ancient Indian holistic medicine ('knowledge for long life') using plant-derived ingredients, treating cause not symptom with individualized therapy; ~1200 plants described.

nodes.label: Boswellic Acids
summaries: From Boswellia serrata gum resin (Boswellin CG); uniquely dual-inhibit 5-lipoxygenase and human leukocyte elastase; 1% under-eye cream reduced dark circles 86% in 4 weeks.

nodes.label: Botanical Extracts
summaries: Plant materials used for marketing or performance rather than odor, from any plant part and solvent; labeled per PCPC nomenclature.
Plant extracts evolved from crude traditional preparations into pure standardized extracts validated by cell and enzyme assays; fastest-developing natural cosmetics segment.

nodes.label: Bovine Spongiform Encephalopathy
summaries: 'Mad cow disease'; reason for US ban on prohibited cattle materials and Chinese BSE certificate requirement.
BSE crisis led cosmetics to abandon animal-derived ingredients, reviving interest in plants.

nodes.label: Caffeine
summaries: Xanthine that blocks phosphodiesterase, increasing cAMP to mobilize fat.
Adenosine antagonist delaying sleep onset; half-life about 4.9 hours.

nodes.label: Calcium
summaries: Regulates cytokeratin maturation, desmosomal adhesion, keratinocyte proliferation/differentiation and wound healing; bioavailability declines with aging.

nodes.label: Carbon Footprint
summaries: Emissions measure; local cultures can contribute to its reduction (chapter by Jean-Marc Seigneuret).

nodes.label: Cell Signaling
summaries: Communication via ligands binding receptors in three stages: reception, transduction and response; signals are endocrine, paracrine or autocrine.

nodes.label: Cellulose Derivatives
summaries: Chemically modified cellulose (cellulose gum, hydroxyethylcellulose, methylcellulose, hydroxypropylcellulose) with salt tolerance, surfactant compatibility and film-forming properties.

nodes.label: Editor's Introduction to the Ingredient Section
summaries: Editor's introduction to the 9th edition ingredient section. Highlights breakthrough technologies: biotech/fermentation (land to laboratory), plant stem cells, marine ingredients, skin whitening, and hyaluronic acid advances, with a focus on anti-aging needs of an aging population.

nodes.label: Clays
summaries: Natural minerals (bentonites, hectorites, magnesium aluminum silicates) used for viscosity, flow control, suspension and emulsion stability; form opaque dispersions and thrive on shear.

nodes.label: Coleus Oil
summaries: Supercritical CO2 extract of Coleus forskohlii rhizome; at 2% as effective as tea tree oil or clindamycin against P. acnes, S. aureus, S. epidermidis.

nodes.label: Dentinal Tubule
summaries: Tiny fluid-filled canals radiating from the pulp to the dentin surface; when open they cause hypersensitivity.

nodes.label: EP Class V (Mediterranean/Asian I)
summaries: Middle East and Central Asia origin; medium-dark olive; seldom burns; hyperpigmentation/melasma, PIH with acne; skin cancer rare; caution with deeper peels and laser.

nodes.label: EP Class VI (Asian II)
summaries: East and Southeast Asian origin; medium-dark yellow-olive; ages well; prone to hyperpigmentation, melasma and PIH; may react to retinoids and hydroquinone.

nodes.label: EP Class VII (Asian III)
summaries: South Asian origin (India, Pakistan, Bangladesh); light to dark olive with yellow undertones; rarely burns; hyperpigmentation, melasma, acne, PIH; sensitive to retinoids and hydroquinone; keloid tendency.

nodes.label: Essential Fatty Acids
summaries: Omega-3, -6 and -9 unsaturated fatty acids from seed/nut oils; aesthetic and restorative claims.
Hydrating nutrients included in the cellular water supplement regimen.

nodes.label: Esters
summaries: Most common lipstick ingredients; thousands possible from different acids and alcohols, from light penetrating to heavy pastes.

nodes.label: Ethoxylated Fatty Alcohols
summaries: Nonionic emulsifiers in creams, roll-ons and conditioners; low and high HLB variants (Steareth-2, Steareth-21, Laureth-23).

nodes.label: Ethyl Methicone
summaries: Methicone that strongly lowers surface tension of oils and esters; 1.5% in 28.5% soybean oil replaced 30% D5 in an antiperspirant stick; REACH polymer CAS 63148-54-9.

nodes.label: European Union
summaries: Market requiring labeling of 26 fragrance allergens above threshold levels on cosmetic ingredient labels.
Phased out animal testing for cosmetics, culminating in a 2013 marketing ban on animal-tested products; its Regulation 1223/2009 governs cosmetics.

nodes.label: Formaldehyde
summaries: Cross-linker used with hot irons in 'Brazilian' straightening for almost permanent shape change; potential carcinogen banned in cosmetic use.
Ingredient in some nail hardeners implicated in causing onycholysis.

nodes.label: Free Fatty Acids
summaries: Stratum corneum lipid component together with ceramides and cholesterol; synthesis rate-limited by acetyl-CoA carboxylase.
Major stratum corneum barrier lipid along with ceramides and cholesterol.

nodes.label: Free Radical Theory of Aging
summaries: Harman's 1956 theory that ROS cause cumulative oxidative damage driving aging; recent data, e.g. long-lived species with high oxidative damage, question its validity.
Most commonly held theory, proposed by Denham Harman in 1954: free radicals damage molecules causing DNA damage, protein cross-linking and age pigments.

nodes.label: Sustainable Bio-Based Manufacturing
summaries: Fermentation lowers CO2 emissions, uses renewable biomass waste, limits fossil fuels and pesticides, and prevents depletion of wild biomass.
Movement toward sustainable, renewable raw materials; silicone is commonly considered not green, so it is used at minimal levels.

nodes.label: Hyaluronan Degradation
summaries: Cleavage by enzymatic, free radical, thermal, ultrasonic, acid and alkaline methods; native HA has low enzymatic resistance and short half-life.

nodes.label: Hair Breakage
summaries: Fiber fracture associated with dryness, loss of sebum, chemical relaxer misuse and weak disulfide network.
Results from tensile strength loss after perming (75-95%) and bleaching (90%); mitigated by amino acid derivatives.

nodes.label: Hair Gel
summaries: Water-based styling product requiring water-soluble fragrance for clarity; key fragrance point is application.
Water-based pseudoplastic styling polymer formulation with high zero-shear yield stress; forms thick uniform seams for extreme styles.

nodes.label: Hair Tensile Strength
summaries: Measure of hair strength reduced by perming, bleaching and shampooing.

nodes.label: Hair Volume
summaries: Space occupied by a hair bundle beyond its nominal volume while fibers stay aligned in synchrony; created dynamically by water-setting in motion, friction, polymers, back-combing or static.

nodes.label: Health Canada
summaries: Canadian authority receiving Cosmetic Notification Forms, maintaining the ingredient hotlist and issuing 2011 working definition of nanomaterial.

nodes.label: Herboretum Network
summaries: Network promoting local cultures and biodiversity, subject of a chapter by Geneviève Bridenne.

nodes.label: Histone Acetyltransferase
summaries: HAT: acetylates histones opening chromatin for gene expression; HAT/HDAC imbalance drives aging.

nodes.label: Human Genome Project
summaries: Project that revolutionized molecular biology research; many current techniques and gene-interaction knowledge derive from it.
International project completed 2003 finding only ~20,500 genes (<2% of genome), revealing mutations too rare to explain disease and aging.

nodes.label: Hydrophobized Hyaluronan
summaries: HA modified with hydrophobic groups (e.g. 50 kDa HA with 50% hexyl groups) to enhance SC penetration; enhanced hydration comparably to 17 kDa HA; can form micro/nano vehicles.

nodes.label: Ichthyosis
summaries: Family of genetic disorders of dry scaling skin; ichthyosis vulgaris results from abnormal retention of keratinocytes and filaggrin mutations.
Genetic hyperkeratotic disorders with dry scaling skin; first AHA indication.

nodes.label: Chronic Inflammation in Aging Skin
summaries: Older skin has higher interleukin-1, interleukin-6 and TNF-alpha, creating a vicious cycle of inflammation, repair and itching in vulvar skin.

nodes.label: Innovation
summaries: Determined by the degree of consumer behavioral change required, not novelty; most new products are continuous innovations and 'hot' ingredients are merely popular.

nodes.label: Inter-Fiber Friction
summaries: Friction between hair fibers balancing bending forces; high friction or polymer welds fix shapes, low friction (silicones) lets fibers slip and recover permanent shape.

nodes.label: Intercellular Communication
summaries: Chemical messenger transfer between keratinocytes dependent on desmosomes and cytokeratins; loses efficiency with age.

nodes.label: Lamellar Body
summaries: Golgi-derived secretory organelle (0.1-0.5 micrometers) appearing in the stratum spinosum; secretes lipids, hydrolytic enzymes and antimicrobial peptides at the SG-SC interface; about 985 proteins identified.

nodes.label: Laser Treatment
summaries: Facial laser procedures requiring caution in olive and dark skin classes due to hyperpigmentation and keloid risk.

nodes.label: Linoleic Acid
summaries: Omega-6 unsaturated fatty acid found in seed and nut oils.
Omega-6 C18:2 fatty acid that decreases tyrosinase level and accelerates its degradation; QD for Sunstar 2001 at 0.1%.

nodes.label: Liposome
summaries: Phospholipid/cholesterol bilayer vesicle carrier for hydrophilic or lipophilic actives; five proposed mechanisms of SC penetration; conventional liposomes do not penetrate intact.
Vesicle encapsulation that protects photolyase activity and delivers it effectively.

nodes.label: Lysine
summaries: Amino acid positively charged at neutral pH, a major contributor to protein charge.
Essential amino acid needed for collagen; lysine-poor diets may increase wrinkles.

nodes.label: Maltobionic Acid
summaries: Bionic acid of gluconic acid linked to glucose; increased cell turnover 82% in eight days, reduces lipid peroxidation, nonirritating at 20%.

nodes.label: Marketing Mix (Four P's)
summaries: The 'Original Four' P's - Product, Price, Place and Promotion strategies - that form the foundation of the marketing program, tailored to market segments.

nodes.label: Mascara
summaries: Eye product; CU limits pH 5.5-8.5 and stricter microbiology (<=10^2 CFU/g).
Often stored in hot conditions (purse, car) promoting spoilage.
Pigmented product relying on suspending agents; organoclays and trihydroxystearin control flow.

nodes.label: Mast Cell
summaries: Immune cell found in the epidermis and dermis.
Mesenchymal dermal cell with heparin and histamine granules; active participant in inflammation and irritation.

nodes.label: Matrikines
summaries: Signal peptides released by enzymatic degradation of ECM proteins that act as cell messengers in wound healing and tissue repair; natural and cryptic classes.

nodes.label: MicroRNA Biogenesis
summaries: Multi-step pathway: transcription to pri-miR, Drosha-DGCR8 microprocessor cleavage to pre-miR, Exportin-5 export, DICER1/TRBP processing to a duplex and loading into RISC.

nodes.label: Nail Polish
summaries: Pigments in solvents applied to nails; nail polishing dates to 3000 BC in China; repeated use of polish and removers linked to splitting and discoloration.
Requires flow properties so brush marks disappear; organoclays suspend pigments.

nodes.label: Natural Isolates
summaries: Single components removed from essential oils by crystallization or fractional distillation without chemical transformation, e.g. menthol from peppermint oil.

nodes.label: Newtonian Fluid
summaries: Fluid whose shear stress/shear rate ratio is constant; polydimethylsiloxane is an example; preferred flow for cleansers.

nodes.label: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
summaries: Publishes validated test guidelines; OECD-validated alternative tests accepted in EU.

nodes.label: Open Innovation for Sustainability
summaries: Application of open innovation to sustainability goals; OIS companies collaborate with competitors and NGOs, embrace transparency and share green IP, adopting a more complete OI model.

nodes.label: Organoclays
summaries: Reaction products of hydrophilic clays with long-chain quaternary compounds (e.g., quaternium-18 hectorite); highly thixotropic, the first choice to thicken oil-based systems.

nodes.label: Perfumer
summaries: Specialist trained 5-10 years by apprenticeship who commits up to 3,000 raw materials to olfactive memory and composes fragrances, typically using 5-15 trials per new fragrance.

nodes.label: pH Value
summaries: Physicochemical parameter specified by CU per category: facial/body cream 5.0-9.0, liquid mascara 5.5-8.5; 33 pH categories.

nodes.label: Photolyase
summaries: DNA repair enzyme (EC 4.1.99.3) from Anacystis nidulans activated by visible light; 1% liposomal photolyase reduced UV dimers by 45% in one hour.

nodes.label: Phytosteryl/Octyldodecyl Lauroyl Glutamate
summaries: Amino acid-derived emollient; 0.5% in shampoo restored bleached hair tensile strength to 95% and wets UV pigments.

nodes.label: Plant Stem Cell
summaries: Meristem cells maintaining totipotency; cultured callus and suspension cells resemble undifferentiated meristem cells.
Cultured plant cell extracts (apple, jasmine, lilac); distinct from extracts of plant stems.

nodes.label: Protein Cross-Linking
summaries: Formation of abnormal bonds between proteins that reduce mobility and elasticity; cross-linking of collagen responsible for wrinkling.

nodes.label: Pyrimidine Dimer
summaries: DNA lesion formed between adjacent pyrimidines by direct UVB absorption, producing UVB signature mutations.
CPDs: most common UV DNA lesions forming at methylation sites; major source of sunlight mutations.

nodes.label: Rainforest Ingredients
summaries: Exotic ingredients from Amazon, Africa and Asia (copaiba balsam, andiroba oil, dragon's blood, açai butter, buriti oil, maracuja oil) adding moisturization, emolliency and shine.
