nodes.label: Salicylic Acid
summaries: KSA limits: active <=3% in rinse-off hair products, <=2% elsewhere; preservative <0.5%.
Basis of beta hydroxy acid products, usually about 2%.
Natural-source preservative on all positive lists showing excellent results in aqueous systems and emulsions.

nodes.label: Silicone Resins
summaries: Heavily cross-linked silicones with no Si-O-Si rotation forming non-rubbery films; include MQ and MDQ resins.

nodes.label: Sleep Deprivation
summaries: Contributes to adverse skin effects; sleep resets metabolism, repairs damaged cells and clears waste.

nodes.label: Sorbitan Esters
summaries: Sorbitol + fatty acids; low HLB emulsifiers; can form liquid crystals; first nonionics (1930s).

nodes.label: Stability Testing
summaries: Testing of a formula (shelf-aging stability, rapid aging, freeze-thaw, light exposure) until results are satisfactory and the formula is robust under foreseeable conditions.

nodes.label: Stannous Fluoride
summaries: Fluoride source that also reduces gingivitis, blocks dentinal tubules, and helps control malodor.

nodes.label: Stratum Corneum Turnover
summaries: SC renewal time, measured by dansyl chloride, increases from 19.8 days (under 35) to 28.1 days (over 60) due to decreased epidermal proliferation.

nodes.label: Streptococcus Mutans
summaries: Acidogenic, acid-tolerant cariogenic plaque bacterium identified as a specific caries pathogen.

nodes.label: Sulforaphane
summaries: Broccoli component found effective via the Nrf2 pathway.
Cruciferous isothiocyanate decreasing DNMTs, inhibiting HDACs, regulating Nrf2 and boosting phase II enzymes.

nodes.label: Telomerase
summaries: Enzyme that maintains and rebuilds telomeres; found in germ and cancer cells; telomerase inhibitors may stop cancer cell division.

nodes.label: Thixotropy
summaries: Shear thinning with delayed recovery: viscosity decreases under shear and recovers only over time after shear is removed.

nodes.label: Dental Staining
summaries: Intrinsic (within tooth) or extrinsic (chromogens from tea, coffee, tobacco, metal ions) tooth discoloration of cosmetic concern.

nodes.label: Traditional Herbal Knowledge
summaries: Asian (Indian, Chinese) traditional remedies passed orally; documentation safeguards sovereignty against patenting of nonoriginal innovations.
Indigenous knowledge of plant uses (anti-inflammatory, cleansing, sunscreens, wound healing) guiding discovery; must be truthfully represented in marketing.

nodes.label: Triclosan
summaries: Antimicrobial not permitted at any concentration in KSA cosmetics.
Antimicrobial clinically demonstrated to reduce gingivitis and useful for oral malodor.

nodes.label: Ubiquitin-Proteasome Pathway
summaries: Major intracellular protein degradation system: E1, E2, E3 enzymes tag proteins with ubiquitin for proteasome degradation; controls cell division, signaling, gene regulation.

nodes.label: United States
summaries: Market where cosmetic law (since 1938) rests on the responsibility of the firm placing products on the market, with postmarket verification rather than premarket approval.
Diverse country: 2010 census 308.7 million, 63.7% White non-Hispanic single race, 16.3% Hispanic, 12.2% Black, 4.7% Asian.

nodes.label: Ursolic Acid
summaries: Pentacyclic triterpenoid from Salvia officinalis; anti-inflammatory; liposomal form increases ceramides and collagen; improves collagen bundles and wrinkles; use 1-5%.

nodes.label: Utility Model
summaries: 'Patent-lite' in China, Japan, Korea and others; lower inventive step, little examination, about 10 years; not in US.

nodes.label: Utility Patent
summaries: Most common patent covering products, processes, product-by-process or new uses (e.g., birch bark extract to reduce wrinkles); 20-year term, about 40% acceptance rate.

nodes.label: Verbascoside
summaries: Phenylpropanoid glycoside (acteoside) containing caffeic acid and hydroxytyrosol; inhibits NF-kB, COX-2, iNOS and activates Nrf2; produced by Syringa vulgaris, Buddleja davidii cell cultures; used for lightening.

nodes.label: Water Plasticization of Hair
summaries: Water acts as the natural plasticizer of hair proteins, softening the gel structure of the amorphous phase so less force is needed to deform moist hair.

nodes.label: Water-Soluble Fragrance
summaries: 'WS' fragrance pre-solubilized in surfactant (typically 70-80% polysorbate) for clear water-based products like hair gel; only 20-30% provides odor.

nodes.label: Zeodration
summaries: Vacuum drying at <=40 C where water vapor is adsorbed onto 4-angstrom zeolites, whose exothermic reaction heats the product; low energy, no refrigerants, yields native carrier-free extracts.

nodes.label: Zinc Oxide
summaries: Certification-exempt color additive (21 CFR 73.2991); restricted in KSA below 25% unless for a medical condition (then a drug).

nodes.label: Absolutes
summaries: Ethanol extract of a concrete with waxes removed (or supercritical CO2 extract); used as touch ingredients at 0.001-0.100% for rich odor value.

nodes.label: Acetyl Hexapeptide-3 (Argireline)
summaries: SNAP-25-derived neurotransmitter-inhibiting peptide with Botox-like effect via SNARE inhibition; anti-wrinkle.

nodes.label: Adipocyte
summaries: Fat cells whose excessive volume causes cellulite.
Fat cell; adipocyte size reduced by Laminaria extract; cellulite fat lobules are larger in females.
Hypodermal white adipose cells storing energy in lipid droplets; differentiation regulated by microRNAs.

nodes.label: Alpha-to-Beta Keratin Transition
summaries: Unfolding of alpha-helical keratin into the beta configuration at 2-35% strain (yield region); reversible when mechanical, usually irreversible when caused by heat or chemicals.

nodes.label: Alpha Keratin
summaries: Soft keratin with alpha-helical structure found in hair, nails, skin and wool; unfolds to beta configuration at 2-35% strain.

nodes.label: AMPS Polymers
summaries: Modified sulfonic acid (acrylamido-2,2-dimethyl propane sulfonic acid) cross-linked polymers with a permanent pH-independent negative charge that swell in water.

nodes.label: Antimicrobials
summaries: Compounds controlling microbes; Ayurvedic botanicals can serve as natural preservatives.

nodes.label: ASE/HASE Polymers
summaries: Alkali-swellable emulsion and hydrophobically modified alkali-swellable emulsion polymers of methacrylic acid and alkyl acrylates, supplied as low-viscosity latex that thickens upon neutralization.

nodes.label: Nanomaterial Assay Interference
summaries: Nanomaterials interfere with optical readouts, dyes, ROS measurement and adsorb nutrients/cytokines, causing false positives or negatives.

nodes.label: ATP
summaries: Adenosine triphosphate, the chemical energy store common to all organisms.
Cellular energy; decreased in keratinocytes after UVB.

nodes.label: Avocado Pulp Peptide Complex
summaries: Stimulates collagen I and elastin, inhibits MMP1, activates LOX/LOXL, antioxidant, increases proteasome expression.

nodes.label: Base Notes
summaries: Longest-lasting, least volatile and most expensive notes (musks, woods, amber, heavy florals) that support and round a fragrance.

nodes.label: Bentonite
summaries: Clay pre-dispersed in solvent as master gel; reduces molecular movement and sweating in lipsticks; rheology control.
Clay based on aluminum silicate; darker than hectorite.

nodes.label: Biodiversity
summaries: Reservoir of plant molecules for cosmetics; over 300,000 flowering plant species with ~70,000 undiscovered; protecting it is life insurance for humanity and industry.

nodes.label: Bionic Acids
summaries: Third-generation AHAs (aldobionic acids): a monosaccharide linked to an aldonic acid; ~358 Da; very hygroscopic, antioxidant, metal chelating and MMP-inhibiting.

nodes.label: Craniofacial Bone Remodeling
summaries: New bone deposition at sutures, cheekbones and mandible supporting skin, reducing wrinkles, sagging and dark circles.

nodes.label: Carboxymethyl-Lysine
summaries: CML: typical AGE; collagen contains three times more CML at age 80 than 20; UV oxidation accelerates CML in actinic elastosis.

nodes.label: Cell-Based Assay
summaries: Assay using lab cells expressing ORs as miniaturized detectors; reliability depends on mimicking native receptor physiology; typically measures calcium influx with fluorogenic dyes.

nodes.label: Cellular Dehydration
summaries: Progressive loss of intracellular water with accumulation of dry mass; increases free radical damage efficiency and slows enzymes; final common pathway of aging.

nodes.label: Chlorogenic Acid
summaries: Ester of caffeic and quinic acids; inhibits NF-kB and AP-1, activates Nrf2, decreases chemical carcinogenesis in animal models.

nodes.label: Circadian Desynchronization
summaries: Loss of synchrony of clock genes with earth's cycle due to stress, aging, shift work; induces genome instability, premature aging, cancer, obesity, diabetes.

nodes.label: Clock Genes
summaries: Peripheral molecular clocks present in nearly all cells (period, clock, cycle, timeless); expressed in human skin cells (shown 2000).

nodes.label: CMR Substances
aliases: carcinogenic, mutagenic or toxic for reproduction
summaries: Carcinogenic, mutagenic or reprotoxic substances per Regulation 1272/2008; category 2 banned unless SCCS-approved; 1A/1B banned except strict conditions.

nodes.label: Concretes
summaries: Natural extracts obtained by hydrophobic-solvent extraction of plants, containing essential oil plus waxes; very expensive touch ingredients.

nodes.label: Copper Tripeptide (GHK-Cu)
summaries: Gly-His-Lys tripeptide identified in human plasma in the 1970s with high Cu2+ affinity; signaling and copper carrier peptide shown to stimulate wound healing and reduce fine lines and wrinkles.

nodes.label: Corneodesmosomes
summaries: Desmosomes at SC level broken by enzymes to favor desquamation.
Proteins binding corneocytes; AHAs degrade them to decrease cohesion and enhance desquamation.

nodes.label: Cornified Envelope
summaries: Rigid, chemically resistant cross-linked protein band with covalently bound omega-hydroxyceramide lipid layer replacing the corneocyte plasma membrane.
Protein-lipid structure of corneocytes attached to keratin scaffold.

nodes.label: China Cosmetic Product Registration
summaries: CFDA premarket registration required for all imported cosmetics and domestic special-use products, with dossier in simplified Chinese, MOH-accredited lab testing, free sale certificate and BSE certificate; may take months or years.

nodes.label: Lipstick Crystalline Structure
summaries: Strong wax crystalline matrix needed for stick strength; excessive pigment loading turns it amorphous and breaks at cup line.

nodes.label: Cuticle Cell
summaries: Flat layered cells ~0.5 µm thick stacked 5-11 deep around the cortex; layers are F-layer (18-MEA), epicuticle, exocuticle, endocuticle and CMC; behavior is viscoelastic and moisture sensitive.

nodes.label: Dandruff
summaries: Scalp flaking most common with oily scalps; managed with anti-dandruff shampoos.
Scalp condition caused primarily by Malassezia furfur.

nodes.label: Demineralization
summaries: Dissolution of tooth mineral by acid when plaque pH falls below the critical pH.

nodes.label: Dermatitis
summaries: Skin inflammation that WWII home-front toilet soaps and barrier creams were developed to reduce.
Frequency and severity increased in clock-deficient models.

nodes.label: DICER1
summaries: Cytoplasmic RNase III that processes pre-microRNAs into 20-25 nt duplexes; its knockout in mouse skin disrupts epidermal and hair follicle morphogenesis and causes premature senescence.

nodes.label: Differential Scanning Calorimetry
summaries: DSC detects the hair crystalline melting endotherm and denaturation enthalpy, which drops 30-50% after alkaline relaxers.
DSC estimates non-freezable bound, freezable bound and free water around HA; 650 kDa HA binds 7.6 non-freezable and up to 43 freezable water per disaccharide.

nodes.label: Dipropylene Glycol
summaries: Common fragrance carrier with the most water solubility of common carriers; poorly soluble in bath oils and silicones, forming a second phase in bath oil.

nodes.label: DPPH Assay
summaries: Free radical scavenging measured by absorbance decrease of DPPH radicals at 516 nm.

nodes.label: ELISA
summaries: Inflammatory cytokine assay; metal oxide nanoparticles adsorb cytokines giving false negatives.
Monitors defensin levels in epithelial cultures before/after test candidates; semi-quantitative.

nodes.label: Epigenetic Drift
summaries: Progressive deregulation of epigenetic marks with age, exacerbated by UV, smoking, stress, diet, alcohol; visible in twin studies.

nodes.label: EU 26 Fragrance Allergens
summaries: EU mandate, based on SCCNFP opinion, that any of 26 dermal allergens present above set levels in a finished product be listed on the ingredient label.

nodes.label: Exopolysaccharides
summaries: High-MW sugar polymers secreted by marine microorganisms with no land equivalent; used as line fillers, mattifiers, sebum absorbers and exfoliants.

nodes.label: Eye Irritation
summaries: Anionics can cause eye irritation; reduced by carboxylates and polysorbates.
Ocular irritation scored on the Draize scale; lower-MW dimethicone copolyols penetrate the eye and irritate more.

nodes.label: Fibronectin
summaries: ECM glycoprotein binding integrins and collagen.

nodes.label: Foam
summaries: Dispersion of gas in a small volume of liquid; anionics give highest foam; no physical role in cleansing but a key consumer cue of luxury.

nodes.label: Four-Quadrant Model
summaries: Wilber-based framework of subjective/objective individual and cultural/societal quadrants explaining consumer response to product degradation and regulation.

nodes.label: Fragrance Allergen Labeling
summaries: EU requirement to label 26 allergens (Annex III 67-92) above 0.001% in leave-on and 0.01% in rinse-off products.

nodes.label: Fragrance Evaluator
summaries: Translates the client's request into an olfactive structure, guides perfumers on trends and impartially critiques creations; likened to a food critic or golf caddy and represents the marketer.

nodes.label: Fragrance Note (Accord)
summaries: A note or accord is an odor character, almost a mini-fragrance, composed of about 2-20 materials each contributing a facet; fragrances combine several accords.

nodes.label: Fragrance Pyramid
summaries: Industry-standard diagram representing a fragrance's top, middle and base note characters.

nodes.label: G-Protein-Coupled Receptor
summaries: Receptor that activates or inhibits an enzyme generating a second messenger or modulates an ion channel.
Class of membrane proteins localized in outer cell membranes; odorant receptors are GPCRs whose activation causes calcium influx.

nodes.label: Gulf Cooperation Council
summaries: Regional bloc of Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, UAE, Qatar, Bahrain and Oman; GSO standards apply across it; also a regional patent organization.

nodes.label: Glass Transition Temperature
summaries: Temperature at which a hard amorphous polymer softens; hair Tg ~144°C relates to the amorphous matrix, and styling polymer Tg governs hold versus flaking.

nodes.label: Glutamic Acid
summaries: Amino acid that can be acylated into acyl glutamate surfactants, esterified into emollients or cyclized into PCA humectant.

nodes.label: Glutaminylglutamine Amide Derivatives
summaries: Gupta-Walker osmoprotective anti-senescence peptide derivatives for topical skin anti-aging; formulated at pH 4.5-6.5.

nodes.label: Glyoxalase
summaries: Glyoxalase-1 and -2 enzyme system detoxifying glyoxal/MGO via glutathione; overexpression extends diabetic animal lifespan; reduced by glycation.

nodes.label: Good Manufacturing Practice
summaries: Manufacturing quality rules; mandatory for US drugs (21 CFR 210/211) but only guidelines for US cosmetics; mandatory in EU via ISO 22716 (Art. 8).
GMP standards for all products; suspension cell cultures are more GMP-compliant.

nodes.label: FEMA GRAS
summaries: Flavor and Extract Manufacturers Association 'Generally Recognized as Safe' flavor designation required for each material in GRAS fragrances.
Safety status that libraries of natural ingredients with history of human consumption and kitchen-like treatments could leverage to facilitate sensory studies.
Generally Recognized as Safe; most sweeteners, flavorings and maskants in lip products are GRAS.

nodes.label: Guinea Pig Maximization Test
summaries: Animal skin sensitization test (GPMT), prohibited in the EU but the only sensitization method accepted by China FDA.

nodes.label: Hyaluronan Chemical Modification
summaries: Attaching pendant groups (via carboxyl, hydroxyl or amino) or cross-linking to improve enzymatic resistance, robustness and skin binding; degradation inevitable.

nodes.label: Hyaluronan Cross-Linking
summaries: Forms insoluble HA hydrogels with longer residence and robustness; most commercial HA products are cross-linked (e.g. divinyl sulfone in Juvederm).

nodes.label: Hair Follicle Bulge
summaries: Region in the lower isthmus/ORS at the arrector pili insertion below the sebaceous gland harboring the follicle stem cell and melanocyte reservoir.

nodes.label: Hair Melting Temperature
summaries: Melting/denaturation temperature of hair's crystalline keratin phase, Tm ~156°C, detected as an endothermic DSC peak.

nodes.label: Hair Roughness
summaries: Measured by sensory and dynamic friction coefficient; reduced by sodium PCA and arginine.

nodes.label: Hydroxyapatite
summaries: Calcium phosphate mineral making up ~98% of enamel and ~70% of dentin; capable of ion exchange with F-, CO3 2-, Zn2+, Sr2+, Mg2+.

nodes.label: Hyperosmolarity
summaries: Above 300 mOsm induces secretion of IL-8, IL-6, IL-1beta, TNF-alpha via PP2A methylation shift activating NF-kB.

nodes.label: Hypopigmentation
summaries: Loss of pigment when melanocytes no longer function; from overbleaching or trauma from UV, lasers or heat; includes vitiligo and albinism.

nodes.label: India
summaries: Indian patent law excludes cosmetic surgery methods and mere new forms/uses of known substances; has pre- and post-grant opposition; source of TKDL.
Cosmetics industry expected to reach US$3.6 billion by 2014; skin-lightening cream market US$432 million in 2010 growing 18% annually; fair skin rooted in culture and caste.

nodes.label: Integrins
summaries: Transmembrane cell-matrix adhesion receptors also involved in signaling.
Cell-surface receptors mediating ECM signaling; RGD peptides target integrin receptors.

nodes.label: ISO 22716 Cosmetics GMP
summaries: International GMP standard for cosmetics (2007), mandatory under EU Regulation 1223/2009 Art. 8; structure similar to ISO 9001.

nodes.label: Isopropyl Myristate
summaries: Very hydrophobic fragrance carrier that works in oils and silicones and yields homogeneous bath oil, but may not suit sulfate-free shampoo.

nodes.label: Lauric Acid
summaries: Principal fatty acid of coconut oil triglycerides.
C12:0 fatty acid; one of the most notable antimicrobial fatty acids released from sebum.

nodes.label: Lead
summaries: Heavy-metal impurity detected by FDA in some makeup; CU limit 5.0 mg/kg in products with over 1% natural raw materials.

nodes.label: Licorice Extract
summaries: Natural alternative to hydroquinone for hyperpigmentation.
Plant extract containing glabridin used in many Asian whitening products.

nodes.label: Lipid Peroxidation
summaries: Oxidation of lipids initiated by singlet oxygen and hydroxyl radicals.

nodes.label: Local Cultivation
summaries: Growing plant biomass close to processing facilities to reduce transport and carbon footprint; cultivated plants preferred over wild for identity, safety and sustainability.

nodes.label: Local Lymph Node Assay
summaries: Skin sensitization assay (LLNA) recommended under the 3R principle but not accepted by CFDA at the time.
LLNA test negative for delayed dermal sensitization of the lash ingredient.

nodes.label: Malodor Masking
summaries: Fragrance's role of covering the base odor of a product; limited for highly volatile gases with higher vapor pressure than fragrance materials.

nodes.label: Maltodextrin
summaries: Carrier used in spray drying that dilutes actives and adds sugars.
Low-molecular-weight glucose polymer derived from starch that improves body, play time and dispersibility without greatly increasing viscosity; also humectant.

nodes.label: Uttwiler Spatlauber Apple Stem Cell Extract
summaries: Swiss apple stem cell extract; 2% delayed senescence in H2O2-treated fibroblasts, prolonged hair follicle growth phase by 4 days and reduced wrinkles in two weeks.

nodes.label: Marine Polysaccharides
summaries: High-MW sugar polymers from algae that retain moisture and form a second skin reducing water loss; can be hydrolyzed into bioactive oligosaccharides.

nodes.label: Market Research
summaries: Surveys, focus groups and other methodologies used to assess consumer needs; intensive market research greatly reduces the marketer's risk.

nodes.label: Matrix Keratinocyte
summaries: Proliferating keratinocytes of the bulb matrix that move upward and differentiate into the hair shaft and inner root sheath.

nodes.label: Hair Medulla
summaries: Low-density porous central region of large cuboidal air-filled cells, discontinuous and present mostly in thicker hair; may aid thermal insulation and affects optical properties.

nodes.label: Mineral Oil
summaries: Petroleum-based product that can interfere with condom use and is best avoided.
Hydrocarbon that feels dry with little slip; occlusive and moisturizing but adds little aesthetics; many formulators avoid it.

nodes.label: miR-145
summaries: MicroRNA whose increased expression targets Sox9, Mitf, Tyr, Trp1 and melanosome-transport genes, inducing depigmentation.

nodes.label: miR-34a
summaries: Tumor-suppressor senescence-associated microRNA up-regulated in replicative and H2O2-induced senescence; targets SIRT1 and E2F3.

nodes.label: Molecular Chaperones
summaries: Protein families that stabilize, unfold or assist folding of proteins; part of the cytoprotective stress pathway.
Proteins that attenuate ubiquitinated protein accumulation; proposed for skin aging, inflammation and wound healing.

nodes.label: N-Acetyl Amino Acids
summaries: Amino acid derivatives structurally analogous to AHAs; e.g., N-acetylcysteine, N-acetylhydroxyproline, N-acetyltyrosinamide.

nodes.label: Natural Gums
summaries: Agricultural polysaccharide thickeners (carrageenan, xanthan, guar, tragacanth, locust bean, karaya, alginates); variable, possible microbial contamination, but pH-stable and salt tolerant.

nodes.label: Neem
summaries: Azadirachta indica; over 100 actives purified; antimicrobial against S. aureus, E. coli, P. aeruginosa, C. albicans, A. niger; used in oral care.

nodes.label: Neonatal Dermal Fibroblast Conditioned Media
summaries: Neonatal fibroblasts secrete over 110 growth factors, cytokines and matrix proteins; decreased wrinkles and increased epidermal thickness lasting 3 months after stopping.

nodes.label: Non-Timber Forest Product
summaries: Fruits, nuts, latexes and other forest products; sustainable harvest levels poorly known for most.

nodes.label: Noncoding RNAs
summaries: RNAs transcribed from noncoding DNA (about 43% of noncoding DNA is transcribed), including siRNAs, miRNAs, piRNAs, snoRNAs and lncRNAs.
miRNA, siRNA, piRNA and lncRNA epigenetic regulators; a novel ncRNA binds DNMT1 preventing CEBPA methylation.

nodes.label: Nonmelanoma Skin Cancer
summaries: Most common cancer (about one million new US cases yearly), increasing with cumulative sun exposure; includes BCC and SCC.

nodes.label: Nucleotide Excision Repair
summaries: DNA repair system whose capacity declines with age.
NER corrects complex damage such as UV-induced cyclobutane pyrimidine dimers.

nodes.label: Odor Detection Threshold
summaries: Minimum air concentration at which a material becomes perceivable; food and decay odors have low thresholds, survival-neutral florals and woods higher ones.

nodes.label: Onychomycosis
summaries: Fungal nail infection, the most common nail condition; four types: distal subungual (most common), superficial white, proximal subungual and candidal.

nodes.label: Ortho-Cortical Cell
summaries: Cortical cell type absorbing less moisture than para cells; the higher the ortho content the curlier the hair.

nodes.label: Outer Root Sheath
summaries: Outermost follicle layer continuous with the epidermal basal layer, generated directly from the bulge; source of VEGF.

nodes.label: PEG-8 Dimethicone
summaries: Dimethicone copolyol that lowers water surface tension below 30 dynes/cm; low-MW versions more efficient in SLS/SLES systems (RF50 1.2%).

nodes.label: PER Genes
summaries: Period genes (PER1-3), first clock gene identified 1971 in flies; PER protein peaks early evening; PER1 and PER2 are tumor suppressors.

nodes.label: Perceived Hair Dryness
summaries: Subjective dryness linked more to cuticle surface roughness than to lack of cortical moisture; swatches at high RH scored higher dryness.

nodes.label: Peroxisome
summaries: Vesicle containing catalase and oxidative enzymes that breaks down toxic hydrogen peroxide and digests fatty acids.
Organelle for hydrogen peroxide metabolism and fatty acid beta-oxidation; its ROS are major contributors to oxidative stress and aging.

nodes.label: Phase Angle
summaries: Arctangent of reactance/resistance; indicator of cell vitality and membrane integrity; decreases with age; 65% of 40 supplemented patients showed increase.

nodes.label: Phase Separation
summaries: Physical instability where a product splits into layers (e.g. freeze-thaw) or pearlizers separate; may be solved by changing fragrance carrier.

nodes.label: Phosphate Esters
summaries: Anionics made by phosphation of alcohols; emulsifiers in sunscreens, stable over wider pH than soap; rich lubricious foams.

nodes.label: Plasma Membrane
summaries: Membrane enclosing each cell containing receptor and transport proteins that let the cell interact with its environment.
Cell membrane that suffers cumulative structural and functional damage with age per the membrane hypothesis.

nodes.label: Pollution
summaries: Sulfuric acid (exhaust, industrial smoke) and nicotine (tobacco) degrade epidermal junctions and cause premature aging.

nodes.label: Pro-Oxidant Activity
summaries: Antioxidants like vitamin C, E, glutathione and carotenoids can act as pro-oxidants especially with transition metals; vitamin C's pro-oxidant action helps convert proline to hydroxyproline.

nodes.label: Probiotic Derived Bioactive
summaries: Isolated ingredient from a probiotic organism shown to be bioactive (immune-stimulating, anti-inflammatory); INCI names end in ferment, extract or lysate.

nodes.label: Processed Skin-Cell Proteins
summaries: PSP from cultured fetal dermal fibroblasts with >100 growth factors and cytokines; reduced periorbital/perioral wrinkles and dark circles.

nodes.label: New Product Failure
summaries: About 80-90% of new products fail to meet expectations and are deleted within a few years, often due to poor cross-functional cooperation and lack of market research.

nodes.label: Progeria
summaries: Premature aging syndrome caused by lamin A mutations.
Devastating premature aging disease from LMNA point mutation.

nodes.label: Propionibacterium acnes
summaries: Bacterium involved in acne pathogenesis; topical retinoids do not directly reduce its counts.

nodes.label: Pseudoplasticity
summaries: Shear thinning with immediate recovery when shear is removed; shown by xanthan and guar gums, carbomers, cellulosics, clays and silicas.

nodes.label: Quercetin
summaries: Polyphenolic associated with Nrf2 activation; protects keratinocytes from UVA via Nrf2.

nodes.label: Red Rice Meristem Extract
summaries: Red rice callus culture extract influencing epigenetic aging factors, improving procollagen-1 and dermatopontin expression in vitro.

nodes.label: Rheology
summaries: Applied rheology, the study of flow and deformation of materials, listed among the Editor-in-Chief's areas of technical expertise.
Viscosity measurement with rotational (concentric cylinder, cone-and-plate, parallel plate, Brookfield) and oscillatory rheometers yielding G', G'' and tan δ; requires ±1 °C temperature control.

nodes.label: Rinse-Off Product
summaries: Product category (e.g. shampoo, body wash) evaluated at bloom, rinse and dry stages; bloom is usually the key evaluation point.

nodes.label: Russia
summaries: Dynamic cosmetics market with demand growing 5%+ per year (possibly over 15% until 2015); joined WTO in 2012, reducing import duties.

nodes.label: Saccharomyces cerevisiae
summaries: Brewers' yeast, arguably probiotic; yeast cell walls source of beta-glucans.

nodes.label: Saliva
summaries: Produced by three pairs of major glands and minor glands; lubricates, clears harmful materials, buffers via bicarbonate and maintains tooth mineral balance; resting pH 6.5-7.2.

nodes.label: Secondary Antioxidants
summaries: Slow oxidation by chelating metals, quenching singlet oxygen or scavenging oxygen; best combined with primary antioxidants.

nodes.label: Sensory Cues
summaries: Cues through bottle, packaging, color and scent that set consumer expectations and communicate olfactive character and emotional story.

nodes.label: Silicone Copolyols
summaries: Dimethicone with EO/PO added; powerful W/Si and W/O emulsifiers for foundations and sunscreens.

nodes.label: SIRT4
summaries: Mitochondrial sirtuin upregulated by caloric restriction; inhibits glutamate dehydrogenase by ADP-ribosylation, reducing ATP; inversely expressed to SIRT3.

nodes.label: Sodium Chloride
summaries: Common salt used to thicken anionic surfactant systems; viscosity rises to a peak then falls (salt curve).

nodes.label: Sodium Lauroyl Glutamate
summaries: Acyl glutamate anionic surfactant; 10% wash removes only 52% amino acids and 39% PCA vs 62%/56% for SLES and 70%/62% for soap.

nodes.label: Starch Derivatives
summaries: Modified starch polymers that build short-textured thixotropic viscosity, stabilize emulsions, prevent syneresis, improve foam and film formation, and are stable to pH, shear, temperature and freeze/thaw.

nodes.label: Stratum Granulosum
summaries: Granular layer containing keratohyalin granules and abundant lamellar bodies (about 20% of cell volume in uppermost cells); 1 to 10 cell layers thick.

nodes.label: Sugar Esters of Fatty Acids
summaries: Sucrose reacted with fatty acids (sucrose distearate, palmitate, cocoate); natural, approved food additives; reduce water loss and aid lip adhesion.

nodes.label: Sulfates
summaries: Anionics made by sulfating alcohols or alcohol ethoxylates; outstanding foam; ethoxylation decreases irritation and foam.

nodes.label: Supercritical CO2 Extraction
summaries: Extraction of plants with supercritical carbon dioxide yielding absolutes of extremely faithful odor quality.
CO2 above 31°C and 74 bar behaves as gas and liquid; extracts nonpolar compounds from oils/oleoresins; expensive; used for coleus oil.

nodes.label: Suprachiasmatic Nucleus
summaries: Master clock in the hypothalamus (~20,000 neurons) receiving light cues via the retina and synchronizing peripheral clocks.

nodes.label: Synthetic Fragrance Materials
summaries: Fragrance materials made by chemical reaction (from crude sulfate turpentine, petroleum or plant molecules); the majority of materials, well characterized, plentiful, cost-stable and not seasonal.

nodes.label: Telangiectasia
summaries: Visible surface blood vessels developing with age from dermal thinning or chronic sun exposure; associated with smoking.

nodes.label: Terminal Differentiation
summaries: Three-to-four-week conversion of basal keratinocytes into flat corneocytes involving keratin formation, lipid processing, water loss (80-85% to about 35%), and envelope cross-linking.

nodes.label: Tight Junction
summaries: Cell junctions crucial for the epidermal permeability barrier; Langerhans cells extend dendrites through them.
Second skin barrier in stratum granulosum; claudin-1 and claudin-4 key to barrier; strengthened by beta-catenin.

nodes.label: Tooth
summaries: Divided into enamel-covered crown and cementum-covered root held by periodontal ligaments; humans have 20 primary and 32 secondary teeth.

nodes.label: Tooth Whitening
summaries: Removal of stain by abrasives or bleaching with peroxides or chlorine compounds; peroxide oral products not permitted in Canada.

nodes.label: Trade Secret Protection
summaries: Protection of secret valuable information (formulas, processes, customer lists) without registration or time limit while kept secret; no protection against independent development or reverse engineering.

nodes.label: Tranexamic Acid
summaries: Drug for melasma that inhibits UV-induced hyperpigmentation by preventing plasminogen binding to keratinocytes; QD for Shiseido 2002.

nodes.label: Transcription Factors
summaries: DNA-binding proteins that switch genes on or off by promoting or blocking transcription; mutations are linked to diabetes, autoimmunity and cancer.

nodes.label: Transparency
summaries: Full disclosure of ingredients, packaging and partners and external auditing; required by both sustainability and open innovation.

nodes.label: Triphala
summaries: Ayurvedic blend of Haritaki (Terminalia chebula), Bibhitaka (Terminalia belerica) and Amalaki; tonic to control microbial infection.

nodes.label: United States Patent and Trademark Office
summaries: US office examining patents and trademarks; PAIR system gives access to file wrappers.

nodes.label: Vulva
summaries: Externally visible female genital region composed of mons veneris, labia majora, labia minora and clitoris; richly vascular like the face.

nodes.label: Xanthan Gum
summaries: Natural gum that is a good example of a pseudoplastic rheology modifier; synergistic with aluminum magnesium silicate.
Natural pH-stable thickener in auxiliary role.

nodes.label: Access and Benefit Sharing
summaries: Compensating people and communities for knowledge leading to commercial plant use, including remuneration and involvement in cultivation.

nodes.label: Adrenocorticotropic Hormone
summaries: Pituitary hormone activating adrenal glands; elevated in chronic insomnia.

nodes.label: Adulterated Cosmetic
summaries: Under FD&C Act Sec. 601, a cosmetic containing poisonous/deleterious or filthy substances, prepared under insanitary conditions, in a harmful container, or with an unsafe color additive (hair dyes excepted).

nodes.label: Alban Muller Group
summaries: Company whose president Alban Muller edited the sustainability book and authored chapters on eco-responsible plant extraction and green industrial production.

nodes.label: Alkyl PEG/PPG Dimethicone
summaries: Alkyl dimethicone copolyols bearing both alkyl and polyoxyalkylene groups; emulsifiers for O/W and W/O emulsions (e.g., lauryl PEG-8 dimethicone).

nodes.label: Alkyl Polyglucosides
summaries: Fatty alcohol + glucose; mild foamers, natural alternatives to ethoxylates; decyl, lauryl, cetearyl glucoside.

nodes.label: EU Allergen-Label-Free Fragrance
summaries: Fragrance containing none of the 26 EU-labeled allergens above thresholds; excludes natural essential oils, limiting the perfumer's palette.

nodes.label: Amino Acid-Based Surfactants
summaries: Acylated, neutralized amino acids (glutamates, glycinates, alaninates, sarcosinates) used as mild cleansing agents.

nodes.label: Ammonium Acryloyldimethyltaurate/Beheneth-25 Methacrylate Crosspolymer
summaries: Hydrophobically modified AMPS polymer (Aristoflex HMB) that thickens and emulsifies high oil loads; higher salt tolerance, slower breakdown and moisturized feel; c* ~1.25% in 62% ethanol.

nodes.label: Amphoteric AHA Complex
summaries: AHA complexed with arginine or ornithine for slow release; 20% glycolic/arginine took 11 vs 4 days to moderate irritation while 6.3% complex cut SC turnover time 15.7%.

nodes.label: Annex II Prohibited Substances
summaries: EU list of over 1300 substances prohibited in cosmetics; traces allowed only if technically unavoidable and safe (Art. 17).

nodes.label: Apple Stem Cell Extract
summaries: Malus domestica meristem cultures improve longevity of skin stem cells by delaying senescence.

nodes.label: Arrector Pili Muscle
summaries: Adrenergically controlled muscle bundle that changes the follicle angle and makes hair stand up with cold or emotional stress; absent in eyelashes.

nodes.label: Artificial Nails
summaries: Acrylic or pre-formed nail plates that can cause contact or irritant dermatitis leading to onycholysis and discoloration.

nodes.label: Ascorbyl Glucoside
summaries: L-ascorbic acid 2-glucoside, QD status to Shiseido in 1994 at 2%.
Ascorbic acid 2-O-alpha-D-glucoside; stable in acidic environments with improved stability and efficacy.

nodes.label: Asiatic Acid
summaries: Triterpene from Centella asiatica, perhaps the best natural fibroblast collagen stimulator.

nodes.label: Autophagy
summaries: Cellular self-eating pathway degrading long-lived proteins and damaged organelles; takes over when proteasome is overwhelmed; target for detoxifying actives.

nodes.label: Back-Combing
summaries: Teasing that lifts cuticle cells to interlock fibers, raising friction to create volume; effective but very damaging.

nodes.label: Basal Metabolic Rate
summaries: Rate of resting energy use; increased in 55% of supplemented patients, correlating with phase angle (p<0.05).

nodes.label: Beauty from Within
summaries: Ayurveda is argued to pioneer the concept, combining topical treatment with oral supplements.
Concept that hydrating foods and ingestible nutricosmetics protect skin internally from free radical damage.

nodes.label: Betaines
summaries: Mild, good-foaming surfactants classed as amphoteric though technically cationic; from alkylation of tertiary amine with chloroacetic acid.

nodes.label: Bioelectrical Impedance Analysis
summaries: BIA diagnostic tool measuring TBW, ICW, ECW, basal metabolic rate and phase angle; used on over 1500 patients aged 25-85.

nodes.label: Botulinum Toxin
summaries: Cholinergic modulator proposed as possible stress-related anti-aging therapy.

nodes.label: Bound Water
summaries: Water strongly bound to protein groups that stabilizes keratin secondary structure and remains even at zero RH; its loss with disulfide breakage causes denaturation.
Non-freezable and freezable bound water hydrating HA; 1 g of 650 kDa HA holds 0.8-2 g water; independent of MW from 30-750 kDa.

nodes.label: Butylene Glycol
summaries: Petrochemical solvent-carrier for extracts that hinders easy plant waste disposal.
1,3-butylene glycol humectant that increased hair roughness vs sodium PCA.

nodes.label: Calcium Signaling
summaries: Calcium ions promote cell adhesion and differentiation genes via calcium-sensing receptor; calcium waves after scratch and via gap junctions direct wound healing.

nodes.label: Candida albicans
summaries: Microorganism not allowed in 0.1 g (cream) or 0.5 g (mascara) under CU requirements.
Pathogenic yeast controlled by neem extracts.

nodes.label: Carbamide Peroxide
summaries: Peroxide bleaching agent in tooth whitening products.

nodes.label: Carnitine
summaries: Carrier shuttling long-chain acyl groups into mitochondria for beta-oxidation.
Osmoprotectant; topical carnitine in dry eye offers osmoprotection and modulates immune/inflammatory responses.

nodes.label: Carnosic Acid
summaries: Phenolic diterpene in rosemary that rearranges to carnosol upon reacting with radicals, then rosmanol and galdosol, cascading antioxidant capacity.

nodes.label: Carnosine
summaries: Used at 0.1% in the anti-aging cream.

nodes.label: Cell-Surface Receptors
summaries: Four major classes: enzyme-linked receptors, G-protein-coupled receptors, ion-channel receptors and tyrosine kinase-linked receptors.

nodes.label: Cellular Stress Resistance
summaries: Emerging theory that longevity tracks resistance to multiple nonoxidative stressors (heat, heavy metals, xenobiotics), coordinated by Nrf2.

nodes.label: Cellular Water Principle
summaries: Optimizing intracellular and extracellular tissue water to achieve cellular water homeostasis improves metabolism, health and dermal appearance; about getting water into cells, not just drinking it.

nodes.label: Certificate of Conformity (KSA)
summaries: Required per shipment for cosmetics entering KSA (MoCI Decree 6386), issued by approved inspection bodies after document review, testing and inspection.

nodes.label: About the Editor-in-Chief
summaries: Biographical note on Meyer R. Rosen, President of Interactive Consulting, Inc. and Editor-in-Chief of Harry's Cosmeticology 9th Ed. It lists his expertise in technical marketing, applied rheology, surface and interfacial chemistry, polymers and organosilicones, and his roles with the SCC, AIC and Euro Cosmetics Magazine.

nodes.label: Children's Cosmetics
summaries: Higher-risk category requiring CU State Registration and specific labeling; in China subject to 2012 guide minimizing ingredients.

nodes.label: Regulations Concerning the Hygiene Supervision over Cosmetics (1990)
summaries: Basis of Chinese cosmetic regulation, defining cosmetics as daily-use chemical products applied to the body surface to clean, deodorize, protect, make up and beautify.

nodes.label: Chromatin Remodeling
summaries: Changing chromatin condensation between open euchromatin and silent heterochromatin; 98% of keratinocyte genome heterochromatic.

nodes.label: Collaboration
summaries: Partnering across supply chains, competitors and NGOs; inherent to OI and required by the complexity of sustainability.

nodes.label: Cosmetic Product Safety Report
summaries: Annex I report within the PIF: Part A safety information (composition, stability, microbiology, impurities, exposure, toxicology) and Part B safety assessment with reasoning.

nodes.label: Creams and Lotions
summaries: Emulsions using 1-5% emulsifiers, generally anionic or nonionic.

nodes.label: Critical Micelle Concentration
summaries: Surfactant concentration at which micelles begin to form.
Concentration at which the interface is saturated and surfactant forms micelles; determined by monitoring surface tension vs concentration.

nodes.label: Cyclotetrapeptide-24 Aminocyclohexane Carboxylate
summaries: Cyclic biomimetic RGD-containing peptide (RonaCare Cyclopeptide-5, Merck KGaA) with synthetic ACHA; claimed to improve wrinkles via integrin selectivity.

nodes.label: Cyclotetrasiloxane
summaries: D4 cyclic silicone with surface tension 20.6 dynes/cm; abandoned in personal care due to safety concerns.

nodes.label: Cysteic Acid
summaries: Oxidation product of cystine formed in photo-aged and alkaline-treated hair.

nodes.label: Dental Enamel
summaries: Hardest tissue in the body, ~98% partially carbonated hydroxyapatite; acid-soluble, stable above the critical pH of ~5.5.

nodes.label: Dental Erosion
summaries: Dissolution of enamel and dentin by acids of intrinsic or external (non-bacterial) origin; depends on acid pH, titratable acidity and behaviors.

nodes.label: Dental Pellicle
summaries: 1-3 um film of proline-rich phosphoproteins, peptides and glycoproteins adsorbed from saliva onto enamel within minutes after cleaning; may protect against erosion.

nodes.label: Dentin
summaries: Mineralized tissue under enamel and cementum, ~70% hydroxyapatite with collagen, perforated by dentinal tubules; more decay-susceptible than enamel.

nodes.label: Discontinuous Innovation
summaries: Disruptive innovation with an entirely new market application, e.g. hair regrowth or ingestible skin/hair supplements.

nodes.label: DNA
summaries: Deoxyribonucleic acid; the hereditary storage form of genetic information whose genes indirectly control protein synthesis.

nodes.label: DNA Damage Response
summaries: DDR pathway of repair enzymes (MMR, BER, NER) regulated epigenetically; works with p53; repair may remove epigenetic tags.

nodes.label: Drug Claims
summaries: Claims the FDA regards as making a product a drug: hair growth restoration, cellulite reduction, varicose vein treatment, skin whitening or darkening, cell regeneration.

nodes.label: Elastase
summaries: Enzyme breaking down elastin; oxyresveratrol IC50 120 µg/ml; human leukocyte elastase inhibited by boswellic acids.

nodes.label: Emollients
summaries: Applied daily to the nailbed and nail plate to soften and help reattachment in onycholysis, and recommended nightly for brittle and split nails.

nodes.label: Endoplasmic Reticulum
summaries: Largest internal membrane, a lipid bilayer studded with ribosomes (rough ER) where proteins with signal sequences are synthesized.

nodes.label: EP Class X (Black/African American)
summaries: African and Caribbean origin; medium-dark brown; never burns; pigmentation issues, keloids, pseudofolliculitis; skin cancer very rare; extreme caution with peels and lasers.

nodes.label: Epidermal Differentiation
summaries: Coordinated multi-step process of keratinocyte maturation from basal proliferation to suprabasal differentiation, controlled by miR-203 among others.

nodes.label: Epidermal Growth Factor
summaries: Protein hormone that signals adjacent cells when membrane-bound and acts as an endocrine signal after protease cleavage.
EGF; alginate oligosaccharides act as its cofactor for keratinocyte growth.

nodes.label: Epigenetically Active Cosmetic Ingredients
summaries: Ingredients modulating gene expression via epigenetic mechanisms; raise questions about timing, cell specificity, penetration and safety.

nodes.label: Erythema
summaries: UV-induced redness reduced by green tea polyphenols, emblica, bakuchiol and vitamin C/E combinations.

nodes.label: Essential Amino Acids
summaries: Amino acids not made sufficiently in the body (methionine, tryptophan, threonine, phenylalanine, valine, lysine, leucine, histidine, isoleucine) and obtained from diet.

nodes.label: Exosomes
summaries: Extracellular vesicles carrying microRNAs, mRNAs and proteins between cells; released by senescent cells and potential biomarkers.

nodes.label: Extracellular Water
summaries: Water outside cell membranes acting as reservoir for intracellular water; divided into interstitial, plasma and transcellular compartments.

nodes.label: Facial or Body Cream
summaries: CU limits pH 5.0-9.0 and <=10^3 CFU/g; KSA skin cream standard requires >=15% fatty matter.

nodes.label: Fine Fragrance
summaries: Perfume product where every moment from application to wash-off is a key evaluation point; over 1,000 launched globally in 2011.

nodes.label: Follicular Penetration Pathway
summaries: Trans-appendageal route through hair follicles (1-2% of skin surface) for large insoluble molecules and nanoparticles.

nodes.label: Fragrance Blocker
summaries: Ingredient that decreases or mutes an undesired fragrance or malodor, e.g. body odor or alcohol solvent smell.

nodes.label: Fragrance Enhancer
summaries: Ingredient that amplifies the perception of a desired fragrance note at certain concentrations; could reduce amount of scarce aromatic needed.

nodes.label: Fucoxanthin
summaries: Carotenoid from Laminaria japonica that suppresses tyrosinase activity, suggesting skin lightening.

nodes.label: Genetically Modified Organism
summaries: Traceability concern mainly for vegetable oils from industrial crops (wheat, sunflower, palm); medicinal plants mostly unmodified.

nodes.label: Genomics
summaries: Field of high-throughput gene analysis arising from the Human Genome Project (completed 2003, 3 billion base pairs); with other omics enables advances in dermatology and cosmetics.

nodes.label: Glucosylceramide
summaries: Lamellar granule lipid converted by beta-glucocerebrosidase into stratum corneum ceramides.

nodes.label: Glycine
summaries: Smallest amino acid (single hydrogen R group) fitting tight spaces; with proline found where the chain loops back.
Nonessential amino acid; part of collagen-boosting glycine:proline:alanine cocktail.

nodes.label: Glycotoxins
summaries: Heterogeneous sugar-derived reactive molecules from diet, cigarette smoke and glycation intermediates; as important as sunlight in skin aging.

nodes.label: Gram-Negative Bacteria
summaries: Coliforms and Pseudomonas grow well with surfactants; target of preservatives.

nodes.label: GRAS Fragrance
summaries: Niche fragrance where each material has a FEMA-GRAS number or is a recognized flavor, for lip balms, products entering the mouth and children's toys; typically fruity and simple.

nodes.label: Hair Bulb
summaries: Lowermost onion-shaped part of the anagen follicle, one of the most rapidly dividing tissues; the 'hair shaft factory' with matrix keratinocytes and melanocytes surrounding the dermal papilla.

nodes.label: Hair Glosser
summaries: Hair product compared using Green Star Rating: cyclomethicone/dimethiconol (GSR 0.5) vs olive oil/crosspolymer (GSR 10).

nodes.label: Hair Manageability
summaries: Ease of combing and styling, governed largely by cuticle friction; decreases with aging and damage.

nodes.label: Hair Spray
summaries: Aerosol styling polymer in ethanol/water; low plasticization and fast evaporation rapidly harden welding spots to entrap shapes in motion.

nodes.label: Hayflick Limit Theory
summaries: Cells have a preset number of divisions; human fibroblasts divide about 50 times then stop, each copy poorer in quality.

nodes.label: Hexachlorophene
summaries: Restricted US preservative: only when no equally effective alternative, max 0.1%, not on mucous membranes such as lips (21 CFR 250.250).
Prohibited or severely restricted in the US.

nodes.label: HLB System
summaries: Hydrophile-Lipophile Balance system designed by William C. Griffin; HLB = weight % hydrophilic portion / 5 (e.g. Steareth-20 = 15); composite HLB is arithmetic; oils have required HLB.

nodes.label: Human Growth Hormone
summaries: Pituitary 'anti-aging hormone' released in stage 3 sleep for tissue repair; deficiency causes thin, wrinkle-prone skin.

nodes.label: Hydrogen Bond
summaries: Weak bonds in the hair gel structure broken by water and re-formed on drying; store temporary shapes in water-setting and volumizing.

nodes.label: Lipid Hydroperoxides
summaries: Odorless primary oxidation products that degrade to free radicals and secondary carbonyl products.

nodes.label: Hydrophilic-Lipophilic Balance
summaries: Griffin's HLB concept describing organic surfactant behavior; inadequate when a silicone moiety is introduced.
HLB study determines emulsifier ratio for stability.

nodes.label: Hypoestrogenism
summaries: Low estrogen state from menopause, ovarian failure, aromatase inhibitors, GnRH agonists or breastfeeding causing vulvar atrophy and loss of sensitivity.

nodes.label: Inventory of Existing Cosmetic Ingredients in China
summaries: CFDA inventory (IECIC 2003 & 2011) plus 2012 batches of 1674, 637 and 1356 substances; ingredients outside it are 'new' and need approval.

nodes.label: IFRA
summaries: International Fragrance Association; regulates the amount of each fragrance material usable in 11 product categories via the QRA document and educates the public.

nodes.label: INCI Fragrance Blend
summaries: Fragrance in which every material has a PCPC INCI name so the label lists ingredients instead of 'fragrance'; types are natural, allergen-label-free, traditional and unscented.

nodes.label: Inflammasome
summaries: Large intracellular multiprotein complex central to innate immunity; UV radiation activates inflammasomes in keratinocytes.

nodes.label: Ingredient Declaration
summaries: Ingredients listed in descending order of predominance; those at 1% or below and colorants may follow in any order; US trade-secret ingredients may be listed as 'and other ingredients'.

nodes.label: Dusting
summaries: Practice of including a non-efficacious amount of a story-driven ingredient, rendering the product ineffective; common in natural/organic and mainstream products.

nodes.label: Involucrin
summaries: Primary cytoplasmic precursor protein of the cornified cell envelope, cross-linked with loricrin by transglutaminase.
Cornified cell envelope protein in the stratum corneum; decreased upon miR-203 inhibition.

nodes.label: Jojoba Oil
summaries: Oil providing nourishing, conditioning and shine benefits to hair.
Replacement for whale fat, grown in Arizona desert and now cultivated in Negev and Argentina.

nodes.label: Keratinocyte Differentiation
summaries: Progressive keratinization from basal layer to surface ending in enucleated corneocytes; regulated by calcium.

nodes.label: Keratinocyte Stem Cells
aliases: somatic stem cells of the epidermis
summaries: Basal epidermal progenitors (<1% of basal population) residing in a niche, supporting epidermal renewal.

nodes.label: Keratohyalin Granule
summaries: Basophilic granules of the stratum granulosum composed of profilaggrin, loricrin and keratins; responsible for keratin filament aggregation; absent in hard keratins of hair and nail.

nodes.label: Latanoprost
summaries: Glaucoma prostaglandin analogue increasing lash length 0.67-0.8 mm and thickness; described for alopecia areata.

nodes.label: Lauroyl Lysine
summaries: Amino acid powder texture modifier with slippery feel.
Amino acid derivative helping inorganic UV blocks deposit uniformly with soft lubricious skin feel.

nodes.label: Leave-On Product
summaries: Products such as lotions and hair gels whose key fragrance evaluation is at application and over the effectiveness time frame.

nodes.label: Lip Aging
summaries: With age the upper lip lengthens and the vermilion zone narrows; TEWL and sebum secretion decrease while hydration is age-independent.

nodes.label: Liquid Crystalline Lamellar Phase
summaries: Surfactant structures similar to skin lipid bilayers; emulsions resist wash-off, enhance moisturization and delivery of water-soluble actives; independent of HLB.

nodes.label: Live Yeast Cell Derivative
summaries: LYCD from S. cerevisiae; increases tissue respiration and accelerates wound healing; peptide fractions stimulate cell renewal.

nodes.label: Lunula
summaries: Visible half-moon lighter region of the nail root; probably reflects incomplete keratinization in the matrix.

nodes.label: Lyophilization
summaries: Deep-freeze vacuum drying with high energy consumption and refrigerating gases.
For heat-labile compounds: freezing at -40°C, primary and secondary drying; used to make Cococin coconut water solids.

nodes.label: Lysosome
summaries: Membrane-bound digestive vesicle containing acid hydrolases that break down proteins and debris.
Cell component containing proteases that break down proteins.

nodes.label: Macrophage
summaries: Immune cell found in skin; activated by interferons.
Second-line cellular immune defense stimulated by defensins.

nodes.label: Magnesium Ascorbyl Phosphate
summaries: Vitamin C derivative granted QD status to Takeda in 1988 at 3%.
Stable vitamin C derivative (MAP), like sodium ascorbyl phosphate requiring pH >7 and a chelator.

nodes.label: Market Segmentation
summaries: Breaking a market into consumer segments sharing characteristics, combining demographics, psychographics and geographics, to tailor the marketing mix.

nodes.label: MD Follicle Energizer
summaries: Lash-conditioner-derived scalp product; 71% of 30 subjects agreed it helped hair growth; proposed as adjuvant to hair loss therapy.

nodes.label: Mechanical Oral Hygiene
summaries: Brushing and flossing that reduce plaque, calculus formation, gingivitis and malodor.

nodes.label: Melanin Transfer
summaries: Delivery of melanosomes via melanocyte dendrites to keratinocytes, dependent on PAR-2.

nodes.label: Melanocyte Stem Cell
summaries: Melanocyte reserve in the bulge region of the ORS that replenishes melanocytes each cycle; loss or failure to differentiate is a graying mechanism.

nodes.label: Melatonin
summaries: Further improved photoprotection when co-applied with vitamins C and E.
Sleep-promoting hormone rising in evening; suppressed by light; decrease can cause onset insomnia.

nodes.label: Membrane Hypothesis of Aging
summaries: Nagy's hypothesis: free-radical cross-linking damages plasma membranes, decreasing potassium permeability, causing colloid condensation, water loss, enzyme inhibition and lipofuscin accumulation.

nodes.label: Menthol
summaries: Natural isolate obtained by crystallizing it out of peppermint oil.
Component of the fixed-ratio essential oil antigingivitis mouthrinse.

nodes.label: Merkel Cell
summaries: Epidermal cell of the basal layer concerned with sensation, often associated with sensory nerve endings.
Slowly adapting receptor responding to sustained touch such as texture or shape; possible target of estrogen effect on sensitivity.

nodes.label: Japan Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare
aliases: Japanese Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare
summaries: Japanese regulator that approves quasi-drug ingredients; discouraged kojic acid use from March 2003.

nodes.label: Micellar Solution
summaries: Surfactant-based product base such as shampoo or body wash in which fragrance perception differs from the neat oil.

nodes.label: Micelle
summaries: Spherical surfactant aggregates in water with hydrophobic tails inside; form above the critical micelle concentration; oil dissolves in interior (solubilization).

nodes.label: Microalgae
summaries: Spirulina, Ulkenia, Chlorella fermented in bioreactors for secondary metabolites.

nodes.label: Middle Notes
summaries: The 'coeur' (heart), the most characteristic part of a fragrance: florals, sweet, gourmand, deeper fruity and lighter woody notes.

nodes.label: Minoxidil
summaries: Pharmacological hair-loss treatment applied as 2% or 5% scalp solution or 5% foam twice daily; 5% was 45% more effective than 2% after 48 weeks in men.
2% solution used as positive control for hair growth.

nodes.label: miR-24
summaries: Suprabasal microRNA inducing differentiation by controlling actin adhesion dynamics; down-regulated in senescent fibroblasts with up-regulated target p16.

nodes.label: miR-29
summaries: Family up-regulated in fibroblast senescence; miR-29b is a potent post-transcriptional repressor of collagen type I.

nodes.label: miR-675
summaries: Secreted by keratinocytes in exosomes and regulates melanocyte pigmentation via MITF.

nodes.label: mTOR
summaries: Serine/threonine kinase (mammalian target of rapamycin) controlling cell division and survival; part of the PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway intersecting AMPK.

nodes.label: MTT Assay
summaries: Cell viability assay; carbon nanoparticles adsorb substrate causing false positives; recommended in OECD TG 431 skin corrosion test.

nodes.label: Multi-Domain Alkyl Silicones
summaries: Alkyl silicones with both solid (C16+) and liquid (C8-C16) alkyl groups on one backbone forming small domains; translucent, melt at 34-38 °C, shear-flowing, reduce syneresis.

nodes.label: Mycotoxins
summaries: Highly toxic fungal metabolites such as aflatoxins and ochratoxins (LD50 often below ug/kg) formed in poorly stored humid plants.

nodes.label: Nagoya Protocol
summaries: Access and benefit-sharing protocol under which wild collection could expose companies to biopiracy lawsuits.

nodes.label: Nail Growth
summaries: Fingernails grow 0.5-1.2 mm/week, toenails 0.2-0.4 mm/week; full fingernail replacement takes 5-6 months, toenails 12-18 months; increased in psoriasis and pregnancy, depressed in infection and starvation.

nodes.label: EU Nanomaterial Pre-Market Notification
summaries: Products with nanomaterials must be notified six months before market placement with identity, specification, quantity, toxicology, safety data and exposure conditions.

nodes.label: Polymer Neutralization
summaries: Deprotonation of carboxylic acid groups above ~pH 3.5 uncoils polyacrylic polymers by charge repulsion; viscosity plateaus at pH 5.5-10.

nodes.label: Nitric Oxide
summaries: Physiological free radical precursor of peroxynitrite.

nodes.label: Non-Special-Use Cosmetics (China)
summaries: Chinese category including hair care, nail care, skin care, perfumes and makeup; domestically made ones exempt from animal tests from June 2014.

nodes.label: New Substances Notification Regulations
summaries: Volume-based premanufacture/preimport notification under CEPA for substances not on the Domestic Substances List; nanoscale forms with unique structures are new.

nodes.label: Ingestible Beauty Supplement
summaries: Skin and hair care products in the form of ingestible nutritional supplements, possibly the last true discontinuous innovation in the sector.
Growing ingested beauty products; makes toxicology of food-related nanomaterials relevant to cosmetics.

nodes.label: Octanol-Water Partition Coefficient
summaries: log Kow index of a material's partitioning between octanol and water; each unit means ~1,000x (as stated) more material prefers the oily phase; most fragrance materials are hydrophobic.

nodes.label: Oily Skin
summaries: Overproduction of sebum causing shine, especially in the T-zone; benefits from oil-control products.

nodes.label: Olive Oil
summaries: Natural oil gelled by behenyl dimethicone; base of high Green Star Rating hair glosser.

nodes.label: One-Carbon Metabolism
summaries: Folate-methionine cycle supplying methyl groups (folate, riboflavin, pyridoxine, cobalamin, choline, betaine, methionine) for DNA/histone methylation.

nodes.label: Optical Effects Cleanser
summaries: Surfactant cleanser suspending beads, particles or air bubbles; needs low yield stress while remaining pourable.

nodes.label: ORAC Assay
summaries: Oxygen Radical Absorbance Capacity; family includes ORAC hydro/lipo, HORAC, NORAC, SORAC, SOAC measuring activity against peroxyl, hydroxyl, peroxynitrite, superoxide and singlet oxygen; AOAC first action method.

nodes.label: Organic Certification
summaries: Certification designed for agricultural products, complex to extend to cosmetics; easily applied to essential oils and cold-pressed oils, harder for floral waters and extracts.

nodes.label: Organic Farming
summaries: Based on health, ecology, fairness and care; avoids synthetic chemicals and GMOs; supply security, yield and cost limit its use in cosmetics.

nodes.label: Ospemifene
summaries: FDA-approved oral non-estrogen SERM for dyspareunia; side effects include hot flashes; risk of endometrial cancer, stroke and blood clots.

nodes.label: Oxidative Stability Index
summaries: AOCS method measuring induction period under heated air bubbling via conductivity of volatile fatty acids; protection factor = IP treated/control.

nodes.label: Packaging
summaries: Labels, containers and applicators considered after formula finalization; an important part of the consumer experience and a key sensory cue in fragrance.

nodes.label: Palmitoyl Oligopeptide (Pal-GHK)
summaries: Collagen-derived signal peptide (Biopeptide-CL) that stimulates collagen and glycosaminoglycan synthesis.

nodes.label: Pancratium Maritimum Extract
summaries: Sea lily extract down-regulating POMC and Substance P receptors, reducing melanocyte dendrites; effective on age spots at 1.5% in three months.

nodes.label: Patch Test
summaries: Dermatological patch testing on human volunteers or in vitro skin, a usual finished-product safety test.
48-hour closed/repeat insult patch tests on 50 subjects showed no irritation for THC and tetrahydropiperine.

nodes.label: Patent Searching and Mining
summaries: Mining free (Espacenet, PATENTSCOPE, Google Patents) and paid databases for legal and technical competitive intelligence.

nodes.label: PEG-8/PPG-8 Dimethicone
summaries: Dimethicone copolyol with propylene oxide groups that gave efficient antiperspirant active release (96.2% at 30 min).

nodes.label: Period After Opening
summaries: Open-jar symbol with months of use after opening, used for products with minimum durability over 30 months instead of a date.

nodes.label: Periodontitis
summaries: Serious periodontal disease with severe inflammation, deeper pockets and irreversible alveolar bone loss; associated with Porphyromonas gingivalis; not an OTC indication.

nodes.label: Phenol
summaries: Common impurity in phenoxyethanol requiring testing reports in China.

nodes.label: Phenoxyethanol
summaries: Preservative whose common impurity phenol must be tested for Chinese registration.
Third most used preservative (8878 US listings).

nodes.label: Phosphodiesterase
summaries: Enzyme destroying cAMP needed to phosphorylate lipase; blocked by xanthines.

nodes.label: Nanomaterial Physicochemical Characterization
summaries: Characterization of size, distribution, morphology, surface, solubility, purity, agglomeration etc.; paramount for interpreting toxicity; purity lacking in over half of food nanomaterial studies.

nodes.label: Phytocosmetics
summaries: Plant-based cosmetics industry using medicinal and aromatic plants such as cornflower, milk thistle, burdock, soapwort.

nodes.label: Plant Breeding
summaries: Mass selection and cross-breeding (aided by molecular markers) to create varieties with high yield, disease resistance and high active content.

nodes.label: Plant Drying
summaries: Most common plant preservation method reducing water to ~12% to stop enzymatic and microbial deterioration; erysimum optimal at 75 C.

nodes.label: Plant Identification
summaries: Scientific binomial name, plant part, botanical (macro/microscopic), phytochemical (TLC, HPLC, GC) and genomic identification of plant raw materials.

nodes.label: Polyethylene
summaries: Thixotropic thickener and suspending agent for anhydrous systems (lipsticks, antiperspirant sticks, mascaras); requires heating to 80 °C or above.

nodes.label: Polyhydroxy Acids
summaries: Second-generation AHAs (aldonic acids) with multiple hydroxyls; comparable anti-aging benefits with greater mildness, humectancy, antioxidant and barrier benefits.

nodes.label: Polymer Seam and Spot Welding
summaries: Junctions of dried styling polymer between fibers that restrict inter-fiber motion and give rigidity; depend on polymer Tg, moisture plasticization and adhesive strength.

nodes.label: Product Discoloration
summaries: Fragrance-induced color shift: vanilla/spun-sugar gourmand notes turn products yellow or pink; grapey, jasmine or tuberose notes turn them pink.

nodes.label: Product Strategy
summaries: Foundation of marketing where marketing and R&D decide ingredients, positioning, packaging and branding before pricing; failed cooperation here often causes product failure.

nodes.label: Product-Use Cycle
summaries: Sequence of consumer evaluation points from point of purchase through dispensing, bloom with water, rinse, drying or leave-on wear; usually one key evaluation point dominates.

nodes.label: Progerin
summaries: Mutant lamin A protein causing progeria; produced in normal cells, activated by telomere damage during senescence.

nodes.label: Propanediol
summaries: Propylene glycol alternative obtained by biofermentation of corn.
Ingredient cited as best practice for biotechnological production.

nodes.label: Prostaglandin J2
summaries: COX-2 product with cyclopentenone ring that increases ubiquitinated proteins and COX-2, a self-destructive feedback loop.

nodes.label: Proteins
summaries: Working molecules of the cell built from 20 amino acids; mammalian cells contain up to 10,000 kinds whose 3D structure determines function.

nodes.label: Protein Denaturation
summaries: Irreversible loss of native keratin conformation (crystalline melting above Tm, alkaline attack); removes permanent shape memory and weakens hair.

nodes.label: Proteolysis
summaries: Protein breakdown essential to cell survival and turnover; via lysosomes, ubiquitin-proteasome pathway and calpains.

nodes.label: Pruritus
summaries: Itching, especially common and sometimes severe in elderly dry skin.

nodes.label: Pseudomonas aeruginosa
summaries: Pathogen not allowed in CU cosmetic samples.
Bacterium that colonizes under the nail causing greenish, black or blue discoloration.

nodes.label: Quantitative Real-Time PCR
summaries: qPCR enables accurate quantification of gene expression and detection of mutations.
Enabled in vivo testing of host peptide up-regulation by PDBs.

nodes.label: Receptor for Advanced Glycation End Products
summaries: RAGE; interaction with AGEs elicits oxidative stress and pro-inflammatory gene activation.

nodes.label: Randomized Controlled Trials
summaries: Large-population controlled efficacy evaluation needed to validate Ayurvedic medicine.

nodes.label: Regional Patent Organizations
summaries: ARIPO (18 mostly English-speaking African states), OAPI (16 French-speaking), EAPO (Eurasian), GCC patent office and Latin American bodies.

nodes.label: Remineralization
summaries: Reparative deposition of calcium and phosphate into enamel by saliva, enhanced by fluoride and available calcium; can reverse early caries lesions.

nodes.label: Repeat Insult Patch Test
summaries: Human RIPT on 209 subjects showed no irritation or sensitization for dechloro ethylcloprostenolamide.
Showed 20% maltobionic acid cream nonallergenic and nonirritating.

nodes.label: Required HLB Test
summaries: Blends of sorbitan oleate (HLB 4.3) and polysorbate 80 (HLB 14.9) at even HLB 6-14 are shaken with test oil and water; least separation gives oil's HLB requirement.

nodes.label: Ribosome
summaries: Framework for protein synthesis, with subunits made in the nucleolus.

nodes.label: RIFM
summaries: Research Institute for Fragrance Materials; conducts safety and environmental studies on fragrance raw materials and maintains the master list of permitted materials.

nodes.label: Rosacea
summaries: Skin disorder with unique gene expression profile; main feature is facial redness.
Sensitive skin condition compatible with gluconolactone.

nodes.label: Sabinsa Corporation
summaries: Company developing standardized botanicals (Saberry, Sabiwhite, Cococin, ForsLean, Cosmoperine, Artonox, Boswellin).

nodes.label: SASO 1512:2010 Skin Cream Standard
summaries: Product-specific standard (GSO 1152:2010): pH 5-9.5, fatty matter >=15%, water <=85%, utility date <=3 years; used in local lab testing.

nodes.label: Saudi Arabia
summaries: Fast-growing GCC market for cosmetics with strong demand for luxury products, where social customs strongly influence rules.

nodes.label: Shelterin Complex
summaries: Telosome of TRF1, TRF2, POT1, RAP1, TIN2 and TPP1 essential for telomere function.

nodes.label: Silica
summaries: Silicon dioxide (hydrated, fumed, precipitated) that builds thixotropic structure via hydrogen-bonded networks in oils, suspends, and acts as anti-caking agent; destroyed by high shear.

nodes.label: Silicone Gum
summaries: Ultra-high-viscosity (100,000-1,000,000 cSt) linear silicone fluid; blended with low-viscosity fluids (50-80%) it gives velvety feel and breathable barrier.

nodes.label: Silicone Waxes
summaries: Phase transition at or slightly above room temperature giving creamy laydown; higher MW than paraffin, compatible with paraffin waxes.

nodes.label: SIRT6
summaries: Nuclear chromatin-bound sirtuin aiding base excision and double-strand break repair, regulating glycolysis; knockout causes graying and fat loss; associates with telomeres.

nodes.label: Sirtuin Activators
summaries: Nutrients listed among hydrating, cell-building supplements.

nodes.label: Situation Analysis
summaries: Objective analysis of internal controllable factors (mission, finance, IT, R&D, marketing) and external factors (industry, competition, economy, regulation) of the business environment; also called business analysis.

nodes.label: Skin Cleanser
summaries: Formulated like shampoos; facial cleansers use milder anionics; body washes add emollients for moisturization.

nodes.label: Skin Surface pH
summaries: SC pH regulates barrier homeostasis, integrity and antimicrobial defense; elevated in impaired skin and lowered by LBA and gluconolactone.

nodes.label: Small Interfering RNAs
summaries: Small dsRNAs arising from exogenous long RNA precursors (viruses, transposons, plasmids) or applied synthetically, mediating RNAi.

nodes.label: Sodium Hydroxide
summaries: Strong base of lye relaxers supplying OH ions at pH 11.5-14 (1.5-3%).
Base used to neutralize carbomer and ASE/HASE polymers; recommended for ~20% alcohol systems.

nodes.label: Sodium Polyaspartate
summaries: Polymerized aspartic acid film former/humectant; 10% let skin stretch 5.75 mm vs 1.5 mm for hydrolyzed collagen; restores permed hair tensile strength.

nodes.label: Solubilization
summaries: Using surfactant to solubilize hydrophobic fragrance oil in water; start at 2-3 parts surfactant to 1 part oil, up to 4-5 parts for clarity.

nodes.label: Sphacelaria Scoparia Extract
summaries: Brown alga extract that inhibits pre-adipocyte maturation, reduces GLUT4 and fatty-acid transporter activity and stimulates collagen I and IV, firming skin.

nodes.label: Botanical Extract Standardization
summaries: AHPA: information and controls to produce materials of reasonable consistency; identify active marker, chemical fingerprinting by chromatography, ensures efficacy and authenticity.

nodes.label: Staphylococcus aureus
summaries: Pathogen not allowed in CU cosmetic samples.

nodes.label: Static Fly-Away
summaries: Electrostatic repulsion from negative charge transferred from rubber combs (triboelectric series); adds volume but causes frizz and dissipates with moisture.

nodes.label: Stratum Basale
summaries: Innermost epidermal layer of cuboidal/columnar proliferating cells attached to the basement membrane by hemidesmosomes; houses epidermal stem cells; biomarkers keratins K5 and K14.

nodes.label: Stratum Spinosum
summaries: Prickle layer named for numerous desmosomes; lamellar granules appear in its upper region; biomarkers keratins K1 and K10.

nodes.label: Syneresis
summaries: Separation of water (or oil, 'sweating') from a gel or formulation; starch derivatives inhibit it in aqueous systems.

nodes.label: Taurine
summaries: Organic osmolyte accumulated by kidney medulla cells.

nodes.label: Telomere Theory of Aging
summaries: States that the faster telomeres shorten, the faster one ages biologically.

nodes.label: Tissue Inhibitors of Metalloproteinases
summaries: Natural MMP inhibitors TIMP I-IV; may orchestrate corpus luteum formation.
Endogenous MMP inhibitors that free radicals inhibit.

nodes.label: Top Notes
summaries: Immediately perceivable, most volatile notes such as citrus, green, marine, ozone and light fruity characters.

nodes.label: Collagen Trabeculae
summaries: Type I collagen connective tissue bands ordering subcutaneous fat; dissolved in cellulite.

nodes.label: Traceability
summaries: Tracking from seed through field, harvest, drying and powdering to product; supported by genomic identification.

nodes.label: Trade Dress
summaries: Limited right in distinctive product appearance or packaging, protected through courts without formal registration.

nodes.label: Transcription
summaries: First step of gene expression in which DNA is copied into RNA by RNA polymerase.

nodes.label: Transglutaminase
summaries: Calcium-dependent enzyme catalyzing epsilon-(gamma-glutamyl) lysine crosslinks of involucrin and loricrin to form the cornified envelope.

nodes.label: Translation
summaries: Ribosomal processing of mRNA into a chain of amino acids forming proteins.

nodes.label: Tryptophan
summaries: Amino acid in hair degraded by UV exposure and heat.

nodes.label: Urea
summaries: Permitted at <=10% in KSA cosmetics, except bath products to be diluted.
Additive to thioglycolate solutions that enhances hydrogen bond breakage, apparently improving perm efficiency.

nodes.label: Vermilion Zone
summaries: Entire external red portion of the lip with thin orthokeratinized epithelium and rich blood supply; its corneocytes are larger and TEWL higher than cheek skin.

nodes.label: Vimentin
summaries: Cytoskeletal protein that is the specific primary target of glycation in skin, reducing fibroblast contractility.

nodes.label: Water-Dispersible Fragrance
summaries: 'WD' fragrance with ~30-50% surfactant forming a hazy semi-stable dispersion, used for accurate low-level dosing such as facial wipes.

nodes.label: Wild Harvesting
summaries: Collecting plants from the wild; can cause overharvesting and extinction (e.g. rosewood); not considered sustainable compared with cultivation.

nodes.label: Wood's Lamp Examination
summaries: UV lamp examination used to check for photodamage, congested skin and hyperpigmentation/melasma and pigment depth.

nodes.label: World Trade Organization
summaries: Russia joined in 2012 after 18 years of negotiation, committing to SPS and TBT agreements.

nodes.label: Xerostomia
summaries: Dry mouth from reduced saliva flow due to systemic disease (Sjogren's), radiation, or over 200 drugs; leads to rampant caries and candidiasis.

nodes.label: Zinc PCA
summaries: Zinc pyrrolidone carboxylate; inhibits UV-induced AP-1 (3 ppm inhibited 69.3%, 30 ppm 77% in fibroblasts), preventing collagenase and wrinkle formation.

nodes.label: Acrylates/Beheneth-25 Methacrylate Copolymer
summaries: HASE polymer (Novethix L-10) whose associative groups give hyperbolic viscosity gains; high NL10 ratios reduce suspending power despite higher yield value.

nodes.label: Acrylates Copolymer
summaries: ASE polymer (Carbopol Aqua SF-1) whose viscosity increases linearly with concentration; provides relatively high yield stress and good particle suspension.

nodes.label: Actinic Keratosis
summaries: Premalignant hyperkeratotic lesion of photodamaged skin with p53/p16 mutations; may progress to squamous cell carcinoma.

nodes.label: Adenosine Monophosphate Disodium Salt
summaries: Cell energy fuel increasing epidermal turnover so melanin-containing cells exfoliate faster; QD for Otsuka 2004 at 3%.

nodes.label: Adipogenesis
summaries: Differentiation of mesenchymal stem cells into pre-adipocytes and adipocytes, regulated by PPARg, C/EBP and microRNAs (miR-27b, miR-138, miR-22 inhibit; miR-30 promotes).

nodes.label: Adipose-Derived Stem Cell Peptides
summaries: Third-generation lash/hair actives: proteins secreted by adipose-derived stem cells; scalp hair reportedly regenerated after topical application.

nodes.label: Adipose Tissue
summaries: Dynamic metabolic organ; thigh/buttock fat has twice as many alpha-2 as beta receptors and resists mobilization; female fat thicker with larger lobules.

nodes.label: Aerobic Metabolism
summaries: AHAs stimulate Krebs cycle and oxidative phosphorylation in keratinocytes and fibroblasts, increasing ATP for proliferation and collagen synthesis.

nodes.label: Alanine
summaries: Amino acid in collagen-stimulating cocktail with glycine and proline.

nodes.label: Albinism
summaries: Rare inherited absence of a melanin-producing enzyme causing complete lack of pigmentation; high sun damage and skin cancer risk.

nodes.label: Alkyl Amines
summaries: Amidopropyl amines protonated below pH 7 to give cationic character; used in conditioners.

nodes.label: Alkylresorcinols
summaries: Phenolic lipids from whole-grain rye and wheat; weak antioxidants but strong inhibitors of Fe2+/H2O2 oxidation; antitumor and antimicrobial.

nodes.label: Alopecia Areata
summaries: Autoimmune patchy hair loss; latanoprost described for it and one patient's lashes grew 100% with dechloro ethylcloprostenolamide.

nodes.label: Alpha-2 Adrenergic Receptor
summaries: Receptor that inhibits lipolysis; abundant in thigh and buttock fat.

nodes.label: Ammonium Acryloyldimethyltaurate/VP Copolymer
summaries: AMPS-based cross-linked rheology modifier (Aristoflex AVC) with vinylpyrrolidone co-monomer; low salt tolerance, rapid breakdown and neutral skin feel; initial yield stress at 0.3% in crème gel.
