nodes.label: Ammonium Thioglycolate
summaries: Reducing agent whose thiolate ion selectively unzips disulfide bonds in perms (7-9%, pH ~9.5) and Thio relaxers.

nodes.label: Anhydrobiosis
summaries: 'Life without water': survival in quiescent extreme desiccation found in bacteria, archaea, fungi, invertebrates and resurrection plants; platform for anti-aging osmoprotective therapies.

nodes.label: Antimicrobial Actives
summaries: Primarily kill gram-positive flora on body surfaces; not to be expected to act as preservatives.

nodes.label: Antimicrobial Peptide
summaries: Peptides such as beta-defensins (hBD-2) and cathelicidins packaged in lamellar bodies, linking permeability and antimicrobial barriers.

nodes.label: Antioxidant Enzymes
summaries: Endogenous superoxide dismutase, catalase and glutathione peroxidase that neutralize free radicals; decline with age.

nodes.label: Antioxidant-Photostabilizers
summaries: Photostabilizers with built-in antioxidant function (DESM, HMBP, TMP pentanedione derivatives) that stabilize avobenzone and protect skin.

nodes.label: Aragonite
summaries: Crystalline calcium carbonate deposited by Padina pavonica on its thallus as protective exoskeleton; requires biological messengers.

nodes.label: Aromatase
summaries: Enzyme converting testosterone precursors to estrogens; inhibition decreases estrogen.

nodes.label: Arsenic
summaries: Toxic element limited to 5.0 mg/kg in CU cosmetics containing over 1% natural herbal/mineral raw materials.

nodes.label: Artemisia Capillaris Extract
summaries: PAR-2 inhibitor reducing melanin transfer; no tanning response at 2% three times daily for three weeks.

nodes.label: Avobenzone
summaries: Photosensitive UVA filter stabilized by antioxidant-photostabilizers such as DESM, HMBP and TMP.

nodes.label: Azeloyl Tetrapeptide
summaries: Antioxidant anti-glycation peptide reducing fibroblast AGE formation ~50%; improved wrinkles and elasticity after six weeks.

nodes.label: Barrier Recovery
summaries: Repair of SC barrier after tape stripping or acetone; young skin recovers 50% in 24 h vs 15% in over-80s; 90% recovery takes 4 vs 7 days.

nodes.label: Basic Fibroblast Growth Factor
summaries: bFGF, anagen-maintaining factor produced by the dermal papilla; its decline is associated with catagen.

nodes.label: Bath Oil
summaries: Solution of fragrance in oils; dipropylene glycol carrier forms a second phase whereas isopropyl myristate stays homogeneous.

nodes.label: Behenyl Dimethicone
summaries: Solid alkyl dimethicone; 10% gels olive oil; high alkyl content gives translucent occlusive coatings.

nodes.label: Benzoyl Peroxide
summaries: 10% anti-acne agent compared to NAG; more effective later but less tolerable.

nodes.label: Beta-Blockers
summaries: Beta-adrenergic antagonists (e.g., timolol) proposed as topical anti-aging therapies; improve burn wound re-epithelialization.

nodes.label: Beta-Carotene
summaries: Oral supplementation in Nambour trial showed no difference from placebo on photo-aging.

nodes.label: Beta Keratin
summaries: Hard keratin typical of reptile claws and turtle shells; also the 'ladder or platelet' configuration hair keratin adopts when alpha helices unfold.

nodes.label: Beta-Oxidation
summaries: Mitochondrial metabolism of fatty acids to acetyl CoA before the citric acid cycle.

nodes.label: Butylated Hydroxytoluene
summaries: Common synthetic antioxidant forming many resonance structures; potent in oil-heavy formulations; demand declining.

nodes.label: Birbeck Granule
summaries: Tennis-racquet-shaped rod organelle characteristic of Langerhans cells into which captured antigen is routed.

nodes.label: Birch Bark Extract
summaries: Example of a new use patent: using birch bark extract to reduce wrinkles.

nodes.label: Bithionol
summaries: Prohibited in US cosmetics due to photocontact sensitization (21 CFR 700.11).

nodes.label: Body Wash
summaries: Micellar rinse-off product base for fragrance.

nodes.label: Brazil Nut
summaries: Bertholletia excelsa; ~200,000 people harvest ~20,000 tons yearly from Amazon; overharvest prevents tree regeneration.

nodes.label: Breast Cancer
summaries: Increased in night-shift workers; differential promoter methylation of core circadian genes.

nodes.label: Brick and Mortar Model
summaries: Model of the stratum corneum with corneocytes as bricks and intercellular lipids as mortar; later extended to a composite smart material concept.

nodes.label: Brittle Nails
summaries: Among the most common cosmetic nail complaints, increasing with age; linked to dryness, surfactant immersion, nutritional and thyroid disorders; no consistently effective therapy known.

nodes.label: Bromofluorescein Staining Dyes
summaries: Lakes of D&C Red 22, 28 and Orange 5; pH-sensitive dyes staining lips pink to extend wear; hygroscopic and may dry lips.

nodes.label: 4-n-Butylresorcinol
summaries: Rucinol; resorcinol derivative inhibiting tyrosinase and TRP-1/-2; QD for Pola in 1998 at 0.3%.

nodes.label: Calcitriol
summaries: Vitamin D form preventing UV-induced senescence and DNA damage, activating proteasome; vitamin D excluded from EU cosmetics.

nodes.label: Calcium Influx
summaries: Activation of GPCRs including ORs causes calcium influx into the cytoplasm, reported by fluorogenic calcium dyes.

nodes.label: Carbon Nanoparticles
summaries: Adsorb MTT substrate, producing false-positive cytotoxicity.

nodes.label: Carnosol
summaries: Rosemary phenolic diterpene antioxidant formed from carnosic acid; oxidizes to rosmanol.

nodes.label: Carrier Peptides
summaries: Peptides facilitating transport of trace elements such as copper and manganese, important for wound healing and enzymatic processes.

nodes.label: Castor Oil
summaries: Ricinus communis seed oil; inexpensive polar solvent and good pigment-wetting agent; main solvent to grind pigments but not obligatory.

nodes.label: Castor Oil Derivatives
summaries: Rheology modifiers that increase viscosity of anhydrous formulations like lipsticks and mascaras; require controlled heat and shear.

nodes.label: Catechin
summaries: Polyphenolic component associated with Nrf2 activation.

nodes.label: Cetyl Dimethicone
summaries: Alkyl dimethicone that lowers oil surface tension, adds silicone-like feel and increases sunscreen SPF via more uniform films.

nodes.label: Preservative Challenge Test
summaries: Test verifying effectiveness of the preservative system; compulsory in EU, not in US.

nodes.label: Chamomile Extract
summaries: Only plant extract approved as whitening QD (Kao, 1998, 0.5%); anti-inflammatory endothelin receptor antagonist reducing melanocyte activation.

nodes.label: Charge Stabilization
summaries: Ionic double layer around droplets creates electrical repulsion; used almost exclusively in O/W emulsions with soaps, phosphate esters or cationics.

nodes.label: Chinese INCI Name
summaries: Chinese labels must list ingredients by Chinese INCI names from the MOH Catalogue of International Cosmetic Ingredients; importers must apply if missing.

nodes.label: Cholesterol Sulfate
summaries: Minor SC lipid that inhibits serine proteases, protecting corneodesmosomes until degraded by sterol sulfatase in outer layers.

nodes.label: Chromatography
summaries: TLC, HPLC and GC used for phytochemical identification and standardization of extracts.

nodes.label: Chrysin
summaries: Flavone from passion flower, chamomile and honeycomb; aromatase inhibitor in vitro, effective topically; suggested at 1%.

nodes.label: Cigarette Smoking
summaries: Cigarette smoke exposure causes significant skin compromise in smokers and nonsmoking spouses; associated with telangiectasia and premature wrinkling.

nodes.label: Cleansing
summaries: Wetting the substrate, removing soil and suspending it to prevent redeposition; surfactant tails attach to soil, which lifts off as emulsion droplets.

nodes.label: Clitoris
summaries: Small erectile organ of crura, body and glans; glans covered by over 8,000 nerve endings and protected by the clitoral hood.

nodes.label: Club Hair
summaries: Fully keratinized dead hair with a club-shaped end formed during catagen and later shed in exogen.

nodes.label: Coal-Tar Dyes (Certified Colors)
summaries: Petroleum-derived color additives that must be FDA batch-certified because of possible contamination, e.g. FD&C Red No. 40, FD&C Yellow No. 5.

nodes.label: Coconut Oil
summaries: Lauric acid triglyceride with high affinity for hair proteins that penetrates the shaft due to low molecular weight and linear chain; excellent conditioner.

nodes.label: Collagen Degradation
summaries: MMP cleavage of collagen into peptides and amino acids; in cellulite destroys trabeculae.

nodes.label: Collagen VII
summaries: Anchoring fibril collagen decreasing with aging; biochemical marker of wrinkles.

nodes.label: Collagenase
summaries: Enzyme degrading collagen, causing wrinkles; induced by AP-1.

nodes.label: Color-Scent Association
summaries: Color is perhaps the strongest cue aligning expectations: blue-calm/watery/ozonic, green-fresh/nature, red-sexy/powerful, purple-luxury/mystery.

nodes.label: Concept Testing
summaries: 'Proof of concept' testing in which relevant parties are interviewed, surveyed or join focus groups to prove a concept might work before further analysis.

nodes.label: Hair Conditioner
summaries: Product that conditions, smooths and lowers friction; after-color conditioners used post-dyeing.

nodes.label: Continuous Innovation
summaries: New product requiring almost no change in consumer behavior, e.g. a hand lotion with a new nonactive ingredient; most new products are of this type.

nodes.label: Convention on Biological Diversity
summaries: UN-sponsored convention calling for compensation of communities and source countries for traditional knowledge and materials used commercially.

nodes.label: Copyright
summaries: Protection for original works; in cosmetics covers packaging layouts, slogans, labels and advertising; US term life plus 70 years.

nodes.label: Corallina pilulifera Extract
summaries: Marine alga extract preventing UV-induced oxidative stress and MMP-2/MMP-9 expression in dermal fibroblasts.

nodes.label: International Cosmetic Ingredient Dictionary
summaries: PCPC (former CTFA) publication of INCI names; updated every two years until 2010, online as wINCI from 2011; new names requested online via INCI application.

nodes.label: Mandatory Cosmetic Warning Statements
summaries: US warnings required for unsubstantiated safety (21 CFR 740.10), aerosols, feminine deodorant sprays and foaming detergent bath products.

nodes.label: Cosmetovigilance
summaries: Reporting of serious undesirable effects by the RP to authorities (Art. 23) and market surveillance by Member States (Art. 22).

nodes.label: Crème Gel
summaries: Emulsion without traditional emulsifiers stabilized by the polymeric rheology modifier; shows higher yield stress than conventional emulsions.

nodes.label: Cross-Functional Collaboration
summaries: Cooperation among marketing, R&D and manufacturing, dual-degree staff and employee training recommended to raise product success rates.

nodes.label: Cross-Linking Theory
summaries: Also called glycosylation theory: abnormal cross-links between proteins/DNA irreversibly alter structures like collagen and enzymes, causing wrinkling.

nodes.label: Cryotherapy
summaries: Liquid nitrogen treatment for idiopathic guttate hypomelanosis; risks post-inflammatory hyper/hypopigmentation in dark skin.

nodes.label: Cryptochromes
summaries: CRY1-2 repressors forming PER/CRY complex that blocks CLOCK/BMAL1 transactivation.

nodes.label: CU TR Declaration of Conformity
summaries: Conformity document for all other cosmetics; issued to a CU-registered legal entity for a specific contract, limited to one client and contract duration.

nodes.label: Eurasian Customs Union
summaries: Customs Union of Russia, Belarus and Kazakhstan formed January 1, 2010 with common tariffs and customs code; single economic area from 2012.

nodes.label: Cuticle
summaries: Posterior nail groove; thin epithelium from the ventral proximal nail fold over the proximal nail plate. Loss of cuticle leads to paronychia.

nodes.label: CYP26B1
summaries: Cytochrome P450 enzyme in epidermal keratinocytes essential for retinoic acid metabolism; ablation disrupts barrier formation.

nodes.label: Death Hormone Theory
summaries: Hypothalamic aging chronometer; pituitary may release DOCH, inhibiting cell use of thyroxin and accelerating aging.

nodes.label: Deep Sleep (Stage N3)
summaries: Slow-wave sleep (~20% of total) when the major human growth hormone pulse is released.

nodes.label: Dermal Filler
summaries: Cross-linked HA such as Juvederm used in cosmetic surgery; allergic reactions have been reported.

nodes.label: Dermatoglyphic Pattern
summaries: Pattern of shallow surface lines in young skin that becomes fewer, deeper and more oriented with aging.

nodes.label: Design Patent
summaries: Protects nonfunctional ornamental appearance (e.g., cosmetic bottles, Vaseline jar USD407982); 14-15 years; also called industrial design.

nodes.label: Desmosine
summaries: Cross-link binding four elastin chains, formed from three allysine and one lysine.

nodes.label: Diabetes
summaries: Accelerates glycation and AGE accumulation; drives pharmacological research benefiting cosmetic anti-glycation.

nodes.label: Dictyopteris Membranacea Extract
summaries: Alga water extract down-regulating MITF, OA1, MART1 and MLPH; reduced pigmentation up to 36% in three months at 3%.

nodes.label: Diethyl Phthalate
summaries: Very good carrier for all product types, but many consumer-product companies no longer allow its use.

nodes.label: Diindolylmethane
summaries: DIM, active anti-estrogenic compound of cruciferous vegetables; suggested ~0.5% in anti-cellulite topicals.

nodes.label: Dimethicone/Vinyl Dimethicone Crosspolymer
summaries: Silicone crosspolymer in which reactive dimethicone backbones are cross-linked by flexible vinyl dimethicone.

nodes.label: 1,4-Dioxane
summaries: Routine impurity tested in China with MoS calculation if traces present.

nodes.label: Dipeptide-2
summaries: ACE-inhibiting dipeptide marketed by Sederma as Peptide VW for anti-aging.

nodes.label: Dipeptide Diaminobutyroyl Benzylamide Diacetate (Syn-Ake)
summaries: Synthetic peptide mimicking Waglerin 1 from Temple Viper venom; Botox-like via acetylcholine receptor.

nodes.label: DKK-1
summaries: Dickkopf-1, secreted by DHT-induced dermal papilla cells; inhibits keratinocyte growth.

nodes.label: DMFT/DMFS Index
summaries: Clinical caries index summing Decayed, Missing and Filled teeth or surfaces used in anticaries trials.

nodes.label: DNA Damage Theories of Aging
summaries: Group of theories holding that accumulated DNA damage inhibits cell function and gene expression, leading to cell death and skin aging.

nodes.label: Doctrine of Equivalents
summaries: Infringement where an element performs substantially the same function in substantially the same way for the same result.

nodes.label: Dose Metrics for Nanomaterials
summaries: Mass-based doses may be inappropriate for nanomaterials; particle number or surface area may better predict dose-response.

nodes.label: Dry Eye Syndrome
summaries: Common disorder in which tear film hyperosmolarity drives ocular surface inflammation.

nodes.label: Dynamically Continuous Innovation
summaries: Major change in a minor behavior or minor change in a major behavior, e.g. a hand lotion moving from jar to pump dispensing.

nodes.label: Dyspareunia
summaries: Painful intercourse; not due to lack of arousal; ospemifene approved for it.

nodes.label: EAC Conformity Mark
summaries: EurAsian Conformity mark (Decision 711, 2011) required on CU-certified products instead of GOST R mark; minimum 5 mm.

nodes.label: Eccrine Sweat Gland
summaries: Most numerous skin appendage (up to 600/cm2), cholinergically controlled, producing odorless dilute sweat (Cl-, Na+, lactic acid, urea) for thermoregulation.

nodes.label: Echinacoside
summaries: Phenylpropanoid from Echinacea angustifolia (1-2% of dry root) produced by plant cell culture; used in anti-aging products.

nodes.label: Eco-Responsibility
summaries: Long-term production management balancing raw materials, process energy, waste, effluents and product impacts; described as the 'eco-responsibility tsunami' following the green wave and organic tide.

nodes.label: Elaunin Fiber
summaries: Elastic fibers parallel to the skin plane in papillary dermis; network gradually lost with age.

nodes.label: Rapid Emulsion Stability Screening
summaries: Test with 47% oil, 47% water, 5% emulsifier, 1% salt mixed 120 s at 50 °C giving stability information within 3-24 hours.

nodes.label: Enzyme Inhibitor Peptides
summaries: Peptides that directly or indirectly inhibit enzymes, e.g., ACE-inhibiting di- and tripeptides.

nodes.label: Enzyme Biology-Based Skin Care Marketing
summaries: Challenge of explaining slow, cumulative enzyme-based anti-senescence to consumers confused by 'percentage claims' and immediate-results marketing.

nodes.label: EP Class I (Caucasian I)
summaries: Northern European/Canadian origin; pale, very fair, ruddy freckled; thin sensitive dry skin, burns easily, ages rapidly; skin cancer most common; avoid sun and harsh treatments.

nodes.label: EP Class II (Caucasian II)
summaries: Central/Southern European and USA origin; fair with light olive undertones; burns then tans, early aging, acne prone, greater skin cancer risk; peels and lasers with caution.

nodes.label: EP Class III (Caucasian III)
summaries: Australia, Turkey, South Africa etc.; fair medium olive; seldom burns, normal to oily skin; thicker darker scars; hyperpigmentation tendency with sun.

nodes.label: EP Class IV (Hispanic/Latino)
summaries: Latin American origin; medium to dark olive; rarely burns, moderate aging, darker scars; hyperpigmentation, acne prone; caution with deep peels and laser.

nodes.label: EP Class IX (Native American/Alaskan)
summaries: Native American and Alaskan origin; medium olive with red undertones; high sun tolerance, leathery with age; hyperpigmentation/melasma.

nodes.label: EP Class VIII (Pacific Islander)
summaries: Native Hawaiian and Pacific Islander origin; medium-dark olive, thick oily skin; prone to hyperpigmentation, melasma; keloid tendency.

nodes.label: EP Class XI (Mixed Race)
summaries: Mix of two or more races; consider predominant traits, start with milder programs and evaluate ancestry before peels, lasers, hydroquinone or retinoids.

nodes.label: Epicatechin
summaries: Catechin polyphenol associated with Nrf2 activation.

nodes.label: Epicuticle
summaries: Cuticle layer ~120 nm thick beneath the 18-MEA monolayer; with the exocuticle it has the highest sulfur content in the fiber.

nodes.label: Epigenome
summaries: Totality of epigenetic tags 'running' the genome; varies by cell type; 98% of adult somatic cell genome silenced.

nodes.label: Epinephrine
summaries: Adrenaline; binds alpha-2-adrenergic receptors constricting skin arteries; elevated levels delay wound healing and re-epithelialization.

nodes.label: In Vitro Epithelial Cell Models
summaries: Models (Mattek, Skin Sensitive) mimicking oral and nasal linings that produce defensins; alternative to animal testing.

nodes.label: Escherichia coli
summaries: Pathogen not allowed in CU cosmetic samples.

nodes.label: Essential Oil Blend
summaries: Most limited, most expensive natural fragrance using only whole essential oils (citrus, herbal, lavender, woody, few florals), with seasonal price swings.

nodes.label: Ethnobotany
summaries: Study of plant use by traditional peoples; the ethnobotanically directed survey evaluates traditional uses in assays to develop actives.

nodes.label: PCA Ethyl Cocoyl Arginate
summaries: Amino acid cationic conditioning agent (CAE) giving greater bending strength (bounce) than STAC or DSTMAC and repairing cuticle.

nodes.label: European Patent Convention
summaries: Treaty with EPO offering single application, search and examination for 38 countries (2012); 9-month post-grant opposition.

nodes.label: Exogen
summaries: Active, controlled shedding phase of the club fiber, typically near renewed anagen onset; 100-150 hairs shed per day is normal.

nodes.label: Plant Extraction
summaries: Maceration, separation (filtration) and concentration of actives using solvents; eco-responsible extraction uses biodegradable water and ethanol and recycles solvents.

nodes.label: Fatty Alcohols
summaries: High-molecular-weight alcohols such as cetearyl alcohol used as thickeners, emulsifiers, emollients, opacifiers and foam boosters in O/W and W/O emulsions.

nodes.label: Ferulic Acid
summaries: 0.5% combined with 15% vitamin C and 1% vitamin E protected skin against solar-simulated UV damage (erythema, sunburn cells, thymine dimers, cytokines).

nodes.label: Feughelman Two-Phase Model
summaries: 1959 model by Max Feughelman treating keratin fibers as crystalline rods (C phase) in parallel with a water-sensitive amorphous matrix (M phase) to explain moisture-dependent viscoelasticity.

nodes.label: File Wrapper (PAIR)
summaries: Collection of application documents and office correspondence retrievable via USPTO PAIR or European Patent Register.

nodes.label: First-to-File System
summaries: Since March 16, 2013, US awards patents to the first inventor to file, harmonizing with the rest of the world.

nodes.label: Flaxseed Oil
summaries: Granolin project oil rich in linoleic and linolenic acids from reintroduced flax cultivation in central France.

nodes.label: Flexural Rigidity
summaries: Mechanical property combining bending modulus and shape; coiled fibers and high friction raise bundle flexural rigidity and body.

nodes.label: Floral Water
summaries: Distillation by-product of essential oils; easy organic extract but hard to preserve; can replace deionized water.

nodes.label: Folic Acid
summaries: Methyl donor; with B12, choline and betaine fed to pregnant agouti mice methylated agouti gene.

nodes.label: Follicle Miniaturization
summaries: Androgen-triggered conversion of terminal to vellus follicles in genetically predisposed frontal scalp, causing thinning and baldness.

nodes.label: Formaldehyde Releasers
summaries: DMDM hydantoin, imidazolidinyl urea, diazolidinyl urea, quaternium-15 among commonly used preservatives.

nodes.label: Fractional Laser
summaries: Fractional laser treatments used to reduce pigmentation.

nodes.label: Fragrance Bloom
summaries: Burst of fragrance when water is added to a rinse-off product, often the key evaluation point for rinse-off categories.

nodes.label: Fragrance Quality Control
summaries: QC compares production batches to a standard by triangle test plus flash point, refractive index, specific gravity and color specifications.

nodes.label: Fragrance Storytelling
summaries: Conveying a sensory story visually and verbally in the brief to stimulate the perfumer, then releasing it to consumers through all sensory cues.

nodes.label: Franz Diffusion Cell
summaries: Used with 14C-HA on porcine ear skin at 37°C for 48 h; 357 kDa HA taken up by epidermis but hardly into dermis.

nodes.label: Free Acid Bioavailability
summaries: Only undissociated free acid penetrates skin; formulation pH is the most important factor for AHA efficacy.

nodes.label: Free Radical Theory of Graying
summaries: Theory by Arck et al. that melanocyte apoptosis from oxidative stress in the pigmentary unit causes graying.

nodes.label: Freedom to Operate Analysis
summaries: Determines whether a product, process or name infringes others' valid IP in target countries; remedies include design-around, invalidation or licensing.

nodes.label: Freeze-Thaw Testing
summaries: Stability test cycling temperature that can reveal phase separation into distinct layers.

nodes.label: Fructosamine-3-Kinase
summaries: FN3K: skin's own de-glycation enzyme system stimulated by Bay cedar extract.

nodes.label: Functional (Formational) Appliances
summaries: Dental appliances creating bite imbalance and pressure to trigger mechanotransduction and bone remodeling.

nodes.label: GB 5296.3-2008 Cosmetic Labeling
summaries: Chinese cosmetic labeling standard; industry applies a Chinese 'patch' over original labels.

nodes.label: Gelatinases (MMP-2, MMP-9)
summaries: MMPs attacking type IV collagen, fibronectin and laminin.

nodes.label: Genomic Identification
summaries: PCR-amplified short DNA fragments (especially mitochondrial) to authenticate species, variety and origin, ensuring traceability and detecting adulteration.

nodes.label: German Chamomile
summaries: Matricaria recutita L.; selected variety has 3% vs 1% flavonoids, needing three times less plant mass and giving 65% lower carbon footprint.

nodes.label: Glabridin
summaries: Strong antioxidant in licorice root extract used for whitening in Asia.

nodes.label: Glutamates
summaries: Very mild anionic surfactants (e.g. sodium cocoyl glutamate) acceptable for natural formulations.

nodes.label: Glutathione Peroxidase
summaries: Enzyme removing hydrogen peroxide; up-regulated by resveratrol and 4-hexylresorcinol.

nodes.label: Glyceryl and Polyglyceryl Esters
summaries: Nonionic emulsifiers; glyceryl esters low HLB; polyglyceryl esters effective W/O emulsifiers.

nodes.label: Glycine Betaine
summaries: Most active natural osmoprotectant for E. coli; found in urine and accumulated by kidney medulla cells.

nodes.label: Glyoxal
summaries: Reactive dicarbonyl glycotoxin (GO) from Amadori stage forming AGEs.

nodes.label: Golgi Apparatus
summaries: Vesicle-forming system that receives proteins from the ER for release outside the cell.

nodes.label: Good Laboratory Practice
summaries: Principles nanomaterial safety studies should ideally follow along with OECD guidelines.

nodes.label: GOST R Certification
summaries: Former Russian declaration/certificate of conformity with GOST R mark, second step of pre-2012 dual assessment; valid until July 1, 2014.

nodes.label: Green IP Sharing
summaries: Donating or licensing sustainability IP for modest fees, e.g. WBCSD Eco-Patent Commons and Nike's GreenXChange.

nodes.label: Green Marketing Model
summaries: Strategic marketing planning framework: internal analysis, external analysis, SWOT, objectives and budget, marketing strategy and program, and control and evaluation.

nodes.label: Green Star Rating
summaries: Metric (US patent application 20090259409) summing green star value times actives percentage per ingredient to quantify formulation greenness.

nodes.label: Greenwashing
summaries: Overinflating a product's or company's green attributes; fear of accusation can prevent sustainable innovation; OI helps overcome the perception.

nodes.label: Guar Gum
summaries: Natural gum with pseudoplastic rheology; synergistic with clays.

nodes.label: Hair Body
summaries: Perception of abundant strong hair best described by bundle flexural rigidity, depending on fiber density, protein density, inter-fiber friction and temporary shapes.

nodes.label: Hair Dullness
summaries: Sign of aged hair addressed with oils, esters, silicones and amino acid cocktails.

nodes.label: Hair Fiber Diameter
summaries: Shaft thickness, which decreases with follicle aging; peaks ~age 20 in men and mid-40s in women.

nodes.label: Halogenated Salicylanilides
summaries: Di-, tri-, metabromsalan and tetrachlorosalicylanilide; prohibited in US cosmetics due to photocontact sensitization (21 CFR 700.15).

nodes.label: Halophytes
summaries: Salt- and drought-tolerant coastal plants (Salicornia, Rock Samphire) producing protective secondary metabolites.

nodes.label: Hand Lotion
summaries: Used as the example product for continuous (new nonactive ingredient) and dynamically continuous (jar to pump) innovation.

nodes.label: Hand Sanitizer
summaries: Hydroalcoholic gel; 60-90% alcohol gels can be thickened with 1% carbomer neutralized with triisopropanolamine to pH 7.5.

nodes.label: Hectorite
summaries: Clay used as master gel in lipsticks to reduce sweating and control rheology.
Clay based on magnesium silicate, lighter in color than bentonite.

nodes.label: Heterochromatin
summaries: Tightly condensed transcriptionally silent chromatin; telomeres are hypermethylated heterochromatin.

nodes.label: High-Density Water
summaries: Highly reactive intracellular water state; its increase generates ROS and impairs repair, leading to aging.

nodes.label: Histidine
summaries: Amino acid with pKa 6.8 (cytoplasmic pH); protonation of its side chain modulates activity of numerous proteins.

nodes.label: Histones
summaries: Alkaline nuclear proteins that package DNA into nucleosomes; their modifications regulate transcription, repair and replication.

nodes.label: Histone Deacetylation
summaries: SIRT1 removal of acetyl groups from histones reducing chromatin polarity, causing condensation and gene silencing.

nodes.label: Homeostasis
summaries: Equilibrium of the internal environment; disturbances decrease cell and organism function.

nodes.label: Human Polynucleotide Phosphorylase
summaries: hPNPase (old-35): RNA-degrading enzyme upregulated in senescence; promotes ROS, activates NF-kB and IL-6/IL-8; proposed target.

nodes.label: HSP27
summaries: Heat-shock protein directly associated with 26S proteasome.

nodes.label: Hydrodynamic Volume
summaries: Effective volume a polymer occupies in solvent; greater hydrodynamic volume (good solvent, expanded coil) gives higher viscosity.

nodes.label: Hydroxypropyl Guar
summaries: Nonionic natural gum derivative with pseudoplastic properties that builds viscosity quickly and imparts lubricity; compatible with alcohols, electrolytes and surfactants.

nodes.label: Hyponychium
summaries: Distal nail groove where skin epithelium meets the nail plate, forming a seal protecting the nailbed from infection and trauma.

nodes.label: Hypothalamus
summaries: Brain region governing hormone release; proposed site of the aging chronometer.

nodes.label: Idea Generation
summaries: First NPD step; ideas come from customers, competitors, employees, suppliers, universities, R&D and even other industries, often via brainstorming led by a technical marketing expert.

nodes.label: Idiopathic Guttate Hypomelanosis
summaries: Hypopigmented 1-6 mm spots on forearms and shins affecting nearly 80% of people over 70; sun exposure thought to play a role.

nodes.label: Immunosenescence
summaries: Age-related decline in immune response mainly due to T-cell decline.

nodes.label: Indirect Infringement
summaries: Inducement or contributory infringement; requires underlying direct infringement.

nodes.label: Inner Root Sheath
summaries: Three-layer sheath (IRS cuticle, Huxley's and Henle's layers) whose keratins and trichohyalin support and mold the growing shaft and anchor it.

nodes.label: Insulin-Like Growth Factor 1
summaries: IGF-1, anagen-maintaining growth factor produced by the dermal papilla with receptors in matrix cells; decreased expression precedes catagen.

nodes.label: Intelligent Targeting Carrier
summaries: PLGA capsules with PVA shell and covalently bound peptide ligands recognized by fibroblasts, melanocytes or adipocytes to deliver actives intracellularly.

nodes.label: Intercellular Penetration Pathway
summaries: Tortuous route between corneocytes through intercellular lipids (gaps about 0.013 micrometers); main route for most hydrophilic and lipophilic molecules.

nodes.label: Interferons
summaries: Cytokine glycoproteins released in response to pathogens or tumor cells that activate immune defenses and interfere with viral replication.

nodes.label: Interleukin-6
summaries: Pro-inflammatory cytokine elevated in older skin.

nodes.label: Iron Oxides
summaries: Yellow iron oxide has fairly high oil absorbance.

nodes.label: Isethionates
summaries: Mild esters of isethionic acid and fatty acids used in syndet bars.

nodes.label: Iterative Screening
summaries: Repeated rounds of screening with libraries of structurally related compounds or extracts plus sensory evaluation to optimize hit compounds.

nodes.label: Kenogen
summaries: Phase in which the follicle is empty after club fiber shedding and before new anagen; more frequent and longer in androgenetic alopecia.

nodes.label: Keratin 38
summaries: Keratin whose asymmetric distribution in the eyelash bulb produces the curved fiber.

nodes.label: Keratolytic
summaries: Substance that softens keratin and loosens the horny layer so dead cells shed.

nodes.label: Koilonychia
summaries: Spoon-shaped thin, soft, concave nails resulting from iron deficiency, usually associated with anemia; part of Plummer-Vinson syndrome.

nodes.label: Lactylates
summaries: Reaction products of fatty acid and lactic acid; emulsifiers and foam boosters; seen as naturally derived.

nodes.label: Lamin B1
summaries: Nuclear envelope constituent declining in senescent fibroblasts and keratinocytes, mediated by miR-23a.

nodes.label: Langerin
summaries: Calcium-dependent C-type lectin (CD207) binding mannose; antigen capture receptor on Langerhans cells that induces Birbeck granules.

nodes.label: Lanthionine
summaries: Thioether cross-link formed from cystine and OH ions during alkaline relaxing; proposed to lock in the straight shape.

nodes.label: Lauryl PEG-8 Dimethicone
summaries: Alkyl dimethicone copolyol emulsifier used in an emulsifier kit for rapid regular/inverse emulsion screening.

nodes.label: LC3-II
summaries: Specific autophagy marker increasing after H2O2 oxidative stress recovery.

nodes.label: Light Interference Patterns
summaries: Colorful microscopic thin-film interference patterns (LIPs) produced by lifted cuticle cells with air pockets; used as an optical microscopy technique to detect cuticle damage.

nodes.label: Initiation
summaries: Free radicals from heat, metals, enzymes or light abstract hydrogen alpha to double bond forming lipid radicals.

nodes.label: Lipoteichoic Acid
summaries: Lactobacillus cell-wall molecule associated with immune stimulation via TLR2.

nodes.label: Lipstick Sweating
summaries: Liquid droplets appear on stick from molecular movement at elevated temperature or ingredient incompatibility; reduced by clay gels.

nodes.label: Liquid Foundation
summaries: Often water-in-silicone emulsions using silicone nonionic emulsifiers and dispersants for pigments.

nodes.label: Literal Infringement
summaries: Every claim element has identical correspondence in the accused product or process.

nodes.label: Loricrin
summaries: Cross-linked protein of the cornified envelope found in keratohyalin granules.

nodes.label: Lung Inflammation
summaries: In rats, 25 nm TiO2 caused steeper inflammation per mass than 250 nm; curves overlapped when dosed by surface area.

nodes.label: Madrid Protocol
summaries: WIPO system for filing a single trademark application across many countries.

nodes.label: Magnesium Aluminum Silicate
summaries: Clay thickener used synergistically with xanthan or guar gum.

nodes.label: Magnolignan
summaries: Dipropyl-biphenyl-2,2'-diol polyphenol that slows tyrosinase maturation; QD for Kanebo 2005 at 0.5%.

nodes.label: Mandelic Acid
summaries: Aromatic lipophilic AHA (phenylglycolic acid) with affinity for sebum, useful for oily and acne-prone skin.

nodes.label: MAP Kinase Pathway
summaries: Mitogen-activated protein kinase cascade activated by ROS-induced cytokines leading to AP-1 formation.

nodes.label: Marketing Concept
summaries: Principle that no new products are developed unless it can be proven that a large enough group of people will buy them; product development is thus driven by marketing analysis rather than innovation.

nodes.label: Mattifying
summaries: Reduction of skin shine by absorbing sebum; elastomer sponge left after solvent evaporation absorbs excess sebum for continuous matte appearance.

nodes.label: Mechanotransduction
summaries: Cell signaling by mechanical stimuli (stretch, deformation) detected by periodontal mechanoreceptors, changing gene expression and inducing osteogenesis.

nodes.label: Menopause
summaries: Natural cause of hypoestrogenic vulvar atrophy; vulvar mechanical sensitivity declines after menopause.

nodes.label: Menstrual Cycle
summaries: Monthly endometrial growth and collagenolytic shedding by MMPs; proposed source of the collagenase that initiates cellulite.

nodes.label: Mercury
summaries: Toxic element limited to 1.0 mg/kg in CU cosmetics with over 1% natural raw materials.

nodes.label: Mercury Compounds
summaries: Restricted in US: eye-area cosmetics below 65 ppm Hg (about 100 ppm phenylmercuric acetate/nitrate) only if no other preservative works; other cosmetics below 1 ppm unavoidable trace.
Prohibited or severely restricted in US (except thimerosal listings).

nodes.label: Metal Oxide Nanoparticles
summaries: Adsorb cytokines in ELISAs, falsely reducing inflammation readouts.

nodes.label: Methionine
summaries: Antioxidant amino acid; stimulates connective tissue regeneration.

nodes.label: Mica
summaries: Effect pigment with irregular jagged platelets; size restricted ≤150 microns in some eye products.

nodes.label: Micellar Solubilization
summaries: IUPAC: incorporation of a solubilizate into or on micelles; nonionics are best solubilizers, e.g. for fragrance in clear shampoos.

nodes.label: Microcomedo
summaries: Initial lesion of acne, prevented by retinoids decreasing debris retention in follicles.

nodes.label: Milk Thistle
summaries: Plant grown near Chartres: seeds give silymarin, and seed cake yields omega-6-rich oil transesterified into a silicone-substitute mono-ester.

nodes.label: miR-125b
summaries: Potent melanogenesis regulator inversely related to pigment levels, modulated by promoter methylation.

nodes.label: miR-200 / miR-205
summaries: Highly expressed skin microRNAs targeting ZEB1/ZEB2, repressors of E-cadherin, maintaining epithelial stability.

nodes.label: Misbranded Cosmetic
summaries: Under FD&C Act Sec. 602, a cosmetic with false or misleading labeling, missing or inconspicuous required information, or a misleading container.

nodes.label: Mood Board
summaries: Visual collage in the fragrance brief conveying olfactive story, color direction and product personality to the perfumer.

nodes.label: Messenger RNA
summaries: RNA type coding the chemical blueprint for a protein during synthesis.

nodes.label: Myrosinase
summaries: Plant enzyme degrading sinigrin into volatile toxic molecules as a natural defense; inactivated at 75 C drying.

nodes.label: N-Acetylhydroxyproline
summaries: Converts to hydroxyproline (a collagen amino acid) in skin and improves barrier function.

nodes.label: NADPH Oxidase
summaries: 'Professional' ROS-producing enzyme (Nox1) and major source of UVA-induced ROS in keratinocytes and fibroblasts; activated by intracellular calcium and ceramide.

nodes.label: Nailbed
summaries: Living dermal tissue below the nail plate with capillaries and glands giving the plate its pink color; its epidermis lacks stratum lucidum and granulosum.

nodes.label: Nanoparticle
summaries: Nanosized carriers penetrating via intercellular and follicular pathways; can deliver lipophilic compounds without transdermal penetration with up to 5000-fold solubilization; used in sunscreens and foundations.

nodes.label: Natural and Organic Ingredients
summaries: Certified organic or natural ingredients chosen by marketing over synthetics, which can pose manufacturing constraints; this business has been plagued by dusting.

nodes.label: N-Nitrosodiethanolamine
summaries: Nitrosamine impurity (NDELA) routinely tested in China with MoS.

nodes.label: Neuropeptides
summaries: Peptides released from cutaneous and immune cells in response to stress; regulate cutaneous immune response, itch, pain, pigmentation and inflammation.

nodes.label: New Cosmetic Ingredient Registration (China)
summaries: Approval needed before using any ingredient not on the CFDA list; extremely time-consuming; only three approved since 2008.

nodes.label: Nitrosamines
summaries: Inevitable impurities among EU forbidden substances, allowed only in technically unavoidable traces.

nodes.label: Nondisclosure Agreement
summaries: Confidentiality contract (NDA/CDA) protecting trade secrets and confidential information.

nodes.label: Nonionic Emulsifiers
summaries: Best for low-pH O/W emulsions, combined low/high HLB with long-chain fatty alcohol.

nodes.label: Nonobviousness
summaries: Patentability condition that the invention is not obvious to a person skilled in the art (35 USC 103, EPC Art. 56); hinders broad formulation patents in US.

nodes.label: Nucleosome
summaries: Repeating unit of chromatin in which DNA coils around histones, resembling a bead on a string.

nodes.label: Odor Instability
summaries: Fragrance fading or 'turning' to unpleasant odor during stability testing, possibly from reaction with the base or actives.

nodes.label: OECD TG 431 In Vitro Skin Corrosion
summaries: Human skin model test using the MTT viability assay, vulnerable to nanomaterial interference.

nodes.label: Olfaction
summaries: Sense of smell mediated by ~350 odorant receptors; like piano keys, odorants activate one or several ORs producing perceived smells.

nodes.label: Olfactory Saturation
summaries: Temporary, reversible blocking of odor receptors after smelling a strong material at high concentration.

nodes.label: Olive Leaf Extract
summaries: In blend with jujube and levan said to reactivate the proteasome.

nodes.label: Onychocyte
summaries: Cornified nail cells produced in sheets by the matrix that lose their nuclei and make up the nail plate.

nodes.label: Onychoschizia
summaries: Horizontal splitting of the nail plate in layers, common in women and older age; caused mainly by repeated water immersion and nail polish/removers.

nodes.label: Organic Cosmetics
summaries: Not regulated in the EU; in China organic claims are basically prohibited, third-party certifications not accepted; 95% organic content needed for official 'organic' mark under GB/T 19630.

nodes.label: Oryza Plant Meristem Cell Extract
summaries: Rice-genus meristem cell suspension extract shown in vitro to restore youthful DNA methylation in aged fibroblasts; first US-patented epigenetic cosmetic ingredient.

nodes.label: Osmosis
summaries: Water diffuses out of swollen polymer networks into the high-salt skin region, collapsing the network and causing breakdown during rub-in.

nodes.label: Osmotic Pressure
summaries: 40-50% glycerin or sorbitol inhibits almost all cosmetic-relevant microbes; concentrated products are self-preserving.

nodes.label: Osmotic Stress
summaries: Loss of internal cellular pressure from water loss causing aged skin appearance.

nodes.label: OTC Drug
summaries: Over-the-counter drug category; anticaries fluoride products are regulated as drugs under US monograph 21 CFR Parts 310, 355 and 369.

nodes.label: Oxidative Metabolism
summaries: Cellular respiration in mitochondria converting glucose and oxygen into CO2, water and energy stored as ATP.

nodes.label: Oxidized/Carbonylated Proteins
summaries: Noxious products accumulating with stress and age, reducing epidermal transparency; normally degraded by proteasome.

nodes.label: Oxytalan Fiber
summaries: Thin (10-12 nm) elastic fibers perpendicular to the DEJ in papillary dermis; shortened and nearly gone by the ninth decade.

nodes.label: p16-pRB Pathway
summaries: Senescence pathway; p16 is up-regulated when miR-24 declines.

nodes.label: p53-p21 Pathway
summaries: Key senescence-regulating pathway modulated by microRNAs.

nodes.label: p63 (DNp63)
summaries: Transcription factor; DNp63 is master regulator of stratification maintaining epithelial stem cell proliferative potential; major miR-203 target.

nodes.label: Palmitoyl Tripeptide (Syn-Coll)
summaries: Thrombospondin I-derived signal peptide promoting collagen synthesis via TGF-beta; anti-wrinkle and stretch-mark claims.

nodes.label: Palmitoylation
summaries: Adding a palmitoyl fatty-acid group to a water-soluble peptide to increase lipophilicity and penetration of the stratum corneum.

nodes.label: Protease-Activated Receptor 2
summaries: PAR-2, critical for melanosome transfer from melanocytes to keratinocytes.

nodes.label: Para-Cortical Cell
summaries: Cortical cell type dominating straight hair; curly hair has para and ortho cells in separate cortex regions.

nodes.label: Patent Cooperation Treaty
summaries: WIPO treaty (1970) giving a unified international filing procedure across 146 countries (2012); examination reverts to national offices.

nodes.label: PEG-12 Dimethicone
summaries: Dimethicone copolyol giving slower antiperspirant active release (43% at 30 min) than PEG-8/PPG-8 dimethicone.

nodes.label: Peppermint Oil
summaries: Essential oil from which menthol is crystallized as a natural isolate.

nodes.label: Perfume
summaries: Fragrance products; ethanol-based perfumes subject to SASO 585/2000 in KSA; fragrances had separate pre-2012 CU assessment.

nodes.label: Peroxide Value
summaries: Iodometric AOCS titration of peroxides (meq/kg) in oils or formulations; indicates onset of rancidity.

nodes.label: Peroxynitrite
summaries: Reactive species derived from nitric oxide; initiator of aging.

nodes.label: Petrolatum
summaries: Applied to scalp before 'base' relaxers to protect against irritation; pre-formulated in no-base relaxers.
Petroleum jelly; can interfere with condom use.
Occlusive compared in barrier recovery test.

nodes.label: Phenolic Diterpenes
summaries: Rosemary antioxidants that form successive active antioxidants on oxidation.

nodes.label: Phormidium Extract
summaries: Blue alga (stromatolite-forming) extract whose glucoside-biopterin activates thioredoxin, reducing UV dimers.

nodes.label: Photo-Oxidation
summaries: Light excites a photosensitizer (e.g. chlorophyll); Type I directly forms lipid radicals, Type II forms singlet oxygen producing hydroperoxides.

nodes.label: Photocontact Sensitization
summaries: Light-induced skin sensitization; basis for the US ban on bithionol and halogenated salicylanilides.

nodes.label: Photomelanosis
summaries: Increased pigmentation on sun-exposed skin (face, neck, back), patchy or diffuse; also called sun damage.

nodes.label: Endogenous Photosensitizers
summaries: Skin chromophores (porphyrins, riboflavin, ubiquinone, NADH/NADPH, trans-urocanic acid) that generate ROS under UVA.

nodes.label: 3T3 Neutral Red Uptake Phototoxicity Test
summaries: First in vitro method approved by CFDA (February 2012), the only accepted in vitro method in China.

nodes.label: Pilosebaceous Unit
summaries: Follicle plus sebaceous gland, targeted by major hormonal pathways and acting as a peripheral producer of steroid hormones, neuropeptides and neurotrophins.

nodes.label: Piper Longum Fruit Extract
summaries: Promotes blood circulation, keratinocyte proliferation, filaggrin synthesis, inhibits melanin synthesis and glycation.

nodes.label: Placental Extract
summaries: Bovine (later porcine) placenta quasi-drug whitening active thought to increase cell turnover; bovine use abandoned after BSE in 2001.

nodes.label: Polybutene
summaries: Synthetic giving extremely high shine but very tacky on lips.

nodes.label: Polyethylene Glycol
summaries: Ethylene oxide polymers of varied molecular weight used as thickeners, humectants, lubricants and co-gelling aids; below MW 700 they are liquid at room temperature.

nodes.label: Polysilicone-11
summaries: Silicone compound listed as adding positive feel and performance to lipsticks.
Highly refined silicone elastomer offered in many solvent combinations, balancing chain length and cross-link density for oil absorption and smooth texture.

nodes.label: Polysorbate 20
summaries: Common fragrance carrier and polysorbate surfactant used to pre-solubilize fragrance oils in water-soluble fragrances.

nodes.label: Polyvinylpyrrolidone
summaries: PVP, a styling polymer for shaping hair, used in gels and mousses.

nodes.label: Proopiomelanocortin
summaries: POMC activated by UV-induced keratinocyte cytokines releasing alpha-MSH and endothelin; down-regulation stops keratinocyte-melanocyte signaling.

nodes.label: 4-Methoxy Potassium Salicylate
summaries: 4MSK; competitive tyrosinase inhibitor; QD for Shiseido in 2003.

nodes.label: Potassium Nitrate
summaries: Desensitizer that reduces pulpal nerve sensitivity by depolarizing nerve membranes.

nodes.label: Pro-Oxidant Effect
summaries: At high concentrations α-tocopheroxyl radical re-initiates lipid oxidation; nullified by co-antioxidants.

nodes.label: Procollagen
summaries: Precursor synthesized in fibroblasts and processed by proteolytic enzymes into 300-nm collagen triple helix filaments.
Amla extract induces procollagen production in fibroblasts dose-dependently.

nodes.label: Product Brief
summaries: Document led by Brand Development/Marketing outlining objective and strategy (brand identity, target consumer, positioning, pricing, distribution, ship date); refined into fragrance and creative briefs.

nodes.label: Profilaggrin
summaries: High molecular weight, histidine-rich, highly phosphorylated precursor protein dephosphorylated and clipped into filaggrin units.

nodes.label: Programmed (Built-in Breakdown) Aging Theories
summaries: Theories holding aging is a direct consequence of genetic programming, a molecular clock built into genome and cell structure.

nodes.label: Prohibited Cattle Materials
summaries: Banned in US cosmetics to protect against BSE; excludes tallow with at most 0.15% insoluble impurities, tallow derivatives, hides and milk products.

nodes.label: Promotion Strategy
summaries: Marketing communication mix of advertising, PR, direct marketing, sales promotion and personal selling, combining push marketing to retailers and pull marketing to consumers.

nodes.label: Protein Kinases
summaries: Enzymes that phosphorylate proteins on tyrosine or serine/threonine, activated by signaling pathways.

nodes.label: Pseudo-Catalase PC-KUS
summaries: Narrow-band UV-activated pseudo-catalase that reduced epidermal H2O2 and repigmented eyelashes and skin in a University of Bradford study.

nodes.label: Pseudomonas
summaries: Gram-negative genus growing over pH 3-11 and in shampoos and conditioners.

nodes.label: Pyrophosphate
summaries: Most common anticalculus agent in tartar control toothpastes; interferes with calcium phosphate crystal growth.

nodes.label: RAPEX
summaries: EU rapid alert system for non-food consumer products; Member States report market anomalies published weekly, frequently involving cosmetics.

nodes.label: Recombinant Technology
summaries: Genetically modified organisms express specific peptides and compounds, e.g. hyaluronic acid in bacteria.

nodes.label: Red Algae Galactans
summaries: Reduced stress-induced telomere shortening 65%; limited POT1 and TPP1 decline.

nodes.label: REM Sleep
summaries: Dreaming sleep (20-25%) consolidating memory; disrupted by high nighttime cortisol.

nodes.label: Resource Scarcity
summaries: Limited natural resources from population growth (toward 9 billion) and destruction of rare plants; a driver pushing companies to embrace sustainability.

nodes.label: Retinyl Palmitate
summaries: Retinol ester permitted at <=1% in KSA.
Retinol ester shown to be metabolized to retinol and free acid in skin.

nodes.label: Retinyl Propionate
summaries: Retinol ester; 0.3% improved wrinkling and hyperpigmentation after 12 weeks.

nodes.label: RGD Sequence
summaries: Arginine-glycine-aspartic acid sequence that facilitates wound healing by binding receptors signaling collagen renewal.

nodes.label: Rhododendrol
summaries: 4-(4-hydroxyphenyl)-2-butanol, a competitive tyrosinase inhibitor found in white birch; QD for Kanebo 2007.

nodes.label: Four-Step Risk Assessment
summaries: SCCS approach: hazard identification, dose-response assessment, exposure assessment, risk characterization; steps 3-4 compulsory under 1223/2009.

nodes.label: RNA-Induced Silencing Complex
summaries: RISC composed of DICER1, TRBP and AGO2; guided by mature microRNA to degrade fully complementary mRNA or inhibit translation.

nodes.label: Safety Assessor
summaries: Qualified expert (Art. 10) who writes the CPSR and supervises scientific/technical compliance; must have relevant EU degree and cosmetic experience.

nodes.label: Sapienic Acid
summaries: C16:1 delta6 fatty acid; notable antimicrobial fatty acid released from sebum triglycerides.

nodes.label: SASO 585/2000 Perfumery Products Based on Ethanol
summaries: Requires ethanol denaturation; products with <8% fragrance limited to 250 ml with nonremovable pump and 'for external use only' warning in Arabic.

nodes.label: SCCS Guidance on Safety Assessment of Nanomaterials in Cosmetics
summaries: 2012 SCCS guidance listing characterization parameters (size, morphology, surface, solubility, surface area etc.) and recommending characterization in raw, formulated and test states.

nodes.label: SCCS Notes of Guidance
summaries: SCCS guidelines for testing cosmetic ingredients and safety evaluation; define a 4-step risk assessment and MoS calculation.

nodes.label: Scleroderma
summaries: Autoimmune disease with excessive collagen deposition and fibrosis; associated with decreased let-7a, miR-150, miR-7 and increased miR-92a.

nodes.label: Scutellaria Baicalensis Extract
summaries: Baicalin-standardized extract delaying telomere erosion, 10% more fibroblast doublings; improved roughness and elasticity clinically.

nodes.label: Secondary Metabolites
summaries: Plant compounds for adaptation and protection (terpenoids, alkaloids, phenylpropanoids) often present at low levels.

nodes.label: Secondary Oxidation Products
summaries: Carbonyl compounds (aldehydes, ketones, fatty acids) responsible for rancid odor and color.

nodes.label: Sederma
summaries: Company that introduced Matrixyl and Peptide VW.

nodes.label: Senescence-Associated MicroRNAs
summaries: SA-miRs modulating senescence pathways; overlap with inflamma-miRs and onco-miRs.

nodes.label: Sensory Dissonance
summaries: Consumer confusion experienced when bottle, packaging, color story and scent are not aligned.

nodes.label: Serum
summaries: Typical cosmetic product supplemented with HA.
Skin care product example with amino acid cocktail and hyaluronic acid.

nodes.label: Service Mark
summaries: Mark identifying the source of a service rather than a product (e.g., CosmoProf).

nodes.label: Shape Memory Polymer
summaries: Polymers able to memorize a permanent shape, be fixed in a temporary shape and recover on a stimulus (heat, moisture, light, electricity); hair behaves as a semi-crystalline cross-linked SMP.

nodes.label: Shea Butter
summaries: African vegetable butter for richer touch; long transport impacts carbon footprint.

nodes.label: Shelf Life
summaries: Extended by antioxidants reducing oxidation rate.

nodes.label: Shift Work
summaries: Associated with obesity, metabolic syndrome, elevated cortisol, breast and prostate cancer via circadian disruption and altered clock gene methylation.

nodes.label: Siliconyl Waxes
summaries: Silicone-modified beeswax, carnauba, candelilla and polyethylene that improve compatibility of silicones in formulas.

nodes.label: Skin Sensitization
summaries: Allergic sensitizing potential of products investigated with GPMT or LLNA.

nodes.label: Sleep Hygiene
summaries: Regular schedule, no afternoon caffeine (half-life ~4.9 h), no alcohol or smoking before bed, dark quiet room, exercise not near bedtime.

nodes.label: Sleep Stages
summaries: 4-5 cycles of 90-120 min: N1 (~5%), N2 (~50%), N3 deep sleep (~20%) and REM (20-25%).

nodes.label: Tobacco Smoking
summaries: Causes baggy eyes, hollow cheeks, lines and large pores in twin studies; impairs HDAC2.

nodes.label: Sodium Bisulfite
summaries: Sulfite reagent of 'Japanese' straightening, more selective to disulfide bonds but prone to shape reversion in tight curls.

nodes.label: Sodium Lactate
summaries: Humectant absorbing high moisture at high humidity.

nodes.label: Solid-State Fermentation
summaries: Carbon-rich solids (bran, paper pulp) used slowly; recyclable nutrient source; common for fungi and food-waste biomass.

nodes.label: Solvent Extraction
summaries: Extraction of plant material with a hydrophobic solvent (yielding a concrete) or ethanol (yielding an absolute).
Most common extraction using ethanol, methanol, IPA, ethyl acetate, acetone or hexane to enrich compounds by polarity.

nodes.label: Soybean Oil
summaries: Triglyceride whose surface tension (~32 dynes/cm) is lowered by alkyl silicones; used with ethyl methicone as D5 replacement.

nodes.label: Spray Drying
summaries: Fast high-temperature drying needing carriers like maltodextrin or lactose that dilute actives.

nodes.label: Squamous Cell Carcinoma
summaries: About 20% of skin cancers; about 2% metastasize.

nodes.label: Stable Cell Line
summaries: Clonal populations of genetically identical cells derived from a single cell introduced with the OR gene; offers well-characterized properties.

nodes.label: Steric Stabilization
summaries: Nonionic emulsifier film around droplets; requires most formulation work but withstands extreme pH, electrolytes and oil polarities.

nodes.label: Submerged Fermentation
summaries: Liquid media in enclosed stainless tanks; nutrients used quickly, robust growth and easy purification.

nodes.label: Substance P
summaries: Neuropeptide that stimulates melanocytes and increases dendricity; basis of 'neurowhitening'.

nodes.label: Sulfonates
summaries: Anionics from sulfonation of alpha olefins, used in hand wash; stable over wide pH.

nodes.label: Superordinate Goal
summaries: Resource scarcity creates a goal that normally opposed parties (competitors, NGOs) agree to work on together.

nodes.label: Sustainable Harvest
summaries: Harvesting non-timber products indefinitely with negligible impact on plant populations (Peters); steps: species selection, forest inventory, yield studies, harvest levels, monitoring.

nodes.label: SWOT Analysis
summaries: Summary of a situation analysis into Strengths and Weaknesses (internal factors) and Opportunities and Threats (external factors) for decision-making and risk reduction.

nodes.label: Synthetic Polymer Thickeners
summaries: Acrylic acid-based homopolymers, copolymers and crosspolymers that swell on neutralization, typically used at 0.1-0.5%; limited by salt, pH, shear and UV sensitivity.

nodes.label: Trichloroacetic Acid Peel
summaries: TCA peel, safe with experienced dermatologists, good option for severe melasma.

nodes.label: Test Marketing
summaries: Releasing a product in specific stores or regions before broad launch to reduce risk of failure; can tip off competitors and is little used in personal care.

nodes.label: Tetra-isopalmitoyl Ascorbic Acid
summaries: Oil-soluble vitamin C QD (Nikko, 2007, 3%) preventing UV-induced pigmentation through antioxidant action.

nodes.label: Heat Buffering by Hair
summaries: Moisture absorption and desorption by keratin releases and absorbs heat, letting hair and wool buffer scalp temperature; 1 kg of dry wool going 40-70% RH releases ~164 kJ.

nodes.label: Thioredoxin
summaries: Small redox antioxidant protein activated by glucoside-biopterin from Phormidium that prevents UV dimer formation.

nodes.label: Thymine Dimers
summaries: UV DNA damage prevented by vitamin C/E combinations and green tea.

nodes.label: Traditional Knowledge Digital Library
summaries: Indian database documenting traditional medicine knowledge in formats patent examiners understand, preventing misappropriation via patents.

nodes.label: Topical Corticosteroids
summaries: Steroids used for vitiligo and, at low potency, for pseudofolliculitis inflammation.

nodes.label: Total Body Water
summaries: Sum of intracellular and extracellular water (ICW+ECW=TBW).

nodes.label: Traditional Fragrance
summaries: Standard mixture of natural and synthetic materials with 5-20% carrier labeled as 'fragrance'; most common, versatile and cost-stable, and the default supplied.

nodes.label: Tranexamic Acid Cetyl Ester Hydrochloride
summaries: Whitening QD approved 2009 for Chanel with Nikko, the first non-Japanese company; mechanism similar to tranexamic acid.

nodes.label: Transdermal Delivery
summaries: HA enhances partitioning of diclofenac and ibuprofen into skin; HA-based liposomes, microemulsions and micelles can more than double penetration.

nodes.label: Transfersome
summaries: Deformable liposome containing surfactant in its bilayer that can deform and pass intact between SC cells following the water gradient (Cevc).

nodes.label: TRF2
summaries: Telomeric-repeat binding factor-2 stabilizing telomeres; expression declines with senescence.

nodes.label: Trigeminal Response
summaries: Separate neurological pathway triggered by odorants like ammonia, making such odors nearly impossible to neutralize with fragrance alone.

nodes.label: Triglycerides
summaries: 57% of sebum; partially hydrolyzed on the skin surface to release fatty acids, some antimicrobial.

nodes.label: Trihydroxystearin
summaries: Thixotropic castor oil derivative providing high viscosity, emulsion stability, water repellency and pigment suspension; used with organoclays in mascara.

nodes.label: Trimethylsiloxyphenyl Dimethicone
summaries: Phenyl-modified silicone with higher refractive index for more shine; reduces tack of acrylic polymers.

nodes.label: TRPV1
summaries: Acid-sensitive ion channel mediating glycolic acid-induced keratinocyte proliferation and ATP release; TRPV channels may underlie AHA stinging.

nodes.label: Type I Collagen
summaries: Predominant collagen of the reticular dermis; reduced in photo-aged skin.

nodes.label: Type III Collagen
summaries: Collagen of the papillary dermis, low in reticular dermis; reduced in photo-aged skin.

nodes.label: Tyrosine
summaries: Amino acid precursor of melanin, oxidized to DOPA.
Amino acid oxidized by tyrosinase to form melanin.

nodes.label: Ubiquitin
summaries: 76-amino-acid protein (~8500 amu) marking proteins for proteolysis; 96% identical between human and yeast; C-terminal gly-gly binding site.

nodes.label: Unscented INCI Blend
summaries: Simple blend of 2-3 neutral-smelling INCI materials that mitigates base odor without adding a recognizable fragrance, e.g. for eye or facial cream.

nodes.label: UV Filters
summaries: Sunscreen actives; EU positive list in Annex VI, allowed only in drugs in the US.

nodes.label: Vaginal Moisturizers and Lubricants
summaries: OTC products lacking definitive efficacy data, none designed for the vulva; may contain irritants like propylene glycol, parabens, perfumes, benzocaine.

nodes.label: Vellus Hair
summaries: Very short, nonpigmented, nonmedullated hairs covering the body; miniaturized follicles revert terminal to vellus hair.

nodes.label: Vitamin A
summaries: Exists as an aldehyde (retinal), alcohol (retinol) and carboxylic acid (retinoic acid), the latter being the active form in skin.

nodes.label: Volatile Sulfur Compounds
summaries: Malodorous compounds such as H2S and methyl mercaptan produced by anaerobic oral bacteria; bound by copper, zinc and tin ions.

nodes.label: Water Activity
summaries: aw = vapor pressure of product/pure water; most bacteria don't grow below 0.91, molds below 0.80, some microbes at 0.70; ERH = aw × 100; measured via equilibrium humidity.

nodes.label: Wetland Restoration
summaries: Alban Muller Group's 4,500 m2 water and biodiversity gardens returning 100,000 L/day of treated effluent to ponds, attracting amphibians, birds and bees.

nodes.label: Wetting
summaries: Spreading and coating of a surface by a liquid, defined by contact angle (Young's equation); lower-MW dimethicone copolyols wet faster.

nodes.label: World Intellectual Property Organization
summaries: UN agency dedicated to IP that administers the PCT and Madrid System.

nodes.label: Yellow Nail Syndrome
summaries: Nails almost stop growing and become yellow or greenish, thickened and curved.

nodes.label: Zeis Gland
summaries: Unilobular sebaceous glands at the eyelid margin secreting oil into lash follicles.

nodes.label: Zirconium-Containing Complexes
summaries: Prohibited in US aerosol cosmetics because of toxic lung effects including granuloma formation (21 CFR 700.16).

nodes.label: Abrasives
summaries: Dentifrice systems that mechanically remove extrinsic stain; abrasivity must stay within a safe range.

nodes.label: Acetyl-CoA Carboxylase
summaries: Biotin-dependent rate-limiting enzyme of epidermal fatty acid synthesis, converting acetyl-CoA to malonyl-CoA.

nodes.label: Acetyl-CoA Synthetase
summaries: AceCS2 activated by SIRT3, increasing oxidative phosphorylation and ATP.

nodes.label: Acid-Swellable Associative Thickeners
summaries: Acrylic amine polymers that swell when protonated by acids, thickening low-pH formulas.

nodes.label: Acrylamide
summaries: Routine impurity tested in Chinese safety assessment.

nodes.label: Acrylates/C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer
summaries: Hydrophobically modified cross-linked polyacrylic acid rheology modifier used widely in personal care.

nodes.label: Adenosine
summaries: Builds up in brain driving homeostatic sleep drive; blocked by caffeine.

nodes.label: Adenylate Cyclase
summaries: Transmembrane enzyme generating cAMP, directly activated by forskolin.

nodes.label: AGE-Reader
summaries: DiagnOptics device measuring skin AGEs noninvasively by autofluorescence at 370±50 nm; readings rise 0.023 units per year of age.

nodes.label: Age Spots
summaries: Darkening of skin areas attributed to excess lipofuscin.

nodes.label: Agouti Gene
summaries: Mouse gene whose methylation by maternal supplements yields brown, healthier offspring; BPA decreases its methylation.

nodes.label: Alagebrium
summaries: Former prescription AGE-breaker drug candidate that failed to reach market.

nodes.label: Alkyl Guanine Transferase
summaries: AGT DNA repair enzyme with activity peaking at midnight.

nodes.label: Aloesin
summaries: Key osmoprotective active in Aloe vera; derivatives with amino acids and peptides reported.

nodes.label: Alpha-Lipoic Acid
summaries: Dietary compound supported by modeling as HDAC inhibitor.

nodes.label: Aluminum Magnesium Hydroxide Stearate
summaries: Complex of aluminum magnesium hydroxide and stearic acid forming colorless, temperature-stable gels in cosmetic oils.

nodes.label: Amadoriases
summaries: Deglycating enzymes evidenced in vertebrates; not yet led to true AGE-breakers.

nodes.label: Ames Test
summaries: Mutagenicity test in five Salmonella strains showing dechloro ethylcloprostenolamide is nonmutagenic.

nodes.label: Amine Oxides
summaries: Foam stabilizers, viscosity boosters, solubilizers made by oxidation of tertiary amines.

nodes.label: Aminomethyl Propanol
summaries: Neutralizer recommended for carbomer at ~80% alcohol.

nodes.label: Androgen Receptor
summaries: Receptor found at higher levels in dermal papilla cells from balding scalp.

nodes.label: Anfinsen Ribonuclease Experiment
summaries: C. Anfinsen showed scrambled ribonuclease with re-formed disulfides could regain native shape with traces of mercaptoethanol/urea, explaining perm reversion.

nodes.label: Angiogenesis
summaries: Development of new blood vessels; stimulated by HA oligosaccharides of 6-20 units.

nodes.label: Annex III Restricted Substances
summaries: EU list of over 250 substances allowed only with concentration limits, use restrictions and warnings.

nodes.label: Anonychia
summaries: Rare congenital complete absence of nails; nail loss may also occur with lichen planus, irritant dermatitis to artificial nails, or trauma.

nodes.label: Anosmia
summaries: Inability to smell a specific material regardless of concentration, often genetic for certain musks or sandalwood; total anosmia is rare and usually from injury or medication.

nodes.label: Antagonistic Pleiotropy
summaries: One gene controlling multiple traits, at least one beneficial and one detrimental; apoptosis and senescence may be examples.

nodes.label: Anti-Glycation Compounds
summaries: Compounds investigated for improving aged skin.

nodes.label: Cellular Anti-Senescence
summaries: 'Single-bullet' anti-aging approach patented by Gupta and Walker that manages cellular senescence to retard skin aging.

nodes.label: Antioxidant Paradox
summaries: Clinical trials of antioxidants like vitamin E or SOD in humans largely failed despite animal efficacy, possibly due to pro-oxidant activity or failure to reach sites.

nodes.label: American Oil Chemists' Society
summaries: Publishes official OSI and peroxide value methods.

nodes.label: Apnea-Hypopnea Index
summaries: Events per hour of sleep: <=5 normal, 5-15 mild, 15-30 moderate, >30 severe OSA.

nodes.label: Apocrine Gland
summaries: Tubular gland attached to hair follicles in axillae, anogenital region; adrenergically controlled; odor arises from bacterial action on secretions.

nodes.label: Apparent Permanent Shape
summaries: Everyday hair shape, a quasi-permanent water set from fiber weight and inter-fiber interactions; real shape seen on water immersion (many wavy Caucasian fibers coil into circles).

nodes.label: AQSIQ
summaries: Chinese General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, authority for GB/T 19630 organic products.

nodes.label: Aquaporins
summaries: Water channel proteins; AQP3 and AQP8 (ammoniaporin, first found in skin via Salicornia research) support skin hydration.

nodes.label: Arabic Labeling Requirement
summaries: KSA requires at least Arabic for product function, warnings and special instructions.

nodes.label: Aromatase Inhibitor
summaries: Endocrine therapy used by breast cancer patients that causes ovarian dysfunction and vulvar atrophy.

nodes.label: Artificial Saliva
summaries: Products with humectants, lubricants, buffers and sometimes fluoride to relieve sensation of oral dryness.

nodes.label: Ascophyllum Nodosum Extract
summaries: Algae extract blocking endothelin adhesion to melanocytes; whitening confirmed in vivo.

nodes.label: Ashwagandha
summaries: Withania somnifera; successfully used Ayurvedic antioxidant.

nodes.label: Aspirin
summaries: Acetylates lysine amines, blocking glycation reaction sites as a sacrifice substance.

nodes.label: Deficient Immune System/Autoimmune Theory
summaries: With age the immune system fails to distinguish self from foreign proteins and antibody production declines.

nodes.label: Autoimmunity
summaries: Immune attack on self; strongest evidence for vitiligo pathogenesis; vitiligo associated with other autoimmune diseases.

nodes.label: Avocado Oil
summaries: Highly emollient, moisturizing oil, good for dry and frizzy hair.

nodes.label: Bacteriocins
summaries: Short-chain antimicrobial peptides from bacteria used to manage acne.

nodes.label: Ballistometry
summaries: Diastron pendulum instrument measuring skin indentation, rebound and elasticity (damping coefficient).

nodes.label: Barrier Cream
summaries: Developed on the WWII home front, with special toilet soaps, to reduce dermatitis among workers.

nodes.label: Basal Cell Carcinoma
summaries: Most common NMSC (about 75% of skin cancers); locally invasive, does not metastasize.

nodes.label: Base Excision Repair
summaries: BER cuts out small chemically altered bases and replaces them.

nodes.label: Bay Cedar Extract
summaries: Guazuma ulmifolia extract stimulating FN3K, partially restoring glycation damage; amplifies glycation decrease at acidic pH.

nodes.label: BB Cream
summaries: Cited example of a new-use patent: BB cream used for hair treatment.

nodes.label: Bed Hair
summaries: Temporary shape locked in by stress relaxation in the gel structure during sleep or hat wearing at room temperature.

nodes.label: Beeswax
summaries: White beeswax (Cera Alba) used in lipstick for stick shrinkage and mold release; synthetic grades available.

nodes.label: Benzyl Benzoate
summaries: One of the most common fragrance carriers.

nodes.label: Berberine
summaries: Plant alkaloid (traditional medicine) reported to activate AMPK.

nodes.label: Berne Convention
summaries: International treaty partly harmonizing copyright protection.

nodes.label: Beta-Glucocerebrosidase
summaries: Lamellar body enzyme converting glucosylceramides to ceramides; critical to barrier competency.

nodes.label: Beta Glucogallin
summaries: Biomarker compound of amla identified by HPLC, LCMS, NMR; Saberry standardized to 10%.

nodes.label: Bimatoprost
summaries: Ophthalmic prostaglandin analogue causing transient hyperemia; gave minimal lash enhancement in an alopecia areata patient.

nodes.label: Biofermentation
summaries: Emerging technology to benefit from natural molecules, e.g. producing propanediol from corn.

nodes.label: Biofilm
summaries: Dental plaque is a complex microbial biofilm varying by site and time and sensitive to ecological parameters.

nodes.label: Biological Markers
summaries: Identifiable substances, genes or characteristics indicating disease or abnormality; changes in gene and protein expression are the markers measured.

nodes.label: Biopiracy
summaries: Unauthorized use of genetic resources or traditional knowledge; wild collection may face biopiracy lawsuits under Nagoya.

nodes.label: Biotin
summaries: Covalently bound to histones (histone biotinylation; 11 sites in humans).

nodes.label: Bisphenol A
summaries: Polycarbonate plastic compound in containers; decreased agouti gene methylation in mice, counteracted by methyl-rich foods.

nodes.label: Bisulfites
summaries: Ingredients releasing sulfur dioxide odor; usually at low enough levels that fragrance can mitigate the smell.

nodes.label: Blind Fragrance Test
summaries: Consumers smell a fragrance on skin, on a blotter, then completely blind without sensory cues to assess purchase intent and descriptors.

nodes.label: Blow-Drying
summaries: Rapid drying that locks water-set shapes and volume; also causes thermal stress and cuticle buckling.

nodes.label: Blueberry Extract
summaries: Antioxidant chosen for anti-glycation potential in diabetic skin study.

nodes.label: Body Lotion
summaries: Leave-on product where fragrance hours after application may reassure consumers that moisturizing continues; mass-market body creams use higher fragrance intensity than high-end facial creams.

nodes.label: Boron Nitride
summaries: Synthetic ceramic powder with lamellar structure that glides; made from borax and nitrogen source; not natural despite name.

nodes.label: Sustainability of Botanicals
summaries: Growing demand pressures limited natural resources; crop rotation, replantation and high-yield varieties help.

nodes.label: Bottle Ergonomics
summaries: Designing bottle shape, weight and cap for emotional and functional feel, e.g. a tapered, dumbbell-weighted men's sport bottle with spray-through cap.

nodes.label: Brain Imaging
summaries: Proposed tool to study whether scents like chamomile produce calming brain activity patterns using selective OR-activating aromatics.

nodes.label: Bromelain
summaries: Fruit enzyme used for gentle exfoliation and smoothing.

nodes.label: Brosimum Alicastrum
summaries: Central/South American tree needing over 1.5 million seeds for one tree to reach reproduction; fruit overharvest could cause extinction.

nodes.label: c-Jun
summaries: Proto-oncogene expressed in basal epidermis targeted by miR-203; increased when miR-203 is suppressed in basal cell carcinoma.

nodes.label: C-Reactive Protein
summaries: Elevated blood levels in aging people indicate inflammatory disorder.

nodes.label: C-Xyloside
summaries: GAG synthesis stimulator tested with blueberry extract on diabetic skin over 12 weeks.

nodes.label: Calcium Aluminum Borosilicate
summaries: Smooth flat glass-like effect pigment enhancing lipstick feel.

nodes.label: Calpains
summaries: Proteases breaking down proteins that give cells shape and stability.

nodes.label: Canada
summaries: Market requiring mandatory cosmetic notification to Health Canada; defines nanomaterials as 1-100 nm or exhibiting nanoscale properties.

nodes.label: Canadian Food and Drugs Act
summaries: Canadian law with Cosmetic Regulations; Section 16 allows Health Canada to restrict unsafe ingredients.

nodes.label: Candelilla Wax
summaries: Euphorbia cerifera wax; typical lipstick hard wax needed for strength and shine.

nodes.label: Candida
summaries: Yeast genus that colonizes onycholytic nails giving yellow color and causes candidal onychomycosis.

nodes.label: Candida Saitoana Ferment
summaries: Fermentation broth extract increasing LC3 ~20%, reducing oxidized proteins and lipids, improving tone and radiance.

nodes.label: Carboxylates
summaries: Mild anionics used to reduce eye irritation of other anionics.

nodes.label: Carmine
summaries: Certification-exempt color additive of animal origin (21 CFR 73.2087).

nodes.label: Carnauba Wax
summaries: Copernicia cerifera wax; typical lipstick hard wax for strength and shine.

nodes.label: Carrageenan
summaries: Natural gum that thrives on shear and does not break down under high shear processing.

nodes.label: Casein Kinase
summaries: Phosphorylates PERs, regulating nuclear import and degradation.

nodes.label: Nucleus
summaries: Largest organelle and control center of the eukaryotic cell, repository of genetic information; contains the nucleolus and nuclear pores.

nodes.label: Cell Proliferation
summaries: Skin cell proliferation 30-fold higher at night than noon, minimizing UV damage.

nodes.label: Cementum
summaries: Thin mineralized layer covering the tooth root; easily worn away after gingival recession exposing dentin.

nodes.label: Centella Asiatica
summaries: Medicinal herb source of asiatic acid and pentacyclic triterpenoids.

nodes.label: Canadian Environmental Protection Act
summaries: CEPA 1999; cosmetic ingredients subject to its New Substances Notification Regulations.

nodes.label: Ceramide Nomenclature System
summaries: Letter system naming amide-linked fatty acid (N, A, O) and long-chain base (S, P, H), with prefix E for ester-linked fatty acid, e.g. ceramide AP.

nodes.label: Cetearyl Alcohol
summaries: Blend of cetyl and stearyl alcohol widely used as a rheological additive in lotions, creams and hair care.

nodes.label: Cetylpyridinium Chloride
summaries: Antimicrobial clinically demonstrated to reduce gingivitis.

nodes.label: Chemical Burn
summaries: Skin burns from highly alkaline relaxer processes; area needing improvement.

nodes.label: Chemical Depilatory
summaries: Hair removal option for pseudofolliculitis barbae.

nodes.label: Chitosan
summaries: Natural polymer listed among hair styling polymers (also chitosan PCA).

nodes.label: Chlorella Extract
summaries: Green microalga extract inhibiting MMP1 activity in vitro.

nodes.label: Chlorine Dioxide
summaries: Chlorine compound used as tooth bleaching agent.

nodes.label: Chloroform
summaries: Prohibited in US cosmetics based on animal carcinogenicity (21 CFR 700.18).

nodes.label: Chromosome
summaries: Linear DNA units of eukaryotes associated with histones and extended as chromatin.

nodes.label: Chronic Stress
summaries: Long-term overactivation of sympathetic nervous system and HPA axis; causes weight gain, hair loss, hypertension, and premature aging.

nodes.label: Aging as Chronic Wound Hypothesis
summaries: Hypothesis that skin aging resembles a chronic wound, justifying growth factor supplementation.

nodes.label: Chrono-Delivery
summaries: Timing drug/cosmetic delivery to circadian phase; topical formulations more efficient at night; chemotherapy timing optimized.

nodes.label: Chrysophyllum Extract
summaries: Inhibits type I collagen and vimentin glycation, preserving fibroblast motility and contractility.

nodes.label: Cosmetic Ingredient Review
