summaries: Independent expert panel meeting quarterly to evaluate cosmetic ingredient safety; its monographs are cited by FDA as information sources.

nodes.label: CITES
summaries: Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species, adopted 1973 in Washington and signed by 175 countries; classifies endangered plants in three appendices.

nodes.label: Citrus Oils
summaries: Essential oils obtained by squeezing fruit peels, a byproduct of the citrus food industry and therefore relatively inexpensive; supply affected by weather disasters.

nodes.label: Claim Substantiation
summaries: Testing the finished product, even when actives are clinically tested, so that marketing claims can be substantiated.

nodes.label: Facial Cleanser
summaries: Skin cleanser formulated with amino acid surfactants.

nodes.label: CLP Regulation 1272/2008
summaries: EU classification regulation used to define CMR categories for cosmetics.

nodes.label: Cocamide DEA
summaries: Alkanolamide; DEA-based materials have fallen into disfavor over toxicological concerns.

nodes.label: Cochlearia Extract
summaries: Increases proteasome activity in H2O2-stressed fibroblasts, decreasing protein oxidation.

nodes.label: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia
summaries: Non-medical therapy building understanding of insomnia and good sleep habits.

nodes.label: Coleus Forskohlii
summaries: Lamiaceae plant whose roots supply forskolin and antimicrobial coleus oil.

nodes.label: Comfrey
summaries: Symphytum officinale; root widely used in cosmetics while the flower contains toxic pyrrolizidine alkaloids.

nodes.label: Compression Therapy
summaries: Mild-compression pantyhose (10-15 mmHg at toe, near zero at groin) lowering interstitial pressure via Bernoulli's law to increase fat metabolism.

nodes.label: Contact Dermatitis
summaries: Reaction to nail cosmetics such as acrylic/sculptured nails that can lead to nail separation.

nodes.label: Contact Sensitization
summaries: Allergen-mediated activation of Langerhans cells which migrate to lymph nodes (CCL19) and activate allergen-specific T-cells.

nodes.label: Controlled Release Delivery
summaries: Delivery of actives via swellable polymer pore volume matched to active size, as with silicone elastomers.

nodes.label: Copper Chelation
summaries: Binding copper atoms of tyrosinase to reduce its activity; mechanism of kojic acid, ellagic acid and ergothioneine.

nodes.label: Cornflower
summaries: Plant used for soothing, softening eye care; grown in the Beauce region.

nodes.label: Corporate Social Responsibility
summaries: Annual evaluation of large companies' contribution to sustainable development, favoring eco-responsible partners.

nodes.label: CosIng Database
summaries: European Commission database on cosmetic substances and ingredients, an unofficial updated nomenclature source pending the Glossary.

nodes.label: Cosmetic Camouflage
summaries: Cover makeup helpful to conceal vitiligo on face and neck.

nodes.label: Cosmetic vs Drug Distinction
summaries: Regulatory separation of cosmetics from drugs, which the editor argues masks a single underlying need to reverse the effects of gravity and time.

nodes.label: Cosmetic Ingredient Hotlist
summaries: Health Canada list of prohibited and restricted cosmetic ingredients; no nanomaterials listed as of late 2012.

nodes.label: Cosmetic Notification Form
summaries: Must be submitted to Health Canada within ten days of making a cosmetic available, listing ingredients and concentrations.

nodes.label: Cosmetics Europe
summaries: European cosmetics industry association (former Colipa) publishing PIF and labeling guidelines.

nodes.label: Coty
summaries: Fragrance company (SVP Catherine Walsh) behind celebrity and designer brands including Marc Jacobs Dot; uses consumer testing to lead trends.

nodes.label: Country of Origin Labeling
summaries: Mandatory in KSA (MoCI Royal Decree M/5, 2010); 'Made in EU' or dual-origin wording not accepted.

nodes.label: CPAP Therapy
summaries: Continuous positive airway pressure 'pneumatic splint'; gold standard OSA therapy, but compliance issues.

nodes.label: CpG Islands
summaries: Clusters of CpG sites near promoter regions; <3% methylated in normal tissue; hypermethylated with age.

nodes.label: Consumer Product Safety Commission
summaries: US agency that regulates true soaps instead of the FDA.

nodes.label: Cellular Retinoic Acid Binding Protein II
summaries: Retinoid-responsive protein up-regulated by Rock Samphire like retinol.

nodes.label: Critical Gelation Concentration
summaries: Concentration at which an alkyl silicone stops an oil or silicone from flowing; 10-20 wt% in 50 cSt silicone fluid.

nodes.label: Critical Overlap Concentration
summaries: Polymer concentration (c*) above which molecules overlap and entangle, exponentially raising viscosity; ~1.25% for Aristoflex HMB in 62% ethanol.

nodes.label: Critical pH
summaries: pH ~5.5 below which tooth demineralization occurs; not an absolute value as solubility depends on acid amount, duration and ion levels.

nodes.label: Crodasorb UV-HPP
summaries: Polyester polyquaternized UV-B protectant substantive to hair (Croda).

nodes.label: Crude Sulfate Turpentine
summaries: Feedstock from which many synthetic fragrance materials are derived.

nodes.label: CU Unified Sanitary-Epidemiological Requirements (Decree 299)
summaries: 2010 CU document (28.05.2010) setting unified hygienic requirements and mandatory State Registration.

nodes.label: Cutometer
summaries: Most common skin elasticity instrument using negative pressure (20-500 mbar) suction probes; parameters Ue, Uv, Uf, Ur, Ua, R and ratios like Ur/Uf.
Measures dermal elasticity; visiometer measures roughness.

nodes.label: Cyclohexasiloxane
summaries: D6 cyclic silicone used to a lesser extent as D4 replacement.

nodes.label: Cystine
summaries: Sulfur-containing amino acid comprising about 9-12% of nail weight in hard keratin.

nodes.label: Daidzein
summaries: Isoflavone found with genistein in soy, lupin, fava beans and kudzu.

nodes.label: Dansyl Chloride Assay
summaries: In vivo fluorescent assay measuring SC cell turnover rate.

nodes.label: Dansyl Chloride Turnover Assay
summaries: Staining SC with fluorescent dansyl chloride and monitoring disappearance under UV light to measure SC turnover time.

nodes.label: Dectin-1
summaries: Surface receptor needed for full response to fungal beta-glucans (Brown et al. 2003).

nodes.label: Dendritic Cell
summaries: Antigen-presenting immune cells; at least four dermal subclasses that capture and present antigens to T-lymphocytes and induce tolerance.

nodes.label: Denham Harman
summaries: Scientist who proposed the free radical theory of aging in 1954.

nodes.label: Dental Pulp
summaries: Inner tooth tissue rich in nerves and blood vessels surrounded by dentin.

nodes.label: Dento-Facial Orthopedics
summaries: Removable night appliances applying forces to teeth and craniofacial bones to treat malocclusion and underdeveloped skeletal structures.

nodes.label: Diethylhexyl Syringylidene Malonate
summaries: Antioxidant photostabilizer designed by Chaudhuri that stabilizes avobenzone, with antioxidant activity superior to vitamin E.

nodes.label: Diglycerol Phosphate
summaries: DGP from marine prokaryote Archaeoglobus fulgidus; stimulates HSP27 associated with 26S proteasome.

nodes.label: 5,6-Dihydroxyindole
summaries: DHI; one of the chemical moieties (with DHICA) forming the melanin polymer.

nodes.label: Dimethylthetin
summaries: Sulfonium analog of glycine betaine equally effective as osmoprotectant for E. coli.

nodes.label: Distribution Strategy (Place)
summaries: Placement decisions choosing exclusive, selective or intensive distribution and retail channel mix, dependent on product and pricing strategies.

nodes.label: Disulfide Bond Interchange
summaries: Rearrangement of disulfide cross-links that, with residual stresses, drives shape reversion and stores temporary shapes in the matrix.

nodes.label: Divinyl Sulfone
summaries: Cross-linker used in commercial Juvederm HA filler.

nodes.label: DNA Methylation Age (Epigenetic Clock)
summaries: Age-associated methylation signatures correlate 0.96 with chronological age; ~80% more accurate than telomere-length clock.

nodes.label: Domestic Substances List
summaries: Canadian inventory of existing substances; substances not listed are new under NSNR.

nodes.label: Doshas
summaries: Basic energy types: Vata (air, motion), Pitta (bile, metabolism), Kapha (phlegm, growth); imbalance from genetics, stress, diet.

nodes.label: Draize Test
summaries: Primary ocular irritation scale from non-irritating (0-0.5) to moderately irritating (25.1-50).

nodes.label: Draves Wetting Test
summaries: ASTM D2281 wetting time for a standard skein of fiber or hair to sink in solution.

nodes.label: Drosha
summaries: Nuclear RNase III that with DGCR8 forms the microprocessor cleaving pri-microRNAs into pre-microRNAs.

nodes.label: Drug Registration and Listing System
summaries: Mandatory FDA registration for drugs (FD&C Act sec. 510, 21 CFR 207), unlike cosmetics.

nodes.label: Dual Fermentation
summaries: Growing multiple organisms simultaneously for bioactive expression with potential anti-aging benefits.

nodes.label: Dynamic Friction Coefficient
summaries: Measure of friction forces between solids; used for hair combing smoothness.

nodes.label: European Chemicals Agency
summaries: EU agency where substances over 1 tonne/year must be registered under REACH.

nodes.label: Echinacea Angustifolia
summaries: Plant requiring 3-4 years cultivation for roots; cell cultures produce echinacoside.

nodes.label: Eco-Design
summaries: Eco-conception of ingredients and products that generates innovative concepts and new technologies.

nodes.label: Eco-Responsible Plant Extraction
summaries: Application of eco-responsibility to plant extraction processes, chapter by Alban Muller.

nodes.label: Ecocert
summaries: Organic certification body; transesterification is an Ecocert-acceptable process.

nodes.label: Ectoine
summaries: Compatible solute osmoprotectant; NADA is its precursor.

nodes.label: Edematous Water
summaries: 'Wasted water' in inflamed or injured tissue manifesting as bloating, puffiness and swelling; not available to cells.

nodes.label: Eflornithine
summaries: Cream option for treating pseudofolliculitis barbae.

nodes.label: Elicitation
summaries: Abiotic (UV, temperature) or biotic (chitosan, methyl jasmonate, salicylic acid) elicitors up-regulate secondary metabolites like phenylpropanoids in plant cell cultures.

nodes.label: Endocrine Disruptors
summaries: Substances interfering with hormone systems; listed as a key ICCR regulatory topic.

nodes.label: Endocuticle
summaries: Non-cross-linked, negatively charged, water-swellable cuticle layer that is soft and acts as a viscoelastic cushion; site of cuticle failure when wet.

nodes.label: Endoplasmic Reticulum Retention
summaries: ORs expressed in ordinary lab cells become trapped in the ER, historically preventing cell-surface expression of native receptors.

nodes.label: Epionychium
summaries: Thin band of epithelium connecting the nail plate to the proximal skin.

nodes.label: Ergothioneine
summaries: Antioxidant amino acid and copper chelator that can inhibit copper-dependent tyrosinase.

nodes.label: Electrospray Ionization Mass Spectrometry
summaries: Characterizes MW of short HA oligomers up to 40-mer; cone voltage must be set carefully to avoid artifacts.

nodes.label: Estrogen Receptor
summaries: ERα and ERβ; genistein shows higher affinity for ERβ.

nodes.label: Ethyl Lactate
summaries: Solvent base: 15% in cream and 96% in anti-inflammatory transparent gel.

nodes.label: EU Cosmetics Regulation
summaries: European Union regulations requiring documentation of toxicological properties, driving data sharing from larger to smaller companies; European Cosmetic Directives.

nodes.label: EU Catalogue of Nanomaterials in Cosmetics
summaries: Public catalogue of nanomaterials used in cosmetics, due by January 11, 2014; nano provisions to be reviewed by July 11, 2018.

nodes.label: Evening Primrose
summaries: Cosmetic plant of the Beauce region used to moisturize dry skin.

nodes.label: Exfoliation
summaries: Mechanical or chemical removal of dead skin cells three times weekly to increase cellular turnover and speed brightening results.

nodes.label: Exocuticle
summaries: Highly cross-linked, sulfur-rich cuticle layer ~250 nm thick that makes the cuticle hard and abrasion resistant.

nodes.label: Facial Wipe
summaries: Product fragranced at very low level (e.g. 0.010%) using water-dispersible fragrance diluted in water.

nodes.label: Fair Packaging and Labeling Act
summaries: US law that, with the FD&C Act, regulates cosmetic labeling so packages give correct content information and allow comparison.

nodes.label: FAO
summaries: UN Food and Agriculture Organization; endorsed plant cell culture technology for secondary metabolite production.

nodes.label: Fatty Acids
summaries: Oil-phase additives providing viscosity, stability, foam stabilization and lubricity; derived from soybean, coconut and palm oils.

nodes.label: FDA Plant Inspection Checklist
summaries: FDA checklist covering buildings, equipment, personnel, raw materials, production, lab controls, records, labeling and complaints; overlaps with ISO 22716.

nodes.label: Fenton Reaction
summaries: Iron-catalyzed generation of hydroxyl radicals from hydrogen peroxide.

nodes.label: 5-Alpha Reductase
summaries: Enzyme (type II) converting testosterone to DHT; elevated in dermal papilla cells of balding scalp.

nodes.label: Flanker
summaries: Fragrance variation of an original, distinguished by color to communicate newness and extend brand lifecycle (e.g. Marc Jacobs Daisy versions).

nodes.label: Fluorapatite
summaries: More acid-resistant mineral formed when fluoride ion-exchanges with hydroxyl in hydroxyapatite.

nodes.label: Foundation
summaries: Pigmented face makeup; silicone elastomers first impacted oil-control foundations.

nodes.label: FOXO
summaries: Forkhead box oxidative stress transcription factors attenuated by SIRT1, aiding survival.

nodes.label: Fractional Distillation
summaries: Distillation of an essential oil separating components by differing boiling points to obtain natural isolates.

nodes.label: Fragrance Concentration-Cost Principle
summaries: Buying concentrated fragrance is most cost-effective: a $40/kg fragrance at 0.5% costs $0.20/kg product, while a diluted $20/kg version needs 1.3% costing $0.26/kg.

nodes.label: Fragrance Library
summaries: A fragrance house's collection of completed, approved but unsold formulas (tens of thousands) used for future requests; chosen formulas are removed once purchased.

nodes.label: Gamma-Tocotrienol
summaries: Increased fibroblast viability (optimum 40-80 µM), prevented H2O2-induced telomere shortening and telomerase loss.

nodes.label: Gap Junctions
summaries: Intercellular communication junctions; measured by Lucifer Yellow dye transfer; involved in calcium waves.

nodes.label: Garlic Oil
summaries: Food-derived material reported to activate AMPK.

nodes.label: Gas Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry
summaries: Multiresidual analysis used to determine allergen content in perfumes and essential oils.

nodes.label: GB 8372-2008 Toothpaste Standard
summaries: Chinese national standard specifying toothpaste requirements; oral care products not in either cosmetic category.

nodes.label: Genetics
summaries: Breakthroughs in understanding the genetic code, cited with epigenetics and biochemistry as enabling approaches to look younger.

nodes.label: Genetic Control Theory
summaries: Inherited longevity assurance genes and a biological clock determine aging; aging results from loss of capacity of dormant renewal cells to divide.

nodes.label: Genome Instability
summaries: Increased when circadian gene expression is uncoupled from cell cycle, promoting premature aging and cancer.

nodes.label: Geranylgeranylacetone
summaries: GGA: synthetic isoprenoid delaying senescence; clinically decreased TEWL, rosacea, sunspots, pore size; increased moisturization and firmness.

nodes.label: Geranylgeranylpropanol
summaries: GGP: maintained telomere length in pre-senescent cells (+1.45 kbp at 1.65 ppm).

nodes.label: Gingiva
summaries: Gum tissue surrounding teeth; healthy margin is firm, pink and forms a crevice no more than 3 mm deep.

nodes.label: Gingival Crevicular Fluid
summaries: Fluid exuding from gingival sulcus epithelium, similar to blood plasma; nourishes sulcular bacteria and carries host defense factors.

nodes.label: Glaucoma
summaries: Eye disease treated with prostaglandin analogue drops whose side effect is eyelash growth.

nodes.label: Global Hypomethylation
summaries: Age-related loss of methylation at non-island CpG sites; most important feature of aging cells.

nodes.label: Glucosamine
summaries: Cell and connective tissue-building, hydrating nutrient recommended in the supplement regimen.

nodes.label: Glutamate Dehydrogenase
summaries: Inhibited by SIRT4 ADP-ribosylation, reducing alpha-ketoglutarate and ATP.

nodes.label: Glycated Hemoglobin
summaries: Less invasive blood measure replacing skin biopsies for glycation severity.

nodes.label: Glycation Theory
summaries: Theory attributing aging and diseases (arterial stiffening, cataracts) to glycation; predominant in medical literature due to diabetes.

nodes.label: Good Agricultural Practices
summaries: Quality assurance for medicinal plants covering seeds, cultivation, crop rotation, minimal agrochemicals, optimal picking time, and trained personnel.

nodes.label: Good Botanical Practices
summaries: Proper collection, identification and permanent documentation of plant-based ingredients.

nodes.label: Gram-Negative Anaerobic Bacteria
summaries: Mature plaque bacteria (e.g. Fusobacterium nucleatum, Prevotella intermedia) producing volatile sulfur compounds, organic acids and endotoxins that drive gingivitis and malodor.

nodes.label: Granolin Project
summaries: Cosmetic Valley initiative reintroducing flaxseed cultivation in central France for full biomass use (oil and fiber insulation).

nodes.label: Granuloma
summaries: Lung lesion formation caused by zirconium complexes in aerosol cosmetics.

nodes.label: Grape Seed Extract
summaries: Inhibited type I collagenase up to 70% at 1.4%.

nodes.label: Grape Seed Procyanidins
summaries: With tocopherols inhibited AGE formation by 90% in BSA-glucose assay.

nodes.label: Green and Sustainable Personal Care
summaries: European and North American consumers trend towards sustainable green care; Ayurveda offers holistic botanical approach.

nodes.label: Green Tea
summaries: Source of epigallocatechin-3-gallate, an AMPK activator.

nodes.label: GTPase
summaries: Proteins acting as molecular switches turning cell signaling on or off.

nodes.label: Guanidine Hydroxide
summaries: Relaxer base generated in situ from calcium hydroxide and guanidine carbonate (mix/no-lye relaxers).

nodes.label: Hair Bleaching
summaries: Ammoniated peroxide bleaching reduces hair tensile strength.

nodes.label: Hair Conditioning
summaries: Positively charged cationic surfactants/polymers attach to net-negatively charged hair, easing brushing and improving appearance.

nodes.label: Hair Drying Rate
summaries: Rate of water evaporation controlling hydrogen bond re-formation; fast drying locks shapes in motion and builds volume.

nodes.label: Hair Porosity
summaries: Increase in fiber porosity caused by sunlight and photo-damage.

nodes.label: Hayflick's Entropy View of Aging
summaries: Hayflick defines aging as increasing molecular disorder (entropy), stochastic and thermodynamically driven, not gene driven.

nodes.label: Hemidesmosomes
summaries: Attach basal keratinocytes to the DEJ basement membrane.

nodes.label: Herboretum Association
summaries: Formed 2004; nine-hectare open-air plant laboratory at St. Ay near Orleans with over 1,000 plant species, thematic and ecological gardens and fauna observatories.

nodes.label: HET-CAM Test
summaries: In vitro test of mucous membrane irritation used in finished-product safety evaluation.

nodes.label: Histamine
summaries: Released from mast cell granules in response to heat or irritants.

nodes.label: Histone Methyltransferase
summaries: HMT adds methyl groups to histones; reversible via LSD1, PAD4, JMJDs.

nodes.label: HMG-CoA Reductase
summaries: Rate-limiting enzyme of epidermal cholesterol biosynthesis using NADPH.

nodes.label: Holy Grail of Lipsticks
summaries: Combining comfort, high shine and long wear (at least 4-6 h) in one product; attributes are contradictory since shine is a function of melt.

nodes.label: Hormesis
summaries: Low-dose stress effect; trace H2O2 slows age-dependent telomere shortening.

nodes.label: Hormone Replacement Therapy
summaries: Systemic HRT whose use dropped after the Women's Health Initiative showed small increased breast cancer, heart attack and stroke risks.

nodes.label: Heat Shock Factor 1
summaries: HSF1 transcription factor regulated by SIRT1 elevating heat shock protein chaperones.

nodes.label: Hydrodynamic Theory
summaries: Most accepted model of dentinal hypersensitivity: stimuli change fluid pressure in open tubules transmitted to pulp nerves as pain.

nodes.label: Hydrogen Bonding
summaries: Intermolecular force explaining water's high surface tension and silica/organoclay network structuring.

nodes.label: Hydrogenated Soybean Oil
summaries: Highly hydrophobic cost-reducing carrier for natural INCI fragrance blends.

nodes.label: Hydroxyethylcellulose
summaries: Pseudoplastic cellulose thickener and emulsion stabilizer compatible with cationic polymers in hair conditioners.

nodes.label: Hydroxypropyl Methylcellulose
summaries: Cellulosic used to thicken surfactant systems such as shampoos and body washes.

nodes.label: Hydroxypropylcellulose
summaries: Pseudoplastic cellulose thickener and emulsion stabilizer with film-forming properties for styling gels.

nodes.label: Hypodermis
summaries: Deepest skin layer (subcutis), composed primarily of lipocytes with fibrous septae for structure and support.

nodes.label: Identical Twin Studies
summaries: Monozygotic twins (Guyuron) show perceived age differences up to 11.25 years from smoking, sun, BMI and HRT differences.

nodes.label: In Silico Prediction Models
summaries: Computer prediction models for safety assessment, an ICCR discussion topic.

nodes.label: In Vitro Skin Model
summaries: Cell cultures and artificial skin used for screening; lack melanocytes, Langerhans cells and a realistic barrier.

nodes.label: Inflammation Theory of Aging
summaries: Free radicals attack membranes producing arachidonic acid via phospholipase A2; oxidized products cause inflammation, a self-perpetuating cycle accelerating aging.

nodes.label: Innate Immunity
summaries: First-line defense requiring no prior exposure; epithelial surfaces form 'one big immune system'.

nodes.label: Intended Use Doctrine
summaries: In the US, cosmetic vs drug classification depends on intended use determined by labeling/advertising claims, consumer perception and ingredients, not only composition.

nodes.label: Intense Pulsed Light
summaries: IPL with pigmentation filter reduces pigmentation, usually 3-4 treatments at 15-20 day intervals.

nodes.label: Interleukins
summaries: Pro-inflammatory polypeptides generating free radicals; decreased by HA fragments in dermis.

nodes.label: Ion Channels
summaries: Membrane components letting ions pass; ion-channel receptors change conformation to alter membrane potential.

nodes.label: IRB SpA
summaries: Italian company that fine-tuned plant cell culture technology for cosmetic phenylpropanoids.

nodes.label: Iris Pigmentation
summaries: Rare side effect of ophthalmic prostaglandins; not observed in 70,000 dechloro ethylcloprostenolamide users.

nodes.label: Iron-Chelating Agents
summaries: Protect against UV-induced free radical production.

nodes.label: ISO 9001
summaries: General quality management system standard; companies certified to it adapt easily to ISO 22716.

nodes.label: Isopropyl Lauroyl Sarcosinate
summaries: Amino acid ester; excellent solvent for organic UVB absorbers and helps inorganic blockers spread.

nodes.label: Keratinocyte Growth Factor
summaries: Growth factor supplied by the dermal papilla, critical for hair growth and melanogenesis (with BMP, HGF, IGF and SCF).

nodes.label: Kinetin
summaries: Isolated from herring sperm DNA in 1955 with natural antioxidant properties.

nodes.label: Koebnerization
summaries: Propensity of lesions such as vitiligo to occur at sites of trauma.

nodes.label: Kraurosis Vulvae
summaries: Progressive sclerosing atrophy with stenosis of the vaginal orifice and effacement of labia minora and clitoris.

nodes.label: Kukui Nut Oil
summaries: High in omega-3 and omega-6 fatty acids.

nodes.label: Labia Majora
summaries: Two longitudinal skin folds rich in adipose tissue, sebaceous and sweat glands enclosing the vulvar cleft.

nodes.label: Labia Minora
summaries: Thin pigmented skin folds without hair follicles, poor in sweat glands but rich in sebaceous glands.

nodes.label: Langer's Lines
summaries: Natural lines of tension in the skin that may influence orientation of aging line patterns.

nodes.label: Lanugo Hair
summaries: Very fine hair normally shed in utero or during the first weeks of life.

nodes.label: Lauroyl Arginine
summaries: Amphoteric amino acid surfactant aligning hair fibers, reducing frizz and increasing luster.

nodes.label: LDH Assay
summaries: Cytotoxicity assay; trace metal nanoparticles inhibit LDH giving false negatives.

nodes.label: Lecithin
summaries: Phosphatidylcholine; hydrating nutrient whose dietary deficiency is linked to cellular dehydration.

nodes.label: Edelweiss
summaries: Leontopodium alpinum; plant from which cell cultures were developed for phenylpropanoid extracts.

nodes.label: Lichen Planus
summaries: Inflammatory condition that can cause nail loss, shedding with scarring, striations, thinning and pitting.

nodes.label: Lichen Sclerosus
summaries: Develops with chronic vulvar inflammation, involving skin and mucous membranes of vulvar and rectal area.

nodes.label: Linolenic Acid
summaries: Omega-3 unsaturated fatty acid found in plant seed oils.

nodes.label: Lip Balm
summaries: Product that may enter the mouth and so requires GRAS fragrances.

nodes.label: Propagation
summaries: Lipid radicals react with oxygen forming peroxyl radicals and hydroperoxides in a chain reaction.

nodes.label: Termination
summaries: Radicals combine into stable nonradical secondary products (aldehydes, ketones) causing off-odor and off-color.

nodes.label: Lipstick Crush (Snap) Test
summaries: Crushing stick between fingers should give resistance and a snap, indicating sufficient crystallinity; alternative to Chatillon.

nodes.label: Lipstick Molding
summaries: Metal book molds (requiring flaming to remove seams) or silicone molds allowing unusual shapes without flaming; silicone ingredients can cause problems in silicone molds.

nodes.label: Lithium Hydroxide
summaries: Strong base used in no-lye alkaline relaxers.

nodes.label: Human Longevity-Associated Genes
summaries: 150 long-life variants of 70 genes found in ~80% of centenarians; form protein interaction networks.

nodes.label: Low-Density Water
summaries: Low-reactivity water predominant in macromolecular-crowded cytoplasm.

nodes.label: Lubricity
summaries: Reduction in friction when two surfaces rub together; influences sensory perception of creams and lotions.

nodes.label: Lucifer Yellow Dye Transfer Assay
summaries: Fluorescent marker diffusing via gap junctions to assess cell communication.

nodes.label: Hamilton and Ludwig Scales
summaries: Grading scales for male (Hamilton II-III) and female (Ludwig I-2 to I-4) hair loss used to enroll study subjects.

nodes.label: Lutein
summaries: Carotenoid shown to improve skin moisturization, elasticity and photoprotection.

nodes.label: Lysyl Oxidase
summaries: Enzyme converting lysine to allysine in elastin.

nodes.label: Magnolol
summaries: Used with honokiol in anti-inflammatory gel and in anti-aging cream (0.2%).

nodes.label: MALDI-TOF
summaries: Mass spectrometry suitable for polydisperse HA mixtures, salt tolerant and sensitive but not quantitative.

nodes.label: Malodor
summaries: Undesired odors such as body or bathroom odor that fragrance blockers could eliminate.

nodes.label: MAPK/ERK Pathway
summaries: Protein chain relaying a signal from a surface receptor to nuclear DNA via phosphorylation; involved in tumor formation and cell growth.

nodes.label: Marine Algae
summaries: Source of phlorotannins, sulfated polysaccharides and tyrosinase inhibitors for skin care.

nodes.label: Marula
summaries: Sclerocarya birrea, South African tree supplying food, timber, medicine and oil for personal care; governance combines statutory law and traditional custom.

nodes.label: MAC and MUCAP
summaries: Maximum approved concentration and maximum used concentration in approved products; exceeding MUCAP requires safety evidence.

nodes.label: MDQ Resin
summaries: Silicone resin with M, D and Q groups and lower cross-link density; can be plastic-like or rubbery depending on Q:D ratio.

nodes.label: Me-Too Products
summaries: Products differing only in ingredient combinations rather than new technology; new technology is the point of difference.

nodes.label: Medium-Chain Triglycerides
summaries: Medium-chain vegetable triglycerides used as inexpensive stable carrier oils for natural INCI blends.

nodes.label: Meibomian Gland
summaries: Eyelid sebaceous glands secreting lipid to form the tear film.

nodes.label: Meissner Corpuscle
summaries: Mechanoreceptor detecting transient light touch on vulva and extragenital sites.

nodes.label: Metal Ions
summaries: Fe2+, Cu2+, Co2+ initiate free radical formation in lipids.

nodes.label: Methanol
summaries: Routine impurity tested in Chinese safety assessment.

nodes.label: Methionine Sulfoxide Reductase
summaries: MSR A and B enzymes that repair H2O2 damage; absent/lower in gray hair, contributing to graying.

nodes.label: Methylene Chloride
summaries: Prohibited in US cosmetics due to animal carcinogenicity (21 CFR 700.19).

nodes.label: Methylisothiazolinone
summaries: Isothiazolinone preservative, alone or with methylchloroisothiazolinone.

nodes.label: Micellar Thickening
summaries: Achieving Newtonian viscosity in surfactant systems via high surfactant concentration or salt thickening.

nodes.label: Micelle Formation
summaries: Excess surfactant beyond interface saturation clusters with hydrophilic exterior and hydrophobic interior.

nodes.label: Microarray
summaries: Go-to high-throughput method for simultaneous analysis of thousands of genes to identify biomarkers; Taylor et al. found 1282 genes in differentiating keratinocytes.

nodes.label: Microbial Contamination Testing
summaries: Testing for bacterial contamination of a finalized prototype formula before commercialization.

nodes.label: Microdermabrasion
summaries: Vacuum suction with diamond chips or aluminum oxide crystals exfoliating top skin layers; improves melasma over multiple treatments.

nodes.label: Microemulsion
summaries: Thick blue dispersion formed by optimally balanced silicone copolyols; most efficient for surface activity; minimum D* = 0.17x + 1.

nodes.label: MicroRNA Expression Profiling
summaries: Microarray, RNA sequencing, qPCR and qPCR arrays used to profile microRNA expression.

nodes.label: Mifepristone
summaries: Glucocorticoid blocker proposed as possible topical anti-aging therapy.

nodes.label: miRBase
summaries: MicroRNA database; v10 (June 2013) listed 1872 human precursors and 2578 mature microRNAs.

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Biogenesis
summaries: Mitochondriogenesis; its promotion is critical to preventing aging.

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Free Radical Theory of Aging
summaries: MFRTA: aging caused by macromolecule damage from mitochondrial ROS; influential for 50 years but challenged by long-lived species studies.

nodes.label: Mitochondrial Theory of Aging
summaries: Toxins and by-products accumulate in mitochondria, reducing energy output; mitochondrial DNA damaged by oxygen radicals.

nodes.label: Moisturizer
summaries: Skin care formulated with amino acid emollients and humectants.

nodes.label: Molds and Yeasts
summaries: Fungi; grow at 20-25°C optimally; molds don't grow below aw 0.80.

nodes.label: Molecular Cell Biology
summaries: Field investigating how cells develop, operate, communicate and control their activities, increasingly relevant to formulation chemists.

nodes.label: Moll Gland
summaries: Modified apocrine sweat glands surrounding eyelash follicles.

nodes.label: Monobenzone
summaries: Agent for total depigmentation reserved as last resort in extensive recalcitrant vitiligo.

nodes.label: Monosodium Glutamate
summaries: Isolated by Kikunae Ikeda in 1908 from seaweed/soy hydrolysates; birth of industrial amino acid production.

nodes.label: Mons Veneris
summaries: Fatty hair-covered prominence overlying the symphysis pubis.

nodes.label: Mousse
summaries: Water-based styling polymer foam that partly plasticizes hair and provides uniform welding patterns.

nodes.label: MQ Resin
summaries: Silicone resin from monofunctional (M) and tetrafunctional (Q) silanes forming cage structures when M:Q ratio is below ~2:1; drying to skin, soluble in hydrocarbons.

nodes.label: Mulberry Extract
summaries: Natural alternative to hydroquinone for hyperpigmentation.

nodes.label: Multivitamin Supplementation
summaries: Oral multivitamins associated with 5% longer telomeres.

nodes.label: Mutation Accumulation and DNA/RNA Damage Theory
summaries: DNA damage and mutations interfere with gene expression, proposed as an aging mechanism.

nodes.label: N-Acetylglutaminylglutamine Amide
summaries: Dipeptide osmolyte discovered in Sinorhizobium meliloti at high osmolarity; lead for new anti-senescence peptides.

nodes.label: NAD+
summaries: Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide cofactor for sirtuins; makes sirtuins sensitive to cellular metabolic state and caloric restriction.

nodes.label: Nail Hardener
summaries: Nail cosmetic; formaldehyde-containing hardeners have been implicated in onycholysis.

nodes.label: Nail Pitting
summaries: Depressed sites in the nail plate from irregular matrix production; most common manifestation of nail psoriasis.

nodes.label: [nano] Ingredient Labeling
summaries: EU requirement that nanomaterial ingredients be followed by 'nano' in brackets in the ingredient list.

nodes.label: Nanotechnology
summaries: Intentional manipulation, manufacture or selection of materials with at least one dimension of about 1-100 nm; a rapidly expanding field driving new legislation.

nodes.label: Narcissus Tazetta Bulb Extract
summaries: Dormant bulb extract slowing epidermal turnover, sparing telomeres.

nodes.label: Narrow-Band UVB Phototherapy
summaries: Gold standard and most frequently used treatment for vitiligo.

nodes.label: Nasal Epithelium
summaries: Lining of the nasal cavity whose highly specialized polarized cells express odorant receptors in vivo.

nodes.label: Natural Preservatives
summaries: Industry moving towards sustainable natural preservatives; Ayurvedic ingredients could be high-value.

nodes.label: Natural vs Naturally Derived Actives
summaries: Naturally occurring compounds in natural form (e.g. EGCG in extract) are natural; naturally derived actives are synthesized from natural sources and don't occur in nature.

nodes.label: Neurodegenerative Disorders
summaries: Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, ALS associated with ubiquitinated protein inclusions and inflammation.

nodes.label: Neuro-Endocrine Theory of Aging
summaries: Aging endocrine glands governed by the hypothalamus secrete less hormone, reducing repair/regulation; receptors are downgraded and circadian hormone rhythms become irregular.

nodes.label: New Drug Application
summaries: FDA premarket approval route (FD&C Act sec. 505) required for drugs unless they comply with an OTC monograph.

nodes.label: Next-Generation Sequencing
summaries: State-of-the-art sequencing of whole genomes in days, RNA sequencing and epigenetic analysis.

nodes.label: Niacin
summaries: B vitamin substrate of SIRT1, playing role in histone modification.

nodes.label: Nicotine
summaries: Tobacco pollutant activating enzymes degrading intercellular cement; thinned epidermis in explants.

nodes.label: Nike
summaries: Developed a $6 million Environmental Apparel Design Tool assessing footprint of technologies and shared it with industry.

nodes.label: No Observed Adverse Effect Level
summaries: Highest dose without observed adverse effects; basis for MoS but rarely found in literature.

nodes.label: Noncoding DNA
summaries: 98% of genome once called 'junk DNA'; includes sequences governing when, where and how much genes are expressed.

nodes.label: Norepinephrine
summaries: Neurotransmitter/hormone released by adrenals in stress response.

nodes.label: North American Menopause Society
summaries: Issued evidence-based position statement recommending local estrogen treatment for vaginal atrophy.

nodes.label: Novelty
summaries: Patentability condition that the invention was not previously known in the prior art (35 USC 102, EPC Art. 54).

nodes.label: Nutriepigenetics
summaries: Study of how dietary nutrients alter the epigenome; nutrition second only to environment in epigenetic impact.

nodes.label: 2'-O-Acetyl-ADP Ribose
summaries: Unique reaction product formed when sirtuins transfer an acetyl group to NAD+.

nodes.label: Office for Harmonization in the Internal Market
summaries: EU office organizing European trademarks and designs.

nodes.label: Oil-in-Water Emulsion
summaries: Product base type, e.g. facial creme, into which fragrances must be adapted.

nodes.label: Oleic Acid
summaries: Omega-9 fatty acid, major component of olive oil.

nodes.label: Olfactive Families
summaries: Fragrance categories: primary citrus, floral, fougere, woody, chypre, oriental; secondary include marine, aldehydic, aromatic, green, spicy, fruity, musky, gourmand, leather/animalic.

nodes.label: Olfactory Adaptation
summaries: Brain ceases to recognize an odor smelled continuously, e.g. after minutes in a zoo monkey house.

nodes.label: Omega-7 Fatty Acids
summaries: Unsaturated at seven carbons from chain end; rich in macadamia nut and sea buckthorn oils.

nodes.label: Onychorrhexis
summaries: Longitudinal nail striations, more prominent with age, lichen planus, psoriasis and trauma.

nodes.label: Optical Coherence Tomography
summaries: Imaging used to show epidermal thickness improvement.

nodes.label: Oral Appliance Therapy
summaries: Custom dental device advancing mandible to open airway for mild/moderate OSA or CPAP-noncompliant patients.

nodes.label: OTC Drug Monographs
summaries: Standards from FDA's Over-the-Counter Drug Review; cosmetic/drugs must comply and use 'Drug Facts' labeling (21 CFR 201.66) listing active then inactive ingredients.

nodes.label: Ozone
summaries: Tropospheric ozone pollutant (0.4 ppm, 30 min) decreased SIRT3 in keratinocytes.

nodes.label: Paeonol
summaries: Used in anti-aging cream (1.5%) and anti-inflammatory gel (0.5%).

nodes.label: Palm Oil
summaries: Its use including in biofuels has destroyed large parts of Indonesian and Malaysian rainforest and biodiversity.

nodes.label: Panchakarma
summaries: Ayurvedic bio-purification using oil or water based extract blends for dermatological concerns, with oral supplements and poultices.

nodes.label: Pantothenic Acid
summaries: Contributes to acetyl-CoA, source of acetyl groups for histone acetylation.

nodes.label: Papain
summaries: Fruit enzyme known to professionals for gentle exfoliation.

nodes.label: Paracrine Effect
summaries: Stem cells secrete growth factors that activate neighboring cells to exhibit diverse pharmacologic actions.

nodes.label: Paraoxonase 1
summaries: Anti-atherosclerotic enzyme preventing lipoperoxide accumulation and LDL lipid oxidation.

nodes.label: Paronychia
summaries: Inflammation of proximal or lateral nail folds after cuticle loss through trauma or aggressive trimming; acute (infectious) or chronic.

nodes.label: PARSOL SLX
summaries: Silicone-based UV-B absorber (DSM) preventing color fading, enhancing gloss and conditioning.

nodes.label: Patent Classification Systems
summaries: USPC (classes 132, 424, 512, D28), IPC and ECLA (A61K, A61Q) hierarchical classes used for patent searching.

nodes.label: Patent Marking
summaries: Laws require tagging products or packaging (or a website) with protecting patent numbers, revealing IP information.

nodes.label: Pearlizers
summaries: Pearlescent agents that may separate on heating in fragranced products, a sign of phase instability.

nodes.label: PEG-150 Distearate
summaries: Viscosifying polymer providing Newtonian rheology in surfactant systems.

nodes.label: PEG-Esters
summaries: Normally high HLB nonionic emulsifiers (PEG-100 stearate).

nodes.label: Penetration Enhancers
summaries: Combining with high-MW HA improves its penetration and anti-aging effect.

nodes.label: Pentosidine
summaries: AGE accumulating in long-lived collagen with age.

nodes.label: Peptide Bond
summaries: Amide bond formed when the carboxyl group of one amino acid links to the amino group of the next, releasing water.

nodes.label: Peptidoglycan
summaries: Bacterial cell-wall molecule eliciting immune-cell stimulation.

nodes.label: Peptidylarginine Deiminase
summaries: Enzyme converting filaggrin arginine to citrulline, releasing it from microfibrils.

nodes.label: Periorbital Hypermelanosis
summaries: Under-eye dark circles, very common in Asian (especially Indian) populations; hereditary or from stress, eye strain, allergies, smoking, alcohol, caffeine, poor sleep and diet.

nodes.label: Personalized Skin Care
summaries: Using an individual's genetic footprint to develop skin care products addressing specific needs.

nodes.label: pH
summaries: Microbes grow optimally near pH 7, most at 5-8; Pseudomonas from 3 to 11.

nodes.label: Phospholipase A2
summaries: Enzyme triggered when skin is traumatized; releases arachidonic acid from membranes.

nodes.label: Photo-Damaged Arm Model
summaries: Bilateral paired forearm clinical model grading crepe-like appearance on 0-9 scale.

nodes.label: Phytic Acid
summaries: Inositol hexakisphosphate from rice, wheat or corn bran; strong natural chelator (sodium phytate).

nodes.label: Pine Bark Extract
summaries: Inhibited type I collagenase up to 70% at 1.4%.

nodes.label: pKa
summaries: Negative log of acid dissociation constant; at pH = pKa half the AHA is free acid (10% glycolic at pH 3.8 gives 5% bioavailable).

nodes.label: Plant Collection Surveys
summaries: Random (shotgun), phylogenetic and ethnobotanically directed survey strategies for discovering plant actives.

nodes.label: Plant Patent
summaries: For asexually reproduced new plant varieties; 20-year term, single claim, rare.

nodes.label: New Plant Waxes
summaries: Neem, esparto, bayberry, sunflower, jojoba, rice bran waxes and castor-based polyester waxes offered as lipstick points of difference.

nodes.label: Poly(lactic-co-glycolic acid)
summaries: Polymer matrix of targeted capsules delivering actives to cells such as dendritic cells.

nodes.label: Polar Paradox
summaries: Hydrophilic antioxidants perform better in bulk oils, hydrophobic ones in O/W emulsions, since oxidation starts at interfaces.

nodes.label: Polar Penetration Pathway
summaries: Hydrophilic route through polar pores surrounded by polar lipids between cells; e.g., sucrose penetrates this way.

nodes.label: Poloxamers
summaries: ABA EO-PO-EO block copolymers; solubilizers and gelling agents in oral care (Poloxamer 407, 188).

nodes.label: Polyacrylic Acid Polymers
summaries: Hydro swellable droplet polymers that invert in water for instant viscosity with broad pH stability.

nodes.label: Polymethylsilsesquioxane
summaries: Silicone powder combined with Polysilicone-11 in a smooth serum for oil absorption and slip.

nodes.label: Polysomnography
summaries: Standard overnight sleep study for diagnosis; home tests, actigraphy and pulse-oximetry also used.

nodes.label: Polysorbate 80
summaries: High HLB (14.9) nonionic used in required-HLB test blends.

nodes.label: Polyunsaturated Fatty Acids
summaries: More susceptible to oxidation than monounsaturated; linoleic acid C-11 hydrogen most easily removed.

nodes.label: Polyvinyl Alcohol
summaries: Polymer forming the outer shell of PLGA intelligent targeting capsules.

nodes.label: PPAR-gamma
summaries: Key adipogenic nuclear receptor targeted by miR-27b and miR-130.

nodes.label: Pricing Strategy
summaries: Pricing must cover variable and fixed costs, consider competitor/substitute prices and willingness to pay; distributors take ~10% and retailers up to 50% of retail price.

nodes.label: Principal Display Panel
summaries: Part of the US label seen at retail; must carry product name, identity, warnings where applicable and net quantity in the bottom 30%.

nodes.label: Procapil
summaries: Sederma active that reinforces hair anchoring and reduces hair loss.

nodes.label: Progesterone
summaries: Ovarian steroid whose fall with estrogen triggers menstruation and MMP secretion.

nodes.label: Proline Betaine
summaries: Anti-senescence osmoprotectant identified in human urine.

nodes.label: Proteases
summaries: Skin enzymes that degrade peptides, limiting their stability.

nodes.label: Proteoglycan
summaries: GAGs such as chondroitin and keratan sulfate bound to core proteins; link proteins bind them to HA forming a hygroscopic complex.

nodes.label: U.S. Provisional Patent Application
summaries: Placeholder filed up to 12 months before a regular application to gain term; no direct enforcement value.

nodes.label: Proximal Nail Fold
summaries: Wedge-shaped structure at the proximal edge of the nail unit; dorsal side forms epidermis, ventral side forms the cuticle; devoid of adnexa.

nodes.label: Pudendal Nerve
summaries: Nerve (S2-S4) whose perineal branch covers labia majora and whose deep branch supplies over 8,000 nerve endings of the glans clitoris.

nodes.label: Push and Pull Marketing
summaries: Push marketing encourages distributors and retailers to carry a product; pull marketing informs consumers about the product, claims and availability.

nodes.label: Pyrrolizidine Alkaloids
summaries: Toxic alkaloids found in comfrey flowers.

nodes.label: QSAR
summaries: Theoretical structure-activity studies on hazard used as alternative strategy after animal testing restrictions.

nodes.label: Quantitative Descriptive Analysis
summaries: QDA sensory method rating cushion, quickness of break, wetness, spreadability and afterfeel on 1-6 scales; used to rank carbomer emulsions.

nodes.label: Quantitative Risk Assessment (QRA)
summaries: IFRA document delineating maximum use levels of fragrance materials per product category (11 categories from lip care to candles) based on expected exposure.

nodes.label: Raoult's Law
summaries: Principle cited for how a component's volatility changes from the neat state due to solubility in or interaction with a product matrix.

nodes.label: RAS
summaries: Low-molecular-weight G-protein binding GTP/GDP, part of the Ras/PI3K/mTOR growth pathway.

nodes.label: Reactive Nitrogen Species
summaries: Longer-lived, more specific species; NO plus superoxide forms peroxynitrite, triggering cytochrome c release and caspase-mediated apoptosis.

nodes.label: Read-Across
summaries: Safety evaluation based on structural surrogates or categories; insufficient data to apply to nanomaterials.

nodes.label: Reconstructed Skin Model
summaries: 3D bioengineered epidermis or full-thickness skin from primary cells used as reproducible testing model for microRNA studies of anti-aging ingredients.

nodes.label: Redox Active Metals
summaries: Iron, copper, chromium, cobalt undergo redox cycling producing superoxide and nitric oxide radicals.

nodes.label: Reticulin
summaries: Fine silver-staining dermal fibers (0.4% of dry weight), now regarded as type III collagen, anchoring the basal lamina.

nodes.label: Retinoic Acid Receptors (RAR/RXR)
summaries: Nuclear receptors (RAR and RXR, each with alpha, beta, gamma subtypes) bound by retinoids to modulate DNA transcription; RAR-gamma is the key mediator in skin.

nodes.label: Retinyl Acetate
summaries: Retinol ester permitted at <=1% in KSA.

nodes.label: Retinyl Esters
summaries: Storage form of retinol in cells and dietary form of vitamin A metabolized to retinol.

nodes.label: REV-ERB alpha
summaries: Nuclear receptor rhythmically repressing BMAL1 transcription in a second feedback loop.

nodes.label: RF50
summaries: Concentration of silicone surfactant needed to reduce a surfactant solution's surface tension to 25 dynes/cm.

nodes.label: Rheology
summaries: Important lipstick parameter to inhibit flow at elevated temperatures; altered by clays.

nodes.label: Fudo Rheometer
summaries: Instrument stretching skin specimen at constant rate until break, similar to a universal testing machine.

nodes.label: RNA
summaries: Ribonucleic acid that transfers information within the cell and provides the template for protein synthesis.

nodes.label: RNA Polymerase
summaries: Enzyme that makes RNA copies of DNA once chromosomes uncoil.

nodes.label: Rochow Process
summaries: Chlorosilane manufacturing process that produces the building blocks of silicone polymers.

nodes.label: ROR alpha
summaries: Clock-controlled gene activating BMAL1 transcription via ROR response elements.

nodes.label: Rosaccreditatsia
summaries: Russian Federal Accreditation Service assigned control of Technical Regulation application.

nodes.label: Rose Extract
summaries: Aromatic extract comprising hundreds or thousands of ingredients; used as example for identifying ORs responsive to a desired aroma.

nodes.label: Rosewood
summaries: Aniba rosaeodora; overexploited in French Guiana for essential oil by distillers clear-cutting trees until protected status and replanting.

nodes.label: Rospotrebnadzor
summaries: Russian Federal Service for consumer rights supervision named in 2012 (Decree 989) to apply and verify the Technical Regulation.

nodes.label: Rucinol
summaries: Non-FDA-approved alternative to hydroquinone for hyperpigmentation.

nodes.label: Ruffini Receptor
summaries: Slowly adapting mechanoreceptor responding to sustained touch.

nodes.label: S-Adenosyl Methionine
summaries: SAM: methyl donor for most DNMT activities; converted to SAH.

nodes.label: Saudi Arabian Standards Organization
summaries: National standards body that transferred food, drug and cosmetic standards to SFDA in 2011; its standards still apply.

nodes.label: SCCNFP
aliases: Scientific Committee on Cosmetic Products and Non-Food Products
summaries: EU Scientific Committee on Cosmetic Products and Non-Food Products whose consensus identified up to 26 fragrance dermal allergens.

nodes.label: Schiff Base
summaries: Unstable reversible bond between reducing sugar aldehyde and protein amine; first stage of AGE formation.

nodes.label: Sea Minerals
summaries: Trace elements from seawater (over 63 elements), Dead Sea and deep sea waters; also lithothamnium and sands for microdermabrasion.

nodes.label: Sebaceous Follicle
summaries: Sebaceous glands without terminal hairs found along the vermilion border and encircling every body orifice, suggesting a protective function.

nodes.label: Seborrheic Dermatitis
summaries: Dandruff-type condition common in brown skin, involving hairline, scalp, eyebrows, nasolabial folds and ears.

nodes.label: Size-Exclusion Chromatography with Multi-Angle Light Scattering
summaries: SEC-MALS-RI gives MW, distribution and size of HA fragments; two columns in series improve separation.

nodes.label: Self-Preserving Cosmetics
summaries: Concentrated products whose physicochemical properties prevent growth; dilution can make them susceptible.

nodes.label: Senescence-Associated Beta-Galactosidase
summaries: SA-bgal marker that increases in senescent cells.

nodes.label: Sensory Spectrum Inc.
summaries: Sensory evaluation firm led by Gail Vance Civille, advocating consumer involvement in preliminary concept work.

nodes.label: M/D/T/Q Silicone Nomenclature
summaries: Shorthand for silicone building blocks: M chain terminators, D backbone units, T and Q cross-linkers; e.g., MD50M; reactive sites denoted with asterisks.

nodes.label: Siliphilic/Oleophilic Solubility Concept
summaries: Extension of hydrophilic/hydrophobic terms: hydrophobic materials may be oleophilic (oil-loving) or siliphilic (silicone-loving); 'group opposites'.

nodes.label: Silymarin
summaries: Liver-protecting medicine extracted from milk thistle seeds.

nodes.label: Simultaneous US-EU Compliance
summaries: Planning product development from the outset to meet both US and EU rules; EU compliance makes US compliance easier.

nodes.label: Sinigrin
summaries: Glucosinolate in erysimum stored in vacuoles; degraded by myrosinase upon tissue laceration unless dried at 75 C.

nodes.label: SIRT5
summaries: Mitochondrial sirtuin deacetylating carbamoyl phosphate synthetase, regulating urea cycle.

nodes.label: Protein-DNA Interactome
summaries: Network connecting genes; seven sirtuins act as hubs in 25% of interactome, warranting caution in gene-targeted cosmetics.

nodes.label: Six Traits of Sustainable Companies
summaries: OIS companies are systemic, enterprise-level, committed, collaborative, invested and transparent.

nodes.label: Skin Evaluation Questionnaire
summaries: Three-page intake form covering skin type, ancestry, tanning, pigmentation, vascularity, acne, sun exposure, free radical exposure, lifestyle and healing ability.

nodes.label: Skin Pigmentation
summaries: Pigmentation process examined in epigenetic skin-care studies.

nodes.label: Skin Sagging
summaries: Sagging correlated with decreased Ur/Uf on the cheeks.

nodes.label: Skin Type (Oily/Dry)
summaries: Categorization from very dry to very oily and blemished, based on T-zone and cheek oiliness.

nodes.label: Skin Undertone
summaries: Complexion undertones vary by region: yellow/olive in Asia, ruddy red/pink in Europe; lighter in northern climates, darker near the equator.

nodes.label: Smectite Clays
summaries: Thickeners forming house-of-cards colloidal structure giving thixotropy and yield value in low-pH formulas.

nodes.label: SNARE Complex
summaries: Neurotransmitter release machinery inhibited by Argireline.

nodes.label: Social Auditing
summaries: Quantifying and publicly disclosing green efforts under pressure from employees and consumers.

nodes.label: Social Media Influence on Regulation
summaries: Rapid online spread of information on bad practices or emerging issues accelerates regulatory change and can force removal of ingredients.

nodes.label: SOCS3
summaries: Negative regulator of JAK/STAT pathway; controversial miR-203 target.

nodes.label: Soft-Focus Effect
summaries: Optical blurring of imperfections; silicone elastomers act as soft-focus particles and line fillers.

nodes.label: Solar Lentigines
summaries: Small brown patches treated by AHAs.

nodes.label: Sorbitan Oleate
summaries: Low HLB (4.3) nonionic used in required-HLB test blends.

nodes.label: Soy
summaries: Natural alternative to hydroquinone for hyperpigmentation.

nodes.label: Hydrolyzed Soy and Wheat Protein (IV10.008)
summaries: Limited TRF-2 loss in senescent fibroblasts and reduced DNA double-strand breaks.

nodes.label: Spreading Coefficient
summaries: Measure of ingredient spreadability; increases with polarity, MW and branching; silicone oils ≥35.

nodes.label: Squalene
summaries: Constitutes about 15% of sebum in the gland lumen.

nodes.label: Steam Distillation
summaries: Usual method of obtaining essential oils; the oil floats on the distillate water and is separated and dried.

nodes.label: Stearic Acid Derivatives
summaries: Used in cleansers for viscosity and foam stabilization and emolliency; stearic acid esters impart pearlescence to shampoos.

nodes.label: Stem Cell Factor
summaries: Dermal papilla growth factor important for hair growth and melanogenesis; its decrease is one theory of graying.

nodes.label: Stephan Curve
summaries: Classic curve showing plaque pH dropping from ~6.8 to ~5 within minutes after sugar and recovering over 20-60 minutes; demonstrated by R.M. Stephan in the 1940s.

nodes.label: Stilbenes
summaries: Stilbenoids with tyrosinase inhibition depending on oxygenation; include resveratrol, oxyresveratrol, pterostilbene.

nodes.label: Stratum Disjunctum
summaries: Outermost desquamating layer of SC where glycolic acid accelerates desmosome breakdown.

nodes.label: Stratum Lucidum
summaries: Clear layer at the deepest portion of the stratum corneum, recognizable only in palmar and plantar skin.

nodes.label: Strehler's Criteria of Aging
summaries: Bernard Strehler's definition: aging is destructive, progressive, intrinsically determined and universal.

nodes.label: Stress-Induced Premature Senescence
summaries: SIPS: model inducing senescence by repeated weak oxidative stress (e.g., H2O2) for testing molecules.

nodes.label: Hair Stress-Strain Curve
summaries: Tensile curve of hair with Hookean region (0-2/5%), yield region (2-35%, keratin coil opening) and post-yield region (>35%, recrystallization) before break.

nodes.label: Stressed Lysates
summaries: Organisms grown under heat shock, peroxide or UV stress produce enhanced novel actives.

nodes.label: Strontium Chloride
summaries: Desensitizing agent that promotes blockage of open dentinal tubules.

nodes.label: Structure-Function Claim
summaries: Type of product claim the FDA has a mandate to keep from being false or misleading.

nodes.label: Successful Aging
summaries: Rowe and Kahn: low disease risk, high mental/physical function, active engagement; Murad extends to 'Inclusive Health'.

nodes.label: Sulfuric Acid
summaries: Pollutant in exhaust gas linked to premature skin aging in cities.

nodes.label: Supercontraction
summaries: Strong contraction of hair/wool in high-pH solutions; proposed to aid imposition of straight shape in relaxing.

nodes.label: Superoxide
summaries: Physiological free radical, mostly harmless itself but precursor of hydroxyl radicals.

nodes.label: Surface Tension Reduction
summaries: Surfactants lower water surface tension at air/water interface, allowing better wetting for cleansing.

nodes.label: Suspending Agents
summaries: Rheological additives that build a loose structure trapping solid particles so they do not settle; critical in antiperspirants, sunscreens, mascara, nail polish and lipsticks.

nodes.label: Sympathetic Nervous System
summaries: 'Fight or flight' branch of the autonomic nervous system most relevant to skin.

nodes.label: Synthetic Fragrance Ingredient
summaries: Synthetic aromatics that became a mainstay of the fragrance industry but often fail to replicate natural extracts exactly.

nodes.label: Systemic Exposure Dosage
summaries: Estimated systemic exposure to an ingredient, the denominator in MoS calculation.

nodes.label: TA-65
summaries: Astragalus-derived molecule claimed to lengthen telomeres via telomerase activation orally.

nodes.label: Talc
summaries: Mineral absorbent popular for oil absorption and slip.

nodes.label: Tannins
summaries: Present in amla; antioxidant and anti-inflammatory.

nodes.label: Skin Lipid Peroxidation Tape Assay
summaries: Tape-removed skin lipids exposed to UV to measure antioxidant protection; showed vitamin E/emblica synergy and pro-oxidant behavior of some materials.

nodes.label: Taxol
summaries: Terpenoid anticancer drug that cannot be chemically synthesized economically; produced via plant cell culture.

nodes.label: Terminal Hair
summaries: Large, usually pigmented and medullated hair, predominantly on the scalp, growing 0.3-0.4 mm per day.

nodes.label: Theophylline
summaries: Xanthine phosphodiesterase blocker that helps mobilize fat.

nodes.label: Hair Thermal Conductivity
summaries: Hair is a poor heat conductor; fibers 100 µm below the iron plate sense 20-25°C less, and the far side of a 1 mm swatch ~60°C less.

nodes.label: Third-Party Conformity Assessment
summaries: CU requires product testing at CU-accredited laboratories and certification bodies before entering the territory.

nodes.label: 3D Facial Scanning
summaries: Cyberware 3030 HIREZ near-IR scanner computing length, depth and volume of wrinkles.

nodes.label: 3R Principle
summaries: Replace, Refine and Reduce animal use in testing.

nodes.label: Thrombospondin-1
summaries: Endogenous inhibitor of blood-vessel growth down-regulated by UVB.

nodes.label: Thyroxin
summaries: Thyroid hormone governing basal metabolism; DOCH is speculated to inhibit its use by cells.

nodes.label: Tiered Testing Strategy
summaries: In vitro and in vivo screening followed by pivotal in vivo and mechanistic studies for nanomaterials.

nodes.label: Tocopheryl Acetate
summaries: Esterified tocopherol, stable but without proton-donating antioxidant activity; hydrolyzes in skin to free tocopherol.
Tocopherol acetate, succinate and linoleate; less protective than tocopherol due to slow hydrolysis in skin.

nodes.label: Toll-Like Receptor 2
summaries: Receptor inhibited by retinoids, down-regulating inflammatory mediators NF-kB, IL-8 and IL-20.

nodes.label: Tongue
summaries: Oral soft tissue harboring large bacterial populations that recolonize teeth and generate oral malodor.

nodes.label: Totipotency
summaries: Embryonic ability of plant meristem cells to originate all differentiated plant structures; regained by wounded somatic cells.

nodes.label: Trade Secret Ingredient Exemption
summaries: FDA may accept an ingredient as a trade secret (21 CFR 720.8) so its name need not be disclosed on the label.

nodes.label: Trademark Class 3
summaries: Nice class covering soaps, perfumery, essential oils, cosmetics, hair lotions and dentifrices; other relevant classes 1, 5, 8, 10, 21, 44.

nodes.label: Transcellular Penetration Pathway
summaries: Penetration through corneocytes; route for amphiphilic and small molecules; slow but large surface area.

nodes.label: Transient Transfection
summaries: Freshly introducing the OR gene into new batches of cells each time; advantage is speed.

nodes.label: Trehalose
summaries: Non-reducing disaccharide osmoprotectant from anhydrobiotic organisms; used to preserve foods, enzymes, vaccines and cells dehydrated.

nodes.label: Triangle Test
summaries: Sensory discrimination test in which panelists identify the odd sample among three (two control, one test or vice versa); used by fragrance QC to compare production to standard.

nodes.label: Triboelectric Series
summaries: Ranking of insulators by electron transfer; hair lies below rubber, so combing transfers electrons and charges hair negatively.

nodes.label: Trichocyte
summaries: Terminally differentiated hair follicle keratinocytes making up the hair shaft.

nodes.label: Trichohyalin
summaries: Protein produced by IRS keratinocytes that acts as intracellular cement strengthening the inner root sheath.

nodes.label: Triethanolamine
summaries: Neutralizer recommended for carbomer hydroalcoholic systems at ~60% alcohol.

nodes.label: Triethyl Citrate
summaries: One of the most common fragrance carriers.

nodes.label: Triisopropanolamine
summaries: Neutralizer recommended for carbomer gels at ~90% alcohol.

nodes.label: Triisostearyl Citrate

nodes.label: Cytokinins

nodes.label: Dermatopontin

nodes.label: Drop Point

nodes.label: Emulsifiers

nodes.label: Environmental Protection Agency

nodes.label: Eucalyptol

nodes.label: Exportin-5

nodes.label: Extremophiles

nodes.label: Fermented Foods

nodes.label: 5-Lipoxygenase

summaries: US agency whose rules govern cosmetic products.

nodes.label: Gluconic Acid

nodes.label: Grapefruit Seed Extract

nodes.label: HACCP

nodes.label: Honey

nodes.label: Hyaluronate Lyase

nodes.label: Hyperkeratosis

nodes.label: ICDAS

nodes.label: Indirect Immunofluorescence

summaries: Ingredient class whose synthesis and development resulted from WWII-era cosmetic developments.

nodes.label: Interleukin-1
summaries: Pro-inflammatory cytokine elevated in older skin.

nodes.label: Lidocaine

nodes.label: Macadamia Nut Oil
summaries: Rich source of omega-7 fatty acids.

nodes.label: Maillard Reaction

nodes.label: Marine Ingredients
summaries: Development and utilization of marine-derived ingredients is highlighted as a breakthrough area.

nodes.label: Mesenchymal Stem Cells
summaries: Abundant in adipose tissue; regenerate damaged skin.

nodes.label: Methyl Salicylate
summaries: Component of the fixed-ratio essential oil antigingivitis mouthrinse.

nodes.label: Methylparaben
summaries: Most frequently used preservative in US and Canada.

nodes.label: Microcrystalline Wax

nodes.label: Nylon-12

nodes.label: Ostwald Ripening

nodes.label: Ozokerite

nodes.label: Piperine

nodes.label: Porphyromonas Gingivalis

nodes.label: Polytetrafluoroethylene
summaries: Specialty powder filler giving smooth slippery feel.

nodes.label: PVP/Eicosene Copolymer

nodes.label: Rosette Test

nodes.label: RTI International
summaries: Institution of authors Jamie Pero Parker and Phil Watson who wrote on defining sustainability and the innovation process.

nodes.label: Sarcosinates

nodes.label: Sea Buckthorn Oil
summaries: Rich source of omega-7 fatty acids.

nodes.label: Secondary Oxidation Product Assays

nodes.label: Selective Estrogen Receptor Modulator

nodes.label: Shaving Cream

nodes.label: Shear Modulus

nodes.label: Silk Powder
summaries: Natural powder derived from silk protein to enhance feel.

nodes.label: Skin Explant Model

nodes.label: Skin Stem Cells
summaries: Their longevity improved by apple meristem cultures.

nodes.label: Sodium Monofluorophosphate

nodes.label: Spherical Silica
summaries: Nonabsorbent spherical powder providing ball-bearing effect.

nodes.label: Steareth-20
summaries: Nonionic with hydrophilic head 75% of weight, HLB 15.

nodes.label: Subungual Hematoma

nodes.label: Succinic Acid
summaries: Bio-based chemical produced by fermentation as alternative to conventional chemistry.

nodes.label: Sucrose

nodes.label: Sucrose Distearate
summaries: Common sucrose fatty acid ester in cosmetics.

nodes.label: Sulfated Polysaccharides
summaries: Marine algal compounds used in skin formulations.

nodes.label: Sulfosuccinates
summaries: Anionic class, e.g. disodium laureth sulfosuccinate.

nodes.label: Taurates
summaries: Mild anionics for opaque shampoos (e.g. sodium methyl cocoyl taurate).

nodes.label: tert-Butylhydroquinone
summaries: Synthetic antioxidant used to prevent rancidity.

nodes.label: Tea Tree Oil
summaries: Antimicrobial comparator less effective than coleus oil.

nodes.label: Thymol
summaries: Component of the fixed-ratio essential oil antigingivitis mouthrinse.

nodes.label: Traction Alopecia
summaries: Hair loss caused by external mechanical interference with follicle processes.

nodes.label: Trichorrhexis Nodosa
